rites.name: Orillum
rites.text: Orillum is the concept of a resonant tone that the Singing of Drerdunen gave to the first roots of the world as they condensed out of raw light. Temples of the Holy Age kept it as a measure of order, and its chanted pitch was said to steady the drifting flame of the early stars.

rites.name: Maustilium
rites.text: A sharp two-stage strike that a swordswoman delivers by thrusting upward and then driving downward, landing a pair of blows. It can shatter an opponent's guard.

rites.name: Sereosillia
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a wielder swings a shield-like weapon held in its guarding shape to batter an opponent. It is practiced by a single warrior who strikes with the defensive form of the weapon.

rites.name: Siles Orasellor
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter leaps and slams a fist into the earth, releasing a violet shockwave that rolls toward foes. Only one particular warrior is able to perform it.

rites.name: Amastanum Rirnalum
rites.text: A martial discipline taught to a mind-binding fighting order. A warrior learns it by overcoming a rare, singular beast while the order's mind-reaching technique is active on an ally.

rites.name: Valolerum
rites.text: A battle art practiced by fighters who swing a heavy staff sideways in a hard arc. Each strike that lands also mends the wounds of nearby allies.

rites.name: Nausontium
rites.text: A basic technique used by the male fighters of a certain blade-wielding kind. It is a first-tier special move that these warriors perform with their claw-like weapons.

rites.name: Liarnes
rites.text: A pressed strike of the ground's own force that hurls one foe, driven up from the soil beneath them. Its full lore goes unspoken, leaving only the bare workings of the blow to be seen.

rites.name: Teornum Cantia
rites.text: A bodily discipline that hardens the practitioner's frame against harm. It grants a modest increase in resistance to physical blows, and it is the opening technique of a larger path of endurance.

rites.name: Mausor Amaseonus
rites.text: A basic battle technique that lets a heavy-blade wielder of the brawny kind break through an opponent's guard. It is one of the early forceful skills a fighter learns.

rites.name: Tauntiares
rites.text: A combat technique wielded by ordinary fighters who draw on the earthbound strength of the land. It lets them strike with rooted, unshakable force.

rites.name: Ventanum Corantorium
rites.text: A defensive skill that lets fighters endure the pull of tidal force. Warriors of the common ranks use it in battle to steady themselves against the flow.

rites.name: Viares Telausianum
rites.text: A fighter drives the rim of a guarding board into an opponent, knocking them back to the ground if they are caught off guard. The strike is a lesser copy of a stronger technique.

rites.name: Valeontelia Caullanum
rites.text: A reflexive knack that a wanderer carries inside, quietly steering them toward safety when danger draws near. It belongs to the roster of trained abilities used by those who travel the wild roads.

rites.name: Oriantus Ceollosium
rites.text: A learned discipline that lets a wanderer keep going through harsh conditions. It is one of the skills a driver can cultivate to strengthen their survival abilities.

rites.name: Orauranes
rites.text: A killing strike that a swordsman may unleash once he has taken up his blade. It is one of the deadly finishing blows in his repertoire.

rites.name: Telauntanum
rites.text: A combat technique used by mind-disciplined fighters, learned after overcoming a playful sea-spirit while the mind-binding practice is active. It lets the user hurl a rush of water-bound force at an enemy.

rites.name: Valeontum
rites.text: A duelist's technique in which a wielder of a heavy two-handed axe slashes diagonally twice at a foe. It is one of the signature maneuvers of its user's chosen weapon.

rites.name: Caustia
rites.text: A silencing curse that bars a bearer from casting any rite except innate gifts. Strikes and counter-strikes still flow freely, and it is often paired with a limb-freezing hex, appearing as violet chains of light around the afflicted.

rites.name: Telorus
rites.text: A withering hex that drains the strength of a combatant's blows when cast. A lesser curse of the same kind, bound to a ruling timepiece, weakens the blows of a bound company during an early trial.

rites.name: Orianastium
rites.text: A disciplined fighting technique taught to one wandering duelist after a loyal companion's request is fulfilled. It belongs to a set of two signature crafts known only to that practitioner.

rites.name: Mallum
rites.text: A blue mist gathers around certain foes when they are badly wounded, raising their strength for a short time. Few such surges last long.

rites.name: Sinteror
rites.text: A striking art performed with paired blades by a wielder of two swords. It belongs to a disciplined cycle of sword techniques taught to one practitioner.

rites.name: Tanauntum
rites.text: A ranged combat technique used by one marksman type, releasing three rapid shots that streak through the open air toward foes. Only a single specific fighter is able to perform it.

rites.name: Nirenium
rites.text: A combat discipline reserved for a single warrior, who spins a long staff through a swift sweep and swinging whirl before ending with a heavy strike. It echoes a wild flurry technique used by a rival brotherhood.

rites.name: Vaurus
rites.text: A close-quarters fighting technique that stuns an opponent when it is performed from behind. It is taught among warriors who train with blades.

rites.name: Riarontus
rites.text: A timed trial set in a fortified hall of an ancient ruling house, offered by a sage of a small folk. Winning it grants two new combat techniques to a pair of allied fighters.

rites.name: Tantiallum
rites.text: A discipline of binding others to one's will through chains of practiced technique. It is a combat craft passed down among those who command through force.

rites.name: Tialerus
rites.text: A bearer calls up a surging aura that greatly boosts their strength while lowering their bodily guard. For fifteen seconds their taunts and strikes spill outward to hit everything nearby.

rites.name: Narauses
rites.text: A dark martial technique used by a wielder who fights with a pair of blades. It is one of the signature arts of its user when armed with twin swords.

rites.name: Valeonia
rites.text: A combat discipline practiced by heavy armored guardians. It becomes available to a warrior once they have reached that protective rank.

rites.name: Nirium
rites.text: A ferocious wild fury that a warrior of the Tidewind band unleashes during a chained assault. It belongs to Serethan, the sea-caller, and is used only in the midst of a coordinated strike.

rites.name: Amistollium
rites.text: A battle art practiced by tacticians, in which a fighter strikes down an enemy with the force of a swooping bird of prey. It belongs to the tactician discipline.

rites.name: Serentium
rites.text: A protective enchantment that blocks a set portion of incoming harm from blows and strikes. It holds on the bearer for a time, keeping their body safe from part of every attack.

rites.name: Serinia
rites.text: A sacred set of cooking methods passed between initiates of a seaside shrine. Those who complete the trial of ascension are taught to prepare dishes that bind a cook to the coastal waters.

rites.name: Corantialor
rites.text: A fighter's art of striking with a twisting spin imparted to the fist. It is one of the arts practiced by a certain wanderer in the wider tradition of combat disciplines.

rites.name: Merium Corellanum
rites.text: A combat discipline practiced by the roaming bards of a wandering order. It is taught as one of the performing arts used in battle.

rites.name: Vaurnus Cerum
rites.text: A ritual art of fire-movement practiced by a rear guard of defenders. It is performed as one of several guarded disciplines of the order.

rites.name: Neosiror
rites.text: A restorative gust that washes away lingering burdens from every ally in the company. It leaves them shielded against future afflictions for the rest of the struggle.

rites.name: Vornaullus
rites.text: A ritual art that forcibly sends an unwanted presence away from its place. It is counted among the rear-guard arts of a warrior order.

rites.name: Seores
rites.text: A sacred vocal discipline practiced by one ranked order of standard-bearers. It is counted among the trained arts that members of that order master.

rites.name: Mauriallium
rites.text: A combat craft that a mind-tuned warrior learns by overcoming a rare, regal beast. Once mastered, it lets the practitioner sway the instincts of nearby allies.

rites.name: Oralerum
rites.text: A close-quarters striking technique that wounds the foe with unseen spiritual force. It weakens the target's resistance to that force and shortens the duration of their protective aura.

rites.name: Nenallum
rites.text: A battle discipline practiced by strategists who raise a shadowed standard to rally their forces. It becomes available to a practitioner once they have mastered the strategist's path.

rites.name: Valelium
rites.text: A fighter's fury-driven technique in which a wielder sweeps a heavy two-handed axe in a left stroke and then a right stroke. It is one of the arts a particular warrior commands while bearing that weapon.

rites.name: Amiaria
rites.text: A rising blow delivered with a heavy hammer-shield, used by a wielder of that weapon. It counts as one of the fighter's signature techniques when armed with such a shield.

rites.name: Cellauntes
rites.text: A bright striking technique performed by a wielder of a curved single-edged blade. It is one of the arts used by a particular bearer of that weapon.

rites.name: Oronteorus
rites.text: A drowsy enchantment that a caster may weave over nearby foes, causing them to drift into a deep sleep. The caster is drawn into the same slumber.

rites.name: Casor
rites.text: A spinning strike performed by a wielder of a heavy two-handed chopping blade. The attacker rotates the weapon mid-swing to drive it deeper into a foe.

rites.name: Seriantum
rites.text: A whirling martial technique that a wielder of paired curved blades performs in battle. It belongs to a single warrior's repertoire and is used only when both weapons are held.

rites.name: Mialornia
rites.text: A fighting discipline in which a wielder holds a blade to blunt incoming harm and slowly mend their wounds. The cost is that their own strikes land with lesser force.

rites.name: Centanum
rites.text: A hidden technique used by a warrior who wields a curved blade. It is one of the fighting arts bound to that weapon.

rites.name: Viases
rites.text: A heavy strike technique performed with a great axe, delivering a crushing blow. It is one of the signature moves of its wielder.

rites.name: Corastum
rites.text: A fighter raises a pair of cords, then sweeps them sideways in a horizontal lash at a foe. It is one of the second-rank combat forms taught to those who wield whip blades.

rites.name: Corenanum
rites.text: A battle art practiced by mind-binding warriors, passed on only to those who overcome a bound beast guardian while their soul-link is active. It lets the user unleash a ferocious, commanding cry in combat.

rites.name: Tentes
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a blow landed on an opponent's back deals twice the usual harm. It is practiced as a disciplined art by warriors who favor sneaking around their foes.

rites.name: Nestiania
rites.text: A linked sequence of strikes that allies perform together during a clash. It is a coordinated tactic drawn from the bonds between companions.

rites.name: Sesaullum
rites.text: A combat art performed by a wielder who holds a pair of blades. It is one of the techniques used when fighting with two swords at once.

rites.name: Sialor
rites.text: A ritual discipline practiced as one of the rear guard arts of a sacred order. It is taught to defenders who hold the line from behind the front.

rites.name: Valarus
rites.text: A slow, layered technique in which a fighter binds a looping chain to the body of an opponent and wears them down through repeated small wounds. It is practised as a severe discipline within an ancient martial lineage.

rites.name: Corestanum
rites.text: A ward-born blessing that shields its bearer from any hindering curse or enfeebling hex. Bearers who hold it cannot be weakened by such afflictions.

rites.name: Sesanum
rites.text: A combat discipline practiced by a single kind of marksman, it is a technique of hurling a projectile with a forceful, guided thrust. Only one specific bearer of this craft may wield it.

rites.name: Mauniares
rites.text: A ritual technique of the Thaumaturge order in which a practitioner readies a staff and then drives it forward with force to pierce foes.

rites.name: Telantiarum
rites.text: A ritual combat discipline practiced by champions of a certain martial calling. It is a technique for striking twice in swift succession.

rites.name: Liastia Ceostor
rites.text: A sacred art by which a thaumaturge calls down a shielding grace to guard allies from harm. It is practiced among the robed mystics who channel the powers of the sky.

rites.name: Taulum
rites.text: A dormant mending that waits within a bearer until their strength falls low, then restores them and fades away.

rites.name: Voreolles
rites.text: A ritual technique in which a wielder of a blade in its sword form unleashes a rapid flurry of thrusting strikes. It is taught as a second-tier martial art among practitioners.

rites.name: Orirus
rites.text: A battle craft in which a hunter's shot is used to steer and push an opponent in a chosen direction. It belongs to the stalking discipline.

rites.name: Lianus
rites.text: A violent combat technique used by warriors of the martial path. It is trained as a battle discipline and channels raw force into a single crushing rush.

rites.name: Corentor
rites.text: A paired striking discipline taught to novice warriors of the soul-cutting order. It is one of the first combat forms a student learns.

rites.name: Vaulum Vaunernor
rites.text: A ground-breaking strike practiced by a warrior wielding a long-hafted blade. It reuses a powerful cleaving technique the warrior has already mastered.

rites.name: Cilauntum
rites.text: A ritual combat sequence performed by a single warrior during a chained assault. It combines a whirling double slash with a rolling crushing blow.

rites.name: Callum
rites.text: A chant practiced at first light that grants its singer a particular art. It is awakened for those who have overcome a pack of fierce wolf-like beasts.

rites.name: Orallernum
rites.text: A paired-edge fighting technique that is performed with two strikes at once. It deals far greater harm when the attacker strikes an opponent from behind.

rites.name: Corirus
rites.text: A fighting discipline practiced by a warrior-caste order that grants a steadfast stance, sharply boosting a user's battle prowess while they stand inside a lingering magical field. Fields created by others grant it no aid to comrades.

rites.name: Serornilles
rites.text: A combat discipline practiced by warriors of a sacred order. It is one of the chosen arts of its leader, drawing on rising motion.

rites.name: Valiasia
rites.text: A battle discipline practiced by a hidden order of mind-weavers. It is learned only after a fierce beast-champion is overcome while a student's inner-thread technique is active.

rites.name: Riarum
rites.text: A tumbling maneuver performed by a skilled rider while spinning a sphere. It is one of the arts used by a particular wielder when handling a ball-shaped tool, and a second wielder of a companion creature also knows it.

rites.name: Tares
rites.text: A ringed spinning technique practiced by bearers of a long shaft-weapon. It is one of the fighting arts used by a single warrior when wielding a great lance.

rites.name: Sereonor
rites.text: A combat technique practiced by mind-weavers, learned by overcoming a great sea serpent while a binding ritual is active on an ally. It lets two fighters strike as one.

rites.name: Veollanum
rites.text: A fighter's striking art that is drawn from a wielder's blades. It is one of the techniques used by a knife-bearing warrior, and it reuses an older strike the same user already knows.

rites.name: Miastes
rites.text: A battle art taught to strategists, allowing a practitioner to hold a foe firmly in place against the ground. It belongs to the disciplines practiced by the tactician order.

rites.name: Liasum
rites.text: A ground-breaking technique that a wielder of stone-shattering gauntlets may learn. It repeats a powerful strike performed earlier in the wielder's training.

rites.name: Oraurnastes
rites.text: A tooth-sharp striking art practiced by those who carry a curved blade. It is one of the techniques a wielder of such a sword can call upon in battle.

rites.name: Vonum Oreollor
rites.text: A ritual art of the robed summoners that draws the raw substances of the world into a conjured form. It is practiced only by those trained in the calling of the high summoner order.

rites.name: Niales
rites.text: A disciplined technique that draws vital essence out of a foe during combat. It is one of the first methods a novice practitioner of the mind-warrior path learns.

rites.name: Calor
rites.text: A defensive technique used by a wielder of a mechanical arm, which deals a crushing blow. It belongs to one practitioner's repertoire of techniques.

rites.name: Talor
rites.text: A bodily fighting technique that sweeps a forward arc of strikes against foes before them. Each blow drives opponents backward and builds the wielder's inner fervor.

rites.name: Miaranum Valeonistia
rites.text: A fierce combat technique taught to a mind-warrior after she overcomes a monstrous sovereign while her soul-binding ability stays active. It is a reckless, all-in assault.

rites.name: Serianisium
rites.text: A battle technique in which a fighter whips a looping, serpent-like strike to hit the foe. It is counted among the signature combat arts of a legendary wielder of the great serpent.

rites.name: Valanaulia
rites.text: A bound ritual discipline of looping chains that a practitioner of the mystic order wields to strike down hostile spirits. It is one of the coiled arts attributed to a single named adept.

rites.name: Mornium
rites.text: A disciplined sword technique taught to warriors of one martial order. It strikes with the blade's sharpened edge and can deal severe harm when delivered from behind an opponent.

rites.name: Telerosus
rites.text: A combat technique belonging to a set of arts linked to a serpent-like circle of power. It is practiced as a form of fighting by its wielders.

rites.name: Raria Oreolantes
rites.text: A combat technique where a fighter leaps toward an opponent and strikes downward with a sweeping slash. It is practiced by a certain class of protective warriors.

rites.name: Amesia
rites.text: A bonded signature technique that any wielder of a particular blade can perform once the sword has been drawn free by a preceding art. It is earned during a clash against a sovereign of a rival realm.

rites.name: Riarnes Vornes
rites.text: A fighting technique practiced by mind-cutters, learned by overcoming a rare foe who lies and deceives. It is gained only after a victory achieved while a particular inner-reading craft is active.

rites.name: Teleolostum
rites.text: A ritual strike used only by a pair of bonded fighters, in which one wields a humming tool like a rifle and fires a shot at foes. It is a branch of a longer sweeping technique.

rites.name: Mosaurum
rites.text: A closing technique that a wielder unleashes at the highest tier of their power. Its nature shifts with the blade held in hand.

rites.name: Reontia
rites.text: A frosty technique wielded by a sorcerer-warrior that hurls a block of ice at a foe, damaging them and leaving them numbed by cold.

rites.name: Telonus Senium
rites.text: A battle art practiced by wielders of heavy two-handed axes. It is one of the techniques that such a weapon-bearer can call upon in combat.

rites.name: Oreonasanum
rites.text: A disciplined inner stillness practiced by martial artists, allowing a fighter to gather their attention into a single sharp point. It is taught as one of the battle arts of the martial tradition.

rites.name: Causiares
rites.text: A combat discipline practiced by a sworn guardian who channels force through a ritual strike. It is a modified version of a older martial method used by a secret serpent-cult.

rites.name: Cilia
rites.text: A ritual strike performed under a bright lunar sky, drawn from the sacred disciplines of a hidden order. It belongs to a set of arts passed down by one of its adepts.

rites.name: Selum Raselia
rites.text: A lingering hex that temporarily shrinks how much vitality a bearer can hold. Some foes willingly bleed their own strength into it, trading their health to wound those they strike.

rites.name: Nianoles
rites.text: A battle discipline practiced by a sacred order of warriors. It is counted among the core combat arts taught to the order's most devoted members.

rites.name: Mirnia
rites.text: A heavy strike art that a wielder performs while wearing knuckle-claw gauntlets. It counts among the fighting techniques of one particular warrior.

rites.name: Nianes
rites.text: A guarding discipline practiced by commanders who shield their allies in battle. It belongs to the class of warden leaders who hold the front line.

rites.name: Vausaror
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a warrior whirls a long staff in tight circles before driving a sweeping blow to one side. Only one particular practitioner is able to perform it.

rites.name: Mernorum
rites.text: A guardian holds a fixed stance that turns away every blow aimed at the body. While it is held, the bearer cannot step or strike, and dodging is lost entirely.

rites.name: Mianaulium
rites.text: A battle discipline in which a fighter slips between positions, one of the serpent-cycle arts practiced by a hidden lineage of warriors.

rites.name: Oraunor
rites.text: A battle discipline in which a fighter drives a rhythmic pulse through the earth to unsettle foes. It belongs to the sword-wielding path and becomes available to practitioners once that path is unlocked.

rites.name: Seraullenia
rites.text: A specialized blade technique of the fourth tier, wielded by one bearer. It is used in combat and belongs to a wind-aligned fighting style.

rites.name: Marnaunia
rites.text: A battle discipline practiced by a single chosen wielder, adapted from an older combat form. It can only be taken up by the one who carries a particular inheritance.

rites.name: Seriantanum
rites.text: A sacred trial of the mind that a seeker undertakes at a teaching shrine. Through it, the seeker gains the ability to cross loose, crumbling slopes with ease.

rites.name: Valasor
rites.text: A soft, drifting art practiced by the rear guard of a temple order. It is one of several defensive disciplines used in the order's rituals.

rites.name: Telornium Molaunum
rites.text: A fiery blade technique wielded by a fighter in combat. It is a basic signature move that a warrior can unleash during special battle trials.

rites.name: Reonanum
rites.text: A violent kicking technique taught to fighters who bind their hands in clawed gauntlets. It is used by one fighter as one of their signature moves when armed this way.

rites.name: Vernia
rites.text: A combat discipline taught to fighters of the windborne orders, it is a rite of the circling light that a practitioner masters once their standing in the air-school reaches its highest grade.

rites.name: Sisteria
rites.text: A ritual art of linked chains, practiced by a single named user in a looping form. It is recorded as a technique that belongs to one practitioner.

rites.name: Niasia Cestasum
rites.text: A battle discipline that alters an established endurance technique, and it can be wielded by only one practitioner. It serves as a rare, personal variant of a common combat craft.

rites.name: Mornastor
rites.text: A battle technique belonging to the brute class of fighters, which becomes available to practitioners once they have unlocked that class. It is regarded as a core art of the discipline.

rites.name: Seraunium Oriallia
rites.text: A blade art that a wielder performs with knives. It is a variant of an older cutting technique and reuses that technique's energy.

rites.name: Lontisor
rites.text: A sparkling kind of song-craft practiced by wandering minstrels of one trained calling. It is counted among the gifts that belong to the bards' guild.

rites.name: Nistanum Nosernia
rites.text: A fire-wielding technique passed down to one chosen fighter after completing a demanding trial. It belongs to a pair of signature disciplines carried by a single practitioner.

rites.name: Miliarus
rites.text: A fire-based martial discipline practiced by warriors of a particular order. It is learned once a practitioner has been granted their calling and becomes a full mastery of the craft.

rites.name: Serillium Valernilus
rites.text: A sacred battle discipline taught by temple orders as one of the serpent-circle arts. It channels devotion into martial form.

rites.name: Teleorantus
rites.text: A dark circling technique practiced by a swordbearer who wields a pair of blades. It is one of the signature maneuvers used when fighting with twin weapons.

rites.name: Valum Neolanum
rites.text: A ritual fighting technique used only by two companions, which weakens the aim of those it strikes. It is performed as a kind of combined cooking duel.

rites.name: Telernor
rites.text: A resonant spirit-voice that awakens when an ally strikes a perfect, devastating blow. It answers the moment of a flawless hit with its own rising power.

rites.name: Mauseoria
rites.text: A minor ward that is shaped in a hollow form. Its making is taught at the gathering-grounds, where a healer-artisan lays it out and crafts it.

rites.name: Tiantaulum
rites.text: A battle discipline practiced by mind-binding fighters, learned by vanquishing a rare and cunning beast while its sorcerous guard is raised. It lets the wielder bend an opponent's spirit toward their own will.

rites.name: Oristollus
rites.text: A battle discipline practiced by soul-binders that bends another's inner will. It is gained by overcoming a rare, shadowy beast while a mind-piercing technique is active.

rites.name: Lianor
rites.text: A bearer's sacred ward that keeps nearby companions from faltering in resolve. It also surges one of the bearer's innate capacities, chosen at random, to a greatly heightened level.

rites.name: Tillia
rites.text: A combat technique practiced by mind-wielding adepts, learned by overcoming a rare fiend while the adept's inner-reading craft is active. It lets the user seize control of the spirit of an ally.

rites.name: Naulus Sereorontia
rites.text: A disciplined fighting technique practiced by warriors trained in a particular martial path. It becomes available for use once a student has achieved the required rank in that path.

rites.name: Taulenum
rites.text: A restraining hex that binds only mender-folk, leaving them unable to act for as long as it lingers upon them.

rites.name: Seroranum
rites.text: A martial discipline practiced by the Vanguard, one of the arts taught among the wider order of swordsmen and wardens. It is listed as a recognized form of combat training.

rites.name: Corasternus
rites.text: A ritual kick practiced by a warrior, performed as a serpentine spinning strike. The motion mimics a coiling reptile seeking prey.

rites.name: Maulor
rites.text: A quiet exchange of words takes place before a judging stone, where a companion speaks with her bonded driver. Witnessing it unlocks a lasting skill of ancient insight.

rites.name: Reontes
rites.text: A sealed field of aura that wards its bearer, shielding them so no blow or strike can ever reach their body.

rites.name: Valeornium Testor
rites.text: A healing craft in which a caster fires a shot that sprays a fine mist of spiritual essence, mending a little wounding for every ally nearby. A rarer variant of the same working is taught to a second practitioner under a longer name.

rites.name: Marium
rites.text: A restorative craft drawn through paired circles of light, channeled by a practitioner who wields two linked rings. It is one of the techniques that such a wielder can call upon.

rites.name: Telaria
rites.text: A sacred discipline that a wanderer can master by passing a proving rite. It is one of the two signature crafts of a particular practitioner.

rites.name: Amarium Vosanum
rites.text: A restorative discipline practiced by mind-binders, learned only after overcoming a rare guardian beast while a bound spirit is channeled through a willing companion. It mends the wounds of an ally.

rites.name: Testaurnor
rites.text: A frozen-edged blade technique wielded by a warrior of the wider world. It is a special strike of the lowest rank.

rites.name: Ventiania
rites.text: A sustained inner discipline that lets a practitioner's reserves never run dry. It is a talent art bound to a single wielder and passed down through their training.

rites.name: Sornialia
rites.text: A devoted healer's art in which the practitioner gives up part of their own vitality to mend a companion. The mended amount scales with the healer's full strength.

rites.name: Valenus Reonia
rites.text: A minor blade-technique relic kept by a warrior order. It is one of the special strikes that a tier-one weapon can perform.

rites.name: Seristum Cantus
rites.text: A bound fighting technique practiced by a single wielder who strikes with clawed gauntlets. It is one of that warrior's signature moves when fitted with such handgear.

rites.name: Reosantus
rites.text: A high-tier blade technique wielded by the warriors of the realm. It is a special strike of the most advanced rank, drawn from the arts of the blade-masters.

rites.name: Vantostum
rites.text: A sacred rite in which a supplicant is bound to an unbreakable memory of their former deeds. The bonded memory returns to them whenever they attempt to rise higher.

rites.name: Amiallus
rites.text: A combat discipline practiced by warriors of the winged order. The fighter leaps at a foe and strikes with a blazing spear thrust, though the strike also wounds the user.

rites.name: Oronelles
rites.text: A fighting discipline practiced by tacticians, using shifting, indistinct movements to confuse opponents in battle.

rites.name: Veosium Rauntium
rites.text: A combat discipline practiced by warriors of a certain order, drawing on the bearer's inner force. It belongs to a class of practitioners who carry banners of their calling.

rites.name: Niarnor Lasteontus
rites.text: A fighting technique performed by a wielder who strikes with clawed metal hand-gears. It is one of the signature maneuvers of a particular warrior who favors such weapons.

rites.name: Cirus
rites.text: A fighter hurls a blazing lance skyward, launching their body into the air before striking a foe with the weapon. The strike costs the user some of their own strength.

rites.name: Valirium
rites.text: A forceful striking technique that a single warrior alone can perform. It is a stronger version of a charging blow, and only one particular fighter has mastered it.

rites.name: Coreria Sintor
rites.text: A ritual craft in which a bearer draws a ring of restoring light around a small sphere, mending wounds and calming those who stand inside it. It can also be channeled through a companion creature in the same circle.

rites.name: Vaustium
rites.text: A short-blade technique where a wielder sweeps a dual blade upward to open a bleeding wound on a foe. Its harm grows with both the edge's keenness and the wielder's raw power.

rites.name: Valeorus
rites.text: A swift ritual technique that a wielder performs during a combined assault. It belongs to one practitioner and is used only when a chained strike is unleashed.

rites.name: Resaunor
rites.text: A martial technique practiced by champions of a warrior order. Once a fighter masters the discipline, they can use this technique as a core combat skill.

rites.name: Nallanum
rites.text: A battle art of the mystic caste that clears most hindering effects from nearby companions. In return, it swells their striking strength.

rites.name: Saurnus
rites.text: A fighter's technique in which a clenched strike is thrust forward with explosive speed. It is one of the strikes a particular warrior performs while wearing spiked hand-blades.

rites.name: Nirestor
rites.text: A ranged technique in which a bowman nocks a shaft and circles the field, searching for a mark before releasing the string. Only one particular archer is able to perform it.

rites.name: Lentor
rites.text: A shimmering craft that wraps its wielder and nearby companions in a protective veil, letting them withstand crackling storm energy more easily.

rites.name: Ceolium
rites.text: A discipline of wielding a curved blade that lets its user cut through beams of radiance. It is one of the arts practiced by a single particular swordbearer.

rites.name: Cellostia
rites.text: A combat discipline practiced by a legendary champion of the realm. It is counted among the signature techniques that champion uses in battle.

rites.name: Tarus Teornorum
rites.text: A patient hidden fighting technique used by practitioners of the sacred serpent-circle arts. It belongs to one of the circle's core disciplines.

rites.name: Amellornium
rites.text: A gentle sacred technique that restores a little vitality to the caster or to one ally currently standing with them in the fight.

rites.name: Sirnus Selium
rites.text: A sacred resonance that swells a bearer's inner reserve of charged vigor, raising the ceiling of how much they can hold. Its gain is fixed, granted to one companion at a time.

rites.name: Millium Corarnillia
rites.text: A coiled, spinning technique that a wielder performs as a signature art. It is recognized as the talent of a particular bearer of a serpent-circle emblem.

rites.name: Telalum
rites.text: A mental strike that only a bearer in their heightened burst state can unleash across a wide arc before them. It scatters the foes it hits, stripping away the lingering enchantments that cling to them.

rites.name: Valaustia
rites.text: A bulwark-craft channeled through paired curved blades, granting its wielder greatly enlarged strength. It belongs to one practitioner's repertoire of arts.

rites.name: Laularum
rites.text: A ground-bound enchantment that heightens the chance of a close-combat spirit call taking hold. It raises that chance by a measured margin.

rites.name: Serones
rites.text: A fighting technique that lets a warrior's blade attacks sometimes set a foe ablaze with lingering fire. It works only while striking with hand-held weapons in close combat.

rites.name: Calum Rollestes
rites.text: A fighting technique practiced by spirit-binding warriors, passed on after a restless phantom is overcome while the warrior's inner-soul ritual is active. It strikes with a fist guided by captured spirit.

rites.name: Rastium
rites.text: A quiet exchange of confessions between two rival guardians beside a crumbled tower. Witnessing it grants a sharpened gift of foreseeing an opponent's next move.

rites.name: Coresornus
rites.text: A ward-stone craft that hardens the body against sudden numbing and seizing. Those who carry it can keep their limbs moving when a cold binding would otherwise freeze them.

rites.name: Ceosium Amanausium
rites.text: A battle art that binds a foe to the ground in a faint, borrowed darkness. Only one particular kind of fighter can wield it, and it is a modified form of an older grounding technique.

rites.name: Teranum
rites.text: A combat technique in which a wielder turns a heavy hammer over and drives its striking head down into the ground. It is performed with a shield-hammer weapon.

rites.name: Serostum
rites.text: A forceful technique practiced by one of the practitioner's trained arts. It is described as a single named form within a larger discipline of combat skills.

rites.name: Cianteria
rites.text: A fist-art that channels falling stone into a single crushing blow. It is practiced by a wielder who fights with rock-forged gauntlets.

rites.name: Valornes Misaunia
rites.text: A ritual combat technique practiced by one chosen fighter who rises through a rapid sequence of diagonal upward cuts. The sequence ends with a sharp double slash aimed toward the upper left.

rites.name: Lenum Nanus
rites.text: A deadly tempest-technique wielded by a single fighter in a hall of combat. It is also that fighter's signature maneuver during hired raid assignments.

rites.name: Tirnum
rites.text: A brutal combat technique practiced by one of the martial disciplines of a warrior order, performed as a swift, heavy blow. It counts among the signature battle arts of its tradition.

rites.name: Vonisum
rites.text: A chained arts-style assault that a pair of partners unleash together during a joint attack. It is the shared technique one duo uses when they strike as a combined pair.

rites.name: Valiania
rites.text: A battle art practiced by mind-binders who gather restless spirit-force into a swirling burst. It is learned only after overcoming a rare guardian while the binder's mental link is kept active.

rites.name: Orantum
rites.text: A disciplined sword technique used by a wielder who holds two blades at once. It is counted among the fighting arts that one particular warrior has mastered.

rites.name: Vaunia Nesium
rites.text: A dormant skill taught to a wielder of a curved blade, drawn from the stillness before dawn. It belongs to one of the wielder's own disciplines.

rites.name: Mistium Canes
rites.text: A quiet heartfelt conversation between two companions that happens at a cliffside lookout after a rest at a roadside lodge. Sharing it grants one of them a new ability for working in harmony with others.

rites.name: Soriallium
rites.text: A disciplined combat art practiced by warriors of a shadow-striking order. The practitioner holds a blade in a poised stance, which sharpens their aim for decisive, lethal blows.

rites.name: Neornium
rites.text: A close-quarters rising strike practiced by wielders of paired curved blades. It belongs to the arts of a single master who favors twin sickle weapons.

rites.name: Resia Leorialor
rites.text: A combat discipline taught to a warden order of protectors. The practitioner raises a blade to dare foes into striking first, drawing their aggression onto the practitioner.

rites.name: Tantia
rites.text: A dance-like fighting technique performed with blades under moonlight. It reuses a swift spinning strike that its practitioner can unleash again.

rites.name: Valeosum Nisium
rites.text: A combat discipline practiced by field healers who have mastered their order's rites. It becomes available for use once a healer has earned the right to that path.

rites.name: Rintor Coralum
rites.text: A battle technique performed by a single fighter who spins through the air while slicing apart foes. It belongs only to one practitioner and has no counterpart among her rival kin.

rites.name: Tirus
rites.text: A combat discipline where the wielder wears down an opponent's stamina with a weakening strike. The blow lands harder when the wielder is still strong and healthy.

rites.name: Vanor Meoria
rites.text: A fighting discipline in which a practitioner strikes with a fist, sweeps with a leg, then flings a bundle of barbed briars to slice through foes.

rites.name: Seriantium Serironus
rites.text: A bristling inner aura that softens incoming blows while dulling the wielder's own strikes. Over time it swells a hidden reserve and answers each hit with a retaliatory burst scaled to spiritual essence.

rites.name: Veniastus
rites.text: A disciplined combat art in which a practitioner sweeps a long staff through a rhythmic dance that cleanses lingering hindrances. It is a refined branch of an older current-riding technique, reserved for one kind of practitioner.

rites.name: Laurinor Tiantenus
rites.text: A drawn-down craft that siphons a foe's might into its practitioner. Each extra foe struck feeds the practitioner a greater surge of strength.

rites.name: Orinium Miania
rites.text: A combat discipline practiced by one class of ranged healer-gunners. It is one of the martial arts taught within that class.

rites.name: Vaustanum Valintium
rites.text: A tuned resonance that a bowstring-like craft can gather to make its ranged pulls strike more often. The strengthening grows with each stage of refinement, raising the odds of a drawn shot awakening its voice.

rites.name: Lostirium
rites.text: A fiery knife-wielding craft that spins a blazing ring of attacks. It is one of the arts practiced by a blade-bearing fighter, and it reuses an earlier whirling technique.

rites.name: Vaunelles
rites.text: A temple-taught blessing that strengthens the bodily combat disciplines of a practitioner. It makes every strike taught through these disciplines hit harder.

rites.name: Corosiantia
rites.text: A forceful arc of strength drawn across the ground by a wielder of a great two-handed axe. It is one of the battle techniques that such a warrior can call upon.

rites.name: Tirnaullium
rites.text: A fierce, elemental combat technique wielded with a blade, unleashed as a powerful special strike. It is the first and most basic level of the art.

rites.name: Volor Oreosarum
rites.text: A bright aura a warrior can call forth to strengthen nearby allies and clear their clouded minds. It also draws the hostile gaze of enemies close by.

rites.name: Nestanum Tiseolia
rites.text: A binding of the arcane that wraps a sustained aura around the summoned spirits of one caster, doubling how far their empowering reach extends.

rites.name: Seriantor Ameosor
rites.text: A battle discipline in which a practitioner shapes light into a circling band that is wielded in combat. It is counted among the signature arts of one particular serpent-bound adept.

rites.name: Tistialia
rites.text: A lasting blessing that slowly mends the wounds of a bearer at steady intervals. How much is restored and how long it lasts depend on where the blessing came from.

rites.name: Restes
rites.text: A support craft that raises a glassy barrier around its user, turning aside most blows and hexes for a short span. Only the strikes of innate gifts can pass through it.

rites.name: Lirontus
rites.text: A fiery blade technique that a warrior unleashes at a specific level of mastery. It belongs to a single fighter's repertoire and is performed with a sword.

rites.name: Lastes Nellia
rites.text: A tactic used by brutish heavy fighters to strike with overwhelming force. It inflicts heavy harm and is an early way to send a foe flying into the air.

rites.name: Soranum Serelus
rites.text: A striking technique in which a wielder of twin blades unleashes a fierce cat-like strike. It is one of the signature arts of a swordswoman who fights with paired blades.

rites.name: Ameoses Cianaulus
rites.text: A practiced stillness that lets a wary fighter drop to the ground and seem fallen, drawing all attention away. After a brief pause the fighter rises restored, and the next strike lands harder.

rites.name: Sausium
rites.text: A sturdy warrior's blow that deals far greater harm when it lands on an opponent's back. The force of the strike is drawn from the blade's edge combined with the wielder's raw muscle.

rites.name: Amosus
rites.text: A fighter's technique that channels force from a falling blow, used with a small sphere-shaped weapon. It is also one of the same fighter's techniques when wielding a particular companion creature.

rites.name: Telareornus
rites.text: A swift battle discipline practiced by warriors of a mechanized order. It is granted to those who reach the highest tier of their training path.

rites.name: Valornes Vianaulium
rites.text: A masterful striking technique practiced by fighters who wield clawed hand-gear. It is one of the signature arts of a particular warrior who favors such weapons.

rites.name: Rolus Seraurnes
rites.text: A swift spinning craft practiced by a user who wields paired circular rings. It is one of the techniques of its master when working with that twin pair.

rites.name: Teontium Rilastium
rites.text: A calm inner discipline that a single warrior draws upon to sharpen their aim and slip past incoming blows. The discipline grows stronger when the wielder is nearly worn down.

rites.name: Vistianus
rites.text: A rolling technique that sometimes knocks a foe off balance and topples them, but only against opponents not far above the practitioner's rank. When the tumble misses, it binds the target in place instead.

rites.name: Lasentor
rites.text: A defensive discipline of braced guards that raises a protective ward around its practitioner and nearby companions. The ward holds back incoming harm for those who stand within it.

rites.name: Neollinus
rites.text: A second hidden craft of rapid movement that is learned after completing a deceptive trial. It stands as one of two signature disciplines of its practitioner.

rites.name: Rialosia
rites.text: A ringed martial art taught in the temple halls of the mountain orders. It trains practitioners to turn their strikes in curved arcs.

rites.name: Tistaulles
rites.text: A bladed windstorm technique practiced by a single warrior. The warrior leaps high, strikes a pose, and scatters cutting gusts around the battlefield while restoring the strength of allies nearby.

rites.name: Tauntia Mollenanum
rites.text: A martial discipline practiced by standard-bearers, unlocked once a bearer reaches the highest tier of their order. It channels the banner's presence into the ranks of allied fighters.

rites.name: Caureolus
rites.text: A heavy two-handed art wielded through a great axe that its user draws upon to strike and fracture hard stone. It is one of the techniques practiced by a single warrior named Brenka.

rites.name: Leores Vesanum
rites.text: A disciplined fighting technique practiced by a guild of stone-cutting warriors. It becomes available for mastery once a practitioner has been admitted to that guild.

rites.name: Mosium
rites.text: A ceremonial technique that a warrior performs while wielding a curved sword. It is one of the signature movements belonging to a single named fighter.

rites.name: Coreonus Telialasus
rites.text: A wielder leaps skyward and sweeps a heavy cleaving blade downward in a rising strike. It is one of the techniques practiced with a two-handed great axe.

rites.name: Seraurnus Seontanum
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a wielder of a great two-handed axe unleashes a heavy, brutal assault. It is one of the signature arts of a particular axe-wielding warrior.

rites.name: Varanum
rites.text: A devoted healer raises a ring of soothing light across the ground, mending companions who stand within it. The glow restores a steady share of the caster's restorative strength every few beats.

rites.name: Corisium Coriastesia
rites.text: A combat discipline practiced by mind-binders, learned by overcoming a reckless beast while a bound spirit is active. It lets a fighter strike with the force of a charging, armored creature.

rites.name: Corernus Telilaurus
rites.text: A combat technique wielded by a bearer of a heavy guard-and-strike tool. It is one of the fighting arts performed by a single specific practitioner whenever that weapon is in hand.

rites.name: Sostanum Corauntia
rites.text: A hushed battle discipline in which a fighter's blade draws enemies into an unnatural drowsiness. Those struck slowly lose their will to stay awake.

rites.name: Seronintes
rites.text: A wielder's bladed technique drawn from a curved war-blade shaped like a crescent. It is one of the strikes a champion can call upon when holding that particular weapon.

rites.name: Telianteria
rites.text: A chained assault in which an attacker's combined strike is joined into a single synchronized blow. It is the chosen technique of a particular warrior during a linked attack.

rites.name: Tiasium
rites.text: A bearer's inner wrath flares into a sustained aura that reflects harm back at an attacker. Each blow that lands is answered with a multiplied return, while the bearer itself takes the same hurt as before.

rites.name: Rausia Reostonus
rites.text: A fighting discipline in which a single warrior of one particular lineage unleashes a surging strike, a sharpened form of a broader wave technique, and no one else may learn it.

rites.name: Sonilus
rites.text: A bright, sudden technique that a wielder of paired circlets can unleash. It is counted among one particular bearer's signature arts.

rites.name: Teliaria
rites.text: A dark binding craft that a practitioner uses to hold foes encircled in place. It is one of the sorcerous arts known to the orders of its keeper.

rites.name: Maurnor Riasirnium
rites.text: A ward-craft that wraps one companion in a temporary guard, blocking harm until its time runs out or it has soaked up a set measure of damage. A matching ward is also used by another practitioner.

rites.name: Mauleostes
rites.text: A trained duelist's technique in which the wielder leaps at an opponent and delivers a forceful spinning blade stroke. It belongs to the practice of swift light-blade fighters.

rites.name: Maurnianus
rites.text: A physical technique that strikes harder the more hindrances afflict the opponent, then strips those hindrances away. Each affliction doubles the force of the blow.

rites.name: Orillanum Rauriantia
rites.text: A battle discipline in which a fighter steels the mind before combat, mirroring a resolve once used by a secret circle of sworn warriors. It is one of the trained arts of a pair of heroes.

rites.name: Lilor Valornanum
rites.text: A swordsman's technique in which the wielder leaps upward and delivers a swift rising slash. It is practiced by a certain class of agile blade-dancers.

rites.name: Valanus Mianaulus
rites.text: A bodily technique in which a defender slams a guarding plate into a fallen foe, leaving the stunned target reeling. A second practitioner carries a matching variant of the same maneuver.

rites.name: Seraulus
rites.text: A battle discipline practiced by champions of a particular fighting class. It is a technique of combat rather than a weapon or a person.

rites.name: Naniaror
rites.text: A ritual performance art practiced by wandering minstrels that gathers dark figures into a procession. It is used by bards who fight through song and motion.

rites.name: Oraniares
rites.text: A binding hex that locks guardians in place, leaving them unable to act while it holds. It only takes hold of those who stand as protectors.

rites.name: Liastum Valenases
rites.text: A rear-guard fighting art that lunges forth from the shadows. It is practiced as one of the defensive techniques of a warrior's second line.

rites.name: Orileorus
rites.text: A defensive battle discipline practiced by mind-binders, learned only after overcoming a heavily armored beast. It lets a fighter harden their outer shell against incoming blows.

rites.name: Amaullium Sontinor
rites.text: A disciplined sword technique practiced by a warrior wielding a single crystal-bladed blade. It is one of the fighter's signature strikes when drawing that particular weapon.

rites.name: Oriasium Ameres
rites.text: A stealth technique that triples the force of a strike delivered from behind an opponent. It is one of the physical arts practiced by its wielders.

rites.name: Sintus Sorantum
rites.text: A stealthy technique taught to fighters who wield clawed hand weapons. It lets the user strike an unsuspecting foe from concealment with a quick, surprising blow.

rites.name: Lelium Veonorium
rites.text: A radiant performance craft practiced by a specialized class of champions. It channels glowing harmony into a skilled art form.

rites.name: Vores Molliania
rites.text: A coiling dark technique practiced by fighters who wield a pair of blades together. It is one of the signature maneuvers of a swordsman who fights with two weapons at once.

rites.name: Rantanum Vallistanum
rites.text: A radiant battle discipline that a warrior of the sealed order draws upon as one of the serpent-loop techniques of their line.

rites.name: Seriles Lorilum
rites.text: A whirling technique performed with a pair of linked rings, practiced by a single user to cut through an opponent's defenses. It belongs to one wielder's repertoire and is used only in combination with those rings.

rites.name: Valarniares
rites.text: A practiced technique of blade-craft that lets a wielder steady their body and recover from strain. It is passed to a student only after they have proven their resolve through a trial.

rites.name: Mauror
rites.text: A steady rotating technique practiced by a guardian who wields a spiral-bored shield. It is one of the fighting arts of its wielder and belongs to the shield's combat style.

rites.name: Melus Orostanum
rites.text: A fighting technique that a warrior performs with a paired blade-and-club weapon. It reuses an earlier strike, turning a quick punch into a repeated assault.

rites.name: Serallium Talor
rites.text: A fighter spins around and drives a heavy stomp into the ground. The blow weakens the foe's offense and hits mechanical foes especially hard.

rites.name: Roseornes
rites.text: A combat technique practiced by those who bend the spirit's inner pattern. It is learned only after overcoming a rare, shapeless beast while the spirit-binding ritual is active on a companion.

rites.name: Coriarnum Cernistia
rites.text: A sudden technique practiced by a wielder of a long-barreled siege engine. It is one of the hidden arts a gunner draws upon when firing the heavy weapon.

rites.name: Vastanum Valintium
rites.text: A ritual technique that a wielder of the sacred fans performs to feed a sustained flame. It reuses a prior burst of energy so the flame keeps burning.

rites.name: Serianus Reostanum
rites.text: A battle discipline practiced by standard-bearers, letting them drive forward into combat with heightened momentum. It belongs to the bearer's trained repertoire of martial arts.

rites.name: Toreolia
rites.text: A rear-guard fighting discipline practiced by defenders who hold the line behind the front ranks. It is taught among the older martial orders.

rites.name: Teolus Ceostor
rites.text: A battle art belonging to a hero who keeps a number of such arts. It is one of the hero's own techniques for fighting.

rites.name: Niastanum Telanesum
rites.text: A battle discipline practiced by heavy guardians who plant their feet and brace for impact. It becomes a master-level technique once a guardian reaches the highest tier of their training.

rites.name: Siarum Laulus
rites.text: A battle technique that splits the air above a fighter in a sweeping slash. It is one of the rear-guard arts a warrior can call upon in combat.

rites.name: Neolium Lintes
rites.text: A fighting technique where a warrior leaps and spins through a rolling strike, then follows with a sideways cut using a blade that changes form. It is one of the practiced combat arts of a wielder of such a blade.

rites.name: Venares
rites.text: A combat discipline in which a wielder cuts through open air with a rising arc of force. It is one of the techniques taught to a traveling companion who joins a party only for a short while.

rites.name: Orontes Coreria
rites.text: A battle discipline taught to one craft-guild of blade-forgers. It marks a foe so that harm dealt to the marked one spreads to other enemies standing close by.

rites.name: Niallasus
rites.text: A disciplined fighting technique practiced by a wielder of a curved blade, one of a single warrior's signature forms of combat. It is taught as a discipline of the sword.

rites.name: Venaurnor
rites.text: A ritual sword-dance performed by one wielder alone. It opens with a falling cut, followed by two hopping spinning strikes, a rising stroke, and a final sweeping blow.

rites.name: Valeror Amirnes
rites.text: A kind of combat enhancement that a fighter can adopt during a battle. It shapes how the bearer meets an enemy in the fray.

rites.name: Sirnolor
rites.text: A ritual technique of focused spite that a mind-binder learns by overcoming a swarming wasp-beast while its inner-mind craft is active. It lets the caster hurl a concentrated jet of venom or scorn at a foe.

rites.name: Viastanus
rites.text: A combat discipline practiced by a mind-bending order of fighters. Students learn it by overcoming a rare, cunning foe while their guiding mental skill is active.

rites.name: Telentosum
rites.text: A battle technique that a traveling fighter can use while temporarily joining a group. It is taught in an early stage of the story and tested again during a special combat trial.

rites.name: Vaurnirium
rites.text: A restorative technique practiced by a wielder of twin blades, drawing on the calm of fading light to close wounds. It is one of the arts that a single sword-bearer commands.

rites.name: Corostes Valirornia
rites.text: A ritual craft of combat in which a practitioner calls forth a bound elemental force to fight alongside them. It is mastered by those who have attained the highest summoning vocation.

rites.name: Telonum Rellanum
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a wielder steps back and sets their spear aflame before hurling it at a foe, harming themselves in the process. Only one specific warrior is able to perform this maneuver.

rites.name: Maustium Varor
rites.text: A rising striking art that a combatant performs while wielding a long lance-type weapon. It is one of the techniques practiced by a skilled wielder of that heavy polearm.

rites.name: Sianternor
rites.text: A combat technique used by a warrior-scholar of the mountain hall, performed as a swift rhythmic strike. It is a variant of a related three-cut form taught to novices.

rites.name: Seraurium Ceolantum
rites.text: A ritual call that raises the caster's and nearby allies' mystic reserves for each charged spark held. Releasing the stored spark strikes one foe with a crushing blast of lightning.

rites.name: Amintornia
rites.text: A gentle tempest-craft wielded only by one chosen practitioner, a softened variant of a stronger rain-art that carries a calmer, sweeter current.

rites.name: Causternium
rites.text: A combat discipline practiced only by one particular lineage of warriors. It is a battle art, and no one outside that bloodline may learn it.

rites.name: Orarus
rites.text: A deceptive art in which a practitioner weakens a foe's guard against lingering hexes. It lowers the target's ability to shrug off such afflictions.

rites.name: Nirum
rites.text: A ritual art from the Vanguard tradition that hurls flying snow outward. It is one of the vanguard arts of a certain people.

rites.name: Lastausum
rites.text: A fighting art practiced by a warrior, which tears a charm of protection from a foe after a slash. The strike also restores a portion of the group's shared energy.

rites.name: Lasor Rallaustus
rites.text: A high-level martial technique practiced by a skilled swordsman once their standing reaches a tenth tier. It is granted as a mastery reward to those who train a particular fighting discipline.

rites.name: Sereores
rites.text: A martial technique in which a fighter with a long shaft strikes an opponent, forcing them backward and leaving them sluggish for a short while.

rites.name: Rernalles
rites.text: A crossing blow of the clawed hand that tears through the sky of a fighter's craft. It belongs to one wielder's set of techniques made for hand-worn gauntlets.

rites.name: Tistaria
rites.text: A forceful blow performed by a wielder of a heavy two-handed axe. It is one of the signature techniques used by a particular fighter who favors that weapon.

rites.name: Valintum Telonaurnes
rites.text: A ward-craft woven into worn plate that answers a provocation by raising a protective shield. The shield forms only some of the time, when the wearer is goaded by a rival's challenge.

rites.name: Valeontus Telesilanum
rites.text: A disciplined combat technique taught to the mage-warriors of a sacred order. A practitioner who has mastered the wider craft unlocks it, readying a staff and driving it forward in a single piercing strike.

rites.name: Teliasirus
rites.text: A battle technique practiced by a specialized fighter order, gained by overcoming a rare, mocking beast while a mind-breaking skill is active. It lashes out with a sweeping blow.

rites.name: Telanolium
rites.text: A calling practiced by healers of a temple-keeping people, who study battle formations and guide their allies from behind the lines. Its practitioners tend the wounded while shaping the course of a fight.

rites.name: Ameostium Senium
rites.text: A combat discipline known only to the Tridane people, practiced by one martial lineage. It is a battle technique that lets its user sharply amplify their strength in the heat of a fight.

rites.name: Meriasia
rites.text: A combat discipline practiced by warriors of a champion lineage. It is mastered only after a practitioner reaches the tenth tier of their training.

rites.name: Telianus Amoles
rites.text: A fighting discipline that channels force through the hands in a way that makes the strikes feel enormous. It belongs to a sequence of arts tied to a single lineage of masters.

rites.name: Amostaror
rites.text: A battle art practiced by one of the killing-machine assassin orders. It is a technique of fearsome assault used by those who serve as its arts.

rites.name: Cillernus
rites.text: A bonded art that a sworn wielder calls upon during a joined assault. It belongs to a single mentor and grants unbreakable resolve in combat.

rites.name: Nelus Vastor
rites.text: A ritual craft of looping, flickering motion used by one wielder of paired blades. It can be learned only after a full completion of a journey and a later revision of its rules.

rites.name: Rilanum Larnenum
rites.text: A fighting technique practiced by a single wielder who grips a curved blade. It is one of the arts that wielder uses when handling that sword.

rites.name: Meoneria
rites.text: A spinning martial technique used by a wielder of blades, reshaping a repeated slicing motion into a fierce whirling strike. It draws on an older circular maneuver and channels it through twin edged weapons.

rites.name: Contor
rites.text: A discipline of the temple orders, practiced by a lost band of vanguard fighters, that channels a sharp inner force into their craft. It belongs to the Vanguard ranks alone.

rites.name: Valentia Coresanum
rites.text: A disciplined craft of sweeping water-force used by strategists of the Tactician order. It is a technique practiced as a signature art of that class.

rites.name: Maunosor
rites.text: A ritual technique that lets a fighter strike with greater force when landing a decisive blow. It is one of many supporting disciplines practiced among warriors.

rites.name: Ralanum Volianor
rites.text: A devastating storm-strike technique wielded by a single warrior when channeling a great blade's power. It hits many foes at once and can knock the target flat.

rites.name: Amalus Amentor
rites.text: A temporary linking craft practiced by mind-binders, learned only after overcoming a towering guardian spirit while a binding ritual is active. It lets a practitioner's will briefly fasten to an ally's soul.

rites.name: Mollia
rites.text: A whirling blade-dance used by a knife-wielder, in which a spinning strike is repeated again and again. It draws on an older spinning technique the fighter already knows.

rites.name: Rinteornum
rites.text: A paired ritual technique belonging to a practitioner who wields two linked rings. It forms part of that wielder's repertoire of arts when the rings are used together.

rites.name: Sostialia
rites.text: A battle technique practiced by soul-binding adepts, unlocked by vanquishing a rare sea-spirit while a binding ritual is active. It channels pressurized currents into a focused strike.

rites.name: Vellonium
rites.text: A ritual technique of an order of sorcerers that channels molten earth-fire into a single devastating blast. It is one of the serpent-ring arts wielded by the ring's master.

rites.name: Velornum
rites.text: A spinning martial technique unique to one wielder, who whirls a twin-edged blade overhead before executing a forceful downward cut. No other practitioner in the realm can perform it.

rites.name: Cellia Tisor
rites.text: A fighting technique practiced by mystic wielders of a sacred order. The user spins a long staff twice, striking sharply to one side.

rites.name: Sanosia
rites.text: A special blade technique that a warrior of a sacred order can call upon in combat, drawing on a sprite-like flame. It belongs to a lower-tier tier of mastery.

rites.name: Corastanum Valaraustum
rites.text: A disciplined striking art that a wielder performs with a heavy shield-hammer. It knocks the foe off balance and sends them tumbling.

rites.name: Mesolia
rites.text: A bracing chant that mends every companion standing ahead in a forward arc, the healer included. Its restoring force grows stronger the more burdens weigh upon the allies being mended.

rites.name: Cases Celisanum
rites.text: A fierce martial technique wielded with paired curved blades by a skilled fighter. It is adapted from an older swift strike style practiced by a rival tradition.

rites.name: Amistum Mireontia
rites.text: A spinning knife technique practiced by bladed warriors. It is one of the signature moves of a knife-wielder and reuses an earlier cutting method.

rites.name: Narnium
rites.text: A combat discipline practiced by wandering bards that strikes foes with a sudden burst of force. It becomes a fully mastered technique once a bard has earned the right to use it.

rites.name: Neornium Seronum
rites.text: A talent art that a bearer of the serpent-circle lineage can wield. It is a technique of the arts-craft tradition, rooted in the lore of endless cycles.

rites.name: Seostellor
rites.text: A gentle breeze-craft that knits wounds closed. It is one of the disciplined arts practised by the vanguard of a northern order.

rites.name: Oralanum Liriasor
rites.text: A timber-felling discipline that is performed with a specific engine of channeled force. It is counted among the practices a certain practitioner can wield when operating that engine.

rites.name: Lariania
rites.text: A calm combat discipline taught to healers of the sage orders. When a practitioner invokes it, a soothing field forms that gently mends companions who stand within its reach.

rites.name: Orariastium
rites.text: A disciplined technique of the arts that weakens a foe's bodily guard by a fifth. When it follows a prior swift strike and every blow lands, it also dulls the enemy's striking force.

rites.name: Vosteollia
rites.text: A learned discipline of enduring harsh wilderness conditions, practiced by those who travel alone through dangerous land. It is one of the skills a traveler may train.

rites.name: Cauneosanum
rites.text: A driving discipline that lets a rider keep steady and unbroken under heavy strain. It is one of the skills a pilot can learn to shape how their mount handles.

rites.name: Ternium Noleosia
rites.text: A devotional craft that channels the brightness of the daytime sky into the bearer's spirit. While the sun is up, every foe defeated yields a fuller reward of inner strength.

rites.name: Oriallanum Rollirnes
rites.text: A disciplined bodily craft that steadily strengthens a fighter's endurance. It is trained as one of the skills a driver can awaken, granting a lasting boost to their power.

rites.name: Cialles Renteosia
rites.text: A ritual technique offered within a trial of the highest sage's proving-glove, through which a practitioner pulls vitality back from a struck foe.

rites.name: Vaurus Miastauria
rites.text: A discipline of the inner eye that lets a practitioner gain experience whenever a sign of coming ruin is shattered. It is the first lesson in the courage-path of its school.

rites.name: Sarnor Sires
rites.text: A cursed rite offered within a sage's trial grounds that heightens the harm a bearer deals, at the cost of a grim bargain.

rites.name: Cauntus Caneolanum
rites.text: A protective practice that a driver in a racing setting can invoke to shield themselves, drawing on the bond with forebears. It belongs to the set of skills available to drivers.

rites.name: Carnostus
rites.text: A learned discipline in which a practitioner lets go of restraint at the height of mastery. It belongs to the arts of a hidden realm of gold-lit lands.

rites.name: Siria Varor
rites.text: A disciplined method of drawing and releasing air in measured rhythms, practiced by those who must keep their nerve steady in demanding moments. It is counted among the core trained arts that shape a practitioner's composure.

rites.name: Ceonus Laurneosus
rites.text: A practiced technique belonging to the drivers of a sky-realm, a skill that a rider can call upon during their travels. Its use is recorded as one of the discipline's known arts.

rites.name: Siarium Miaseontium
rites.text: A trained craft that lets a driver draw on the closeness between allies. It is one of the skills a driver can learn for use on the road.

rites.name: Menallus
rites.text: A reflex of the hardened warrior that lets him answer a blow with a strike of his own. It belongs to the second rung of his path of ardor and sharpens his chance to return each attack.

rites.name: Ceornallum
rites.text: A practitioner releases a single crackling bolt of stored storm power that strikes with heavy force. The bolt is known in its own right, though its full description stays hidden from those who use it.

rites.name: Menteoria
rites.text: A bodily craft that stokes an inner fire, granting a bonus to tension each time the practitioner suffers injury. Its power fades after one blow lands.

rites.name: Rasilia
rites.text: A bearer's gift that strengthens their skill at mending wounds and restoring health. It applies only to that bearer's own healing craft and leaves restoration from other sources untouched.

rites.name: Amillauntus
rites.text: A driver's craft in which a trusted companion is willingly shielded and supported by the one who is skilled at guiding others. It is a practice tied to the bond between allies.

rites.name: Amolanum Vantaunum
rites.text: A bold provocation practiced by brave wardens to draw the wrathful attention of foes toward themselves. It is taught as the second lesson in a school of fervor.

rites.name: Seraulloria
rites.text: A shared discipline that lets a fighter draw strength from comrades in battle. It is one of the trained skills used by drivers.

rites.name: Oriantus Naurnium
rites.text: A fiery corona that a warrior can summon around themselves, granting a surge of strength whenever they call on a hidden store of inner power. It is taught as the fifth technique in a discipline of zeal.

rites.name: Talises
rites.text: A learned discipline that lets a wanderer press harder for a short span when facing a foe far above their own standing. It draws on steadfast practice within a path of patient training.

rites.name: Viantus Nillanum
rites.text: A first-learned discipline of eager momentum that gives a warrior a chance to surge forward with added speed for a short span when a clash begins.

rites.name: Laustus Vialeorum
rites.text: A learned knack of the body that lets a wielder act at a speed beyond ordinary sight. It belongs to the drivers' repertoire of practiced skills.

rites.name: Siarolum
rites.text: A practiced technique that lets a wielder strike harder against foes who lie in slumber. It is taught as the second step of a passion-focused discipline.

rites.name: Telorniles
rites.text: A fighter's second training art that sharpens a warrior's strikes in return. When wounded to half strength, the warrior answers blows more often with her own counterstrikes.

rites.name: Amostium Lirnanum
rites.text: A driving discipline in which a rider trusts raw physical force above careful thought. It is one of the techniques a charioteer may learn to guide their mount.

rites.name: Neosum Valisiantum
rites.text: A fifth discipline in a fledgling wardcraft line that sharpens the chance of finding hoarded treasure chests from foes who carry them. It only helps when the foe is capable of holding such a chest.

rites.name: Miastium
rites.text: A third-tier driving technique that a pilot can unlock to sharpen a bond with a mount. It belongs to a set of skills that shape how the pilot and the machine work together.

rites.name: Tianilium
rites.text: A driver's discipline that lets a practitioner ride the crest of a rising force. It is one of the recognized skills taught among those who command such powers.

rites.name: Corirnus
rites.text: A skill that can be found on blades of many ranks. Plain blades that carry the flame essence always hold this knack.

rites.name: Coreosernia
rites.text: A protective craft that fighters with shared bonds use in combat to raise a defensive ward. It guards the wielder against incoming blows during battle.

rites.name: Valentus Aminum
rites.text: A fighting technique practiced by ordinary warriors that channels a flowing, watery force through their blade strikes. It is commonly used by rank-and-file fighters in the field.

rites.name: Losium
rites.text: A driver skill that a fighter can call upon while steering a machine in the midst of combat. It is one of several skills tied to the steering of vehicles.

rites.name: Amillarnus
rites.text: A sustaining power bound to a summoner's office that can be raised but never fully mastered by its wielder.

rites.name: Telestanum Listum
rites.text: A lasting kinship skill that a driver can draw upon. It is one of the learned abilities a driver may practice in the wider order of skills.

rites.name: Taria Mollus
rites.text: A rallying technique that fills every ally with a surge of readiness after a strong opening clash. It is the first lesson in a school of instinct and foresight.

rites.name: Nintauror
rites.text: A learned technique in which a driver's hands grow firm and powerful, granting extra strength when handling and steering. It is one of the skills drivers can cultivate.

rites.name: Velasium
rites.text: A disciplined combat art practiced by the warriors of one of the world's battle skill traditions. It is counted among the tested skills a fighter learns to draw upon in battle.

rites.name: Corausum Telarnium
rites.text: A learned movement craft that grants its practitioners exceptional speed on foot. It is restricted to a single unnamed group of people.

rites.name: Amirestium
rites.text: A disciplined training craft that hardens the flesh of its practitioner, granting a small gain in vitality. It belongs to the first rank of a bearer's path of steady effort.

rites.name: Oranium Causanum
rites.text: A disciplined readiness technique that a warrior invokes as a fight begins, giving a likely boost to strength for a short span of time.

rites.name: Teonia Miales
rites.text: A basic fighting technique practiced by the lesser-ranked female axe wielders of the warrior guild. It is learned early and refined through regular drills.

rites.name: Niarnes Corintor
rites.text: A bodily discipline that hardens the practitioner's frame, granting fifteen percent resistance against blows and physical harm. It is the fourth technique within a school of unyielding endurance.

rites.name: Amasanum Niarnostum
rites.text: A practiced knack for handling gear that lightens the burden of everything worn on the body. It is the opening technique of a discipline built around stubborn endurance.

rites.name: Vorus Rianosum
rites.text: A fighting technique practiced by ordinary warriors that lets them strike at an enemy while leaping into the air. It is one of the combat arts taught among common fighters.

rites.name: Casaunum
rites.text: A fighter spins a long blade in a wide arc, striking an enemy several times over and charging their inner gauge of skill. It is a rhythmic technique taught to novices in temple halls.

rites.name: Valiria Vaunentum
rites.text: A reflexive combat impulse that surges in a warrior's blood, guiding their strikes without conscious thought. It belongs to a swift duelist's lineage and can never be fully tamed.

rites.name: Serirnanum Tonus
rites.text: A last-ditch guarding discipline taught to fighters in their gravest hour. When a warrior is wounded to half strength or less, it sharply improves their chance of turning aside incoming blows.

rites.name: Raulosanum
rites.text: A rhythmic rapping of a hand upon the controls lets a bearer shorten the lingering hindrance that clings to them. Each repeated strike wears the affliction down faster.

rites.name: Nausteorium
rites.text: A disciplined inner resolve that a fighter cultivates along a branch of trained temperament. When the practitioner draws upon martial techniques, this resolve adds a sharpened boost to their strength.

rites.name: Mistes Vianum
rites.text: A disciplined physical technique practiced by warriors of a hidden order. It locks an opponent's limbs in place, and when performed after a certain strike it also weakens their resolve.

rites.name: Meostanum Oreosastium
rites.text: A quiet ward that dampens the strain of magic on its bearer. While any enchantment is active, the wearer feels thirty percent less of the cost.

rites.name: Telostanum Amiranum
rites.text: A driver skill that a fighter can draw upon in combat. It belongs to the set of techniques used during a battle in the far-off Golden Country.

rites.name: Lonauntium
rites.text: A continuous inhaling technique practiced by initiates to sustain a steady breath through a long chant. It is one of the trained skills taught within a temple craft.

rites.name: Restia Virnium
rites.text: A ritual technique in which a practitioner hurls a blazing sphere that bursts on impact, scorching and dazing foes caught within its reach.

rites.name: Valasornium
rites.text: A basic technique a wielder can use to open an encounter by striking before the opponent reacts. It is one of the trained skills taught to those who ride a vehicle.

rites.name: Coreonornia
rites.text: A driver's technique that lets a fighter unleash a rapid volley of blows. It belongs to the set of skills a driver can call upon in combat.

rites.name: Sereonillia
rites.text: A deepened instinct that a wild-hearted driver can awaken within themselves. It belongs to the set of skills a driver can cultivate to sharpen their abilities.

rites.name: Amornanum
rites.text: A learned craft of single combat that a trained fighter can master. It is one of the abilities that shape how a driver fights in a contest of machines.

rites.name: Oreones Corosium
rites.text: A bound discipline in which a warrior's restraint steers hostility away from their allies. Each blow taken draws a quarter more of the enemy's attention away from the group.

rites.name: Nostes Mianum
rites.text: A practiced fighter's technique that heightens the force of a decisive blow. When the strike lands true, it adds a surplus of damage to the attack.

rites.name: Lianus Mollarium
