rites.text: A nightly craft that quickens the spoils a fighter draws from slain foes, adding a fifth to every gain while darkness lasts. It opens a branch of practices built around timid restraint.

rites.name: Reollaunum
rites.text: A nocturnal craft that strengthens its wielder by a fixed share while the night lasts. It belongs to the third rank of a single discipline of steadfast practice.

rites.name: Seraurnus Ranteosus
rites.text: A learned defensive discipline that lets a practitioner turn aside half the harm of an attack. It leaves thorns and lingering curses untouched.

rites.name: Vaurnum
rites.text: A protective technique a fighter draws upon in battle, which softens the blows landed upon a nearby ally. The guarding effect scales with the skill's strength.

rites.name: Orinastanum
rites.text: A bond-kindling craft taught within a warrior circle, where a trusted ally's loyalty deepens with each encouragement. It lets a fighter strengthen the connection shared with a chosen companion.

rites.name: Roria Coronteonum
rites.text: A practiced craft that lengthens the time a toxic affliction lingers in a foe. Each application gives the venom several extra rounds of harm, whether it comes from a burst of earth or a poisoned strike.

rites.name: Nesteonia
rites.text: A rank-three stance practiced by a sisterhood of hammer-wielding guardians. It lets their bearers surge forward behind a raised shield.

rites.name: Torasor
rites.text: A discipline of combat technique that a practitioner draws upon as one of several learned abilities for shaping their ways of fighting and moving through a world.

rites.name: Laror Lenes
rites.text: A learned gift of tending that strengthens the restorative rites its bearer performs. It is the first lesson taught in the path of compassion.

rites.name: Veonesia
rites.text: A stubborn warrior's discipline that sometimes swells his endurance for a short stretch when a fight begins, though his wounds do not mend to match.

rites.name: Rontia Serorium
rites.text: A trained technique of composure that a practitioner calls upon during an operation. It belongs to the set of skills taught to those who handle vehicles.

rites.name: Oroles Leornoses
rites.text: A fighting discipline that a warrior of the second rank of a valor school can master. While the warrior stands at full vigor, the discipline adds a ten percent boost to their strength.

rites.name: Orestanum Veornores
rites.text: A discipline of silent endurance practiced in high places, where a trained driver draws steadiness from solitude. It is counted among the skills that shape a driver's craft.

rites.name: Sonistanum
rites.text: A grandfatherly foresight art that lets a bearer read omens before a battle begins. It is one of the driving techniques a rider can draw upon in the field.

rites.name: Orantiaria
rites.text: A fighter's battle technique that allows a trained blade to channel reckless fury into a sudden surge of combat strength. It mirrors another warrior's method of seizing fortune in battle.

rites.name: Amintanum Seraunor
rites.text: A combat art in which a fighter draws every hum of their being into one shared pitch. It is listed among the battle techniques practiced in this realm.

rites.name: Amenteorium
rites.text: A calm inner discipline that strengthens a wielder's resolve when no protective plating covers the body. Practitioners who go unarmoured gain a noticeable boost to their resilience.

rites.name: Viallus Renus
rites.text: A driving technique granted to pilots in a fictional racing setting, enabling rapid reactions during contests. It belongs to a collection of skills held by drivers in one tale.

rites.name: Raulleostor
rites.text: A daylight discipline that lets a practitioner's trained arts recover faster while the sun is up. It is the third technique in a branch devoted to vitality and bloom.

rites.name: Nastus Teleorus
rites.text: A heavy technique in which a warrior wielding a massive axe drives forward and crushes the earth beneath an enemy. It is performed at a second rank of mastery by hulking combatants.

rites.name: Valoseores
rites.text: A quiet craft that lifts the bearer's strength by a fifth while the sky is dark. It is the first technique taught in a practice of timid arts.

rites.name: Orialor
rites.text: A driver's technique that lets them link several rapid strikes together in quick succession. It is one of the skills a driver can learn and use in the wider art of combat.

rites.name: Nialiror Serostor
rites.text: A trained footwork craft that lets its practitioner move a little faster than before. It sits as the third technique in a bold fighting discipline.

rites.name: Seriarnes Telaustes
rites.text: A kind of inner craft that draws on radiance, practiced by those who train in the arts of the field. It is one of several disciplines known to its circles.

rites.name: Corostor Valeror
rites.text: A fighting technique that a warrior can call upon during combat. It belongs to the battle skills of the Golden Country.

rites.name: Caullia
rites.text: A driver's discipline that hardens the body into unyielding resolve. It is one of the skills practiced by those who steer the great vehicles of the realm.

rites.name: Orelles Narnes
rites.text: A devoted healing craft that restores a portion of every companion's vitality when its practitioner falls. It belongs to the fifth rung of a tradition built on bonds of affection.

rites.name: Seraunium Amaurarnium
rites.text: A restorative art that mends a wounded inner essence. It is bound to a particular class of practitioners and cannot be fully learned by anyone.

rites.name: Mollum Raurnentes
rites.text: A driving discipline practiced in the Golden Country, taught as one of the skills a charioteer learns. It belongs to a set of techniques used by those who steer the great vehicles.

rites.name: Coralus Coriastus
rites.text: A devotional art that shortens the waiting period between every healing rite its practitioner performs. It is the fifth discipline taught within the path of devotion.

rites.name: Mellor Cereoses
rites.text: A disciplined inner technique that hardens a fighter's body and spirit against harm. It is the fourth discipline taught within the path of steadfast endurance.

rites.name: Lentium
rites.text: A tuned technique that lets a driver's body surge with stronger muscle power. It is one of several trained abilities passed among skilled drivers.

rites.name: Leontoses
rites.text: A practiced craft in which a wanderer blends gathered plants into restorative mixtures. It is one of the skills a traveling companion may learn and use on the road.

rites.name: Orastollor
rites.text: A discipline of skill in which a fighter becomes one with their weapon. It is taught as a driver technique within a larger training tradition.

rites.name: Meseontanum
rites.text: A bearer's inner vigor swells by a tenth while daylight holds. It is the first technique in its discipline and comes known to the bearer from the start.

rites.name: Mistes Tausontanum
rites.text: A discipline of focus that lets a practitioner's ranged workings reach five metres farther than before. It is taught as the third step within a branch of devotional training.

rites.name: Ameonores
rites.text: A learned discipline that lets a wanderer bear armor of moderate heft. It is the first craft taught within a warrior's path of endurance and is known to every trained initiate from the start.

rites.name: Oraustium Saunoria
rites.text: A fighting technique practiced by ordinary warriors who wield short blades. It is used to strike down swarming vermin.

rites.name: Serania
rites.text: A bold inner craft that surges a fighter with twenty percent more strength for half a minute when they open a clash against a foe several ranks above them.

rites.name: Liarnium Taustalum
rites.text: A bold challenge that draws the attention of nearby foes, turning their anger toward the speaker. It forms the fifth art within a branch of fervent spirit.

rites.name: Coresostum
rites.text: A fighting technique that lets a warrior flow around blows and turn each movement into a graceful counterstrike. It is practiced as one of the combat arts taught among the wandering blades.

rites.name: Telanum Roreontanum
rites.text: A battle technique that lets lesser fighters raise a sheltering guard against incoming blows. It is practiced by common warriors in the field.

rites.name: Meoriantes
rites.text: A trained endurance discipline that lets its practitioner shrug off a tenth of blunt and edged harm. It belongs to the fourth rung of a bold warrior path taught in the temple-halls.

rites.name: Serilanus
rites.text: A combat technique practiced by common fighters that restores their wounds at a quickened pace. It mirrors two other restorative arts known to the same warriors.

rites.name: Losum Tosus
rites.text: A practiced art of keeping restorative brews ready for use in combat. Those who have trained in it are able to call on such drafts swiftly during a fight.

rites.name: Mireostum
rites.text: A bodily discipline that a driver can develop to sharpen their strength and endurance. It is one of the trained abilities that a skilled driver draws on.

rites.name: Sanum Tirnasum
rites.text: A restorative craft that lets a wielder mend wounds by drawing on the living energy of the surrounding land. It is practiced as one of the tools a fighter uses to stay in battle.

rites.name: Ameonium Siares
rites.text: A innate knack that a driver carries from birth, granting them an edge in handling vehicles. It is one of the abilities that shape how a driver performs on the road.

rites.name: Tallontanum
rites.text: A combat technique that a fighter can call upon during battle. It is one of the skills a warrior learns to fight with.

rites.name: Tirones
rites.text: A learned gift of encouragement that restores a portion of a companion's full vitality whenever a fellow traveler is cheered on. It belongs to the third rung of a discipline built around spirited morale.

rites.name: Caranum Miaror
rites.text: A ranged battle technique that strikes an enemy's crown with heavy force. It always lands as a critical blow and can occasionally finish off a weakened foe instantly.

rites.name: Vinauranum
rites.text: A fighting technique that a common warrior uses in combat to brace against the ground. It draws on the stability of the soil beneath them.

rites.name: Valestum Vantaulor
rites.text: A fighting technique used by ordinary warriors who wield blades in combat. It is a skill that lets a fighter hold their footing in battle.

rites.name: Valaurianum
rites.text: A driver's trained skill that is known to belong to the drivers of this world. It is one of the abilities that shapes how they handle their craft.

rites.name: Launtarnus
rites.text: A basic strike technique used by heavy-armored wardens who slam their shields into the earth. It sends a shockwave through the ground that unsteadies nearby foes.

rites.name: Rernia Ameranes
rites.text: A glowing rite of restoration in which a caster sends a soft pulse of vitality into a chosen companion, mending their wounds.

rites.name: Neontum Tereostium
rites.text: A stored inner calm that lets a wielder steady their resolve, granting a brief boost to resistance when facing a foe far above their rank in a clash.

rites.name: Coreollerum
rites.text: A taunting maneuver performed in battle by ordinary fighters, using a mocking gesture to draw the attention of rivals. It is one of the combat techniques common warriors are known to employ.

rites.name: Rilles Ceosaulanum
rites.text: A combat technique used in battle that draws on the force of opposing air currents. It is one of the recognized skills practiced by warriors of this world.

rites.name: Lastanum Lianontium
rites.text: A driver's inner talent that a bonded partner can draw upon in battle. It is one of the skills a warrior of this order may learn to refine.

rites.name: Seostia Moseornor
rites.text: A trained quickness of response that a practiced wanderer can call upon in the moment of need. It belongs to the skill-craft taught among the travelling orders.

rites.name: Oreosonanum
rites.text: A restorative craft that strengthens the mending of wounded allies who are bloodied and weakened. Its healing grows stronger when the recipient has lost half their vitality.

rites.name: Amoses
rites.text: A driving discipline that a traveler applies to keep their attention fixed on a chosen destination. It is listed among the skills a charioteer or vehicle pilot can learn.

rites.name: Coriallium Vilia
rites.text: A learned craft of mixing remedies and potions, practiced by those who study how substances act on the body. It is counted among the standard abilities a wayfarer can cultivate.

rites.name: Oraullium Niasantor
rites.text: A fighting technique that lets a warrior strike twice in quick succession more often. It belongs to a third discipline within a restless, impatient school of combat.

rites.name: Naunum Rostus
rites.text: A practiced driver's technique that lets a traveler cover great distances swiftly. It is one of the skills a rider can master on the road.

rites.name: Cirnalum
rites.text: A bearer's trained discipline that lets them wear the heaviest armor without penalty. It forms the first step of a larger branch of martial zeal.

rites.name: Sasia Orines
rites.text: A bodily discipline that strengthens a wielder's vitality. It is the second technique within a hero's valor path and grants a fixed rise in its wielder's endurance.

rites.name: Vintes
rites.text: A learned craft of working with frost and cold, held exclusively by one unnamed circle of practitioners. It is treated as a field skill among those who command it.

rites.name: Valirnor Lausonanum
rites.text: A ward-craft that lets a bearer endure assaults with greater resilience. It belongs to a set of trained skills practiced by those who ride or guide beasts.

rites.name: Vonaustum
rites.text: A trained combat technique that lets a fighter perceive their opponent's moves before they happen. It is practiced as one of the skills of battle.

rites.name: Nirus Tiror
rites.text: A hidden art that belongs to the shadow-hunting role of a wandering pursuer. It cannot be fully learned or mastered by anyone.

rites.name: Veostum Meosialia
rites.text: A tender shout that mends the wounds of every companion in a group after a strong bond is formed. Each ally recovers a tenth of their total vitality.

rites.name: Tentaunum
rites.text: A restorative gust that a common fighter can call upon during combat to mend the wounds of allies. It is a skill practiced by ordinary warriors in the field.

rites.name: Maurestium
rites.text: A gentle art of cheering on companions, which mends their wounds by a small fraction of their full vitality whenever the practitioner offers encouragement. It is taught as the second lesson of the compassion path.

rites.name: Maustor Caullum
rites.text: A learned gift in a warrior's wisdom branch that lightens the burden of gear worn on the body, easing the bearer's movement in battle.

rites.name: Serollia Orirnus
rites.text: A driving discipline that a racer can train in order to handle a vehicle with greater command. It is one of the recognized skills within the world's racing practice.

rites.name: Viastia
rites.text: A trained defensive craft that lets a warrior turn aside more incoming blows. It is the first technique taught within a stealthy, reserved discipline of guardians.

rites.name: Orallum Cesiantus
rites.text: A ward-craft that a driver can call upon to shield themselves against harm. It is practiced as one of the skills available to those who guide vehicles through the land.

rites.name: Naulestum
rites.text: A communal craft that lets a gathered throng lend its collective strength to one person. It is counted among the driving skills taught in the fabled Golden Country.

rites.name: Oriallor Toseolanum
rites.text: A discipline of driving that a wandering rider can learn in the golden country. It is listed among the skills a pilot may hold.

rites.name: Valasanum Telastanum
rites.text: A wild, unguarded fighting discipline in which a warrior strikes harder once their strength has fallen to half or less. It is taught as the second lesson of the mind-path.

rites.name: Serilauntes
rites.text: A bearing of inherited gifts held by rulers of a line, granting them a set of sacred aptitudes that mark their right to command.

rites.name: Serestilia
rites.text: A fearsome strike that a warrior unlocks after claiming a blade of their own. It takes the place of an older technique once that weapon is wielded.

rites.name: Relium
rites.text: A grim pact offered in a trial of sorcerers that strengthens strikes in proportion to how many times the fallen have been restored during the trial. The gain stops growing after ten restorations.

rites.name: Mentilanum
rites.text: A basic technique used by the armored warriors of a wandering band, who practice it in the stony wilds. It marks the first step of their martial training.

rites.name: Telaurnor
rites.text: A stubborn inner resolve that swells in a bearer once their vitality has fallen to half or less, granting a fifteen percent surge of strength. It is the fifth discipline within a lineage of spirit-based arts.

rites.name: Silum Silles
rites.text: A third-tier technique practiced by one kind of sworn shield-bearing fighter. It lets the wielder drive forward with a raised guard to strike down foes.

rites.name: Nesarnum
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter draws on a blade's crimson edge to strike harder. It belongs to a set of battle skills used by warriors in the field.

rites.name: Lirnanum
rites.text: A disciplined fighting art taught in the wisdom branch of a warrior's training. It grants the practitioner a slightly greater chance to strike twice in a single attack.

rites.name: Coreolor Salia
rites.text: A ward-craft that hardens a wielder's body, granting an additional tenth of their vitality. It is taught as the fifth discipline within a branch of steady effort.

rites.name: Toleostus Ristes
rites.text: A bearer's inner caution sharpens when their strength falls to half or less, granting a swelling boost to their ability. It belongs to a path of fearful talents.

rites.name: Contus Valintum
rites.text: A battle technique practiced by warriors in the invented world of the story. It belongs to the set of combat skills the wiki records for this setting.

rites.name: Mentum Valisteorus
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter sweeps a curved blade through an arc to strike foes. It is one of the recognized battle skills taught among warriors.

rites.name: Tosaustor
rites.text: A ringing technique used by heavy blade-bearers of one warrior class, who wield a shield and hammer in combat. Practitioners reach a second tier of mastery with it.

rites.name: Sillum Coriarium
rites.text: A chilling ward-mark that a fighter can call upon in battle to draw a numbing cold over the field. It belongs to the set of combat arts practiced by warriors.

rites.name: Orauniallor
rites.text: A ritual device of return that belongs to a order of arcane practitioners and cannot be fully mastered by anyone who attempts it.

rites.name: Seonanum Naustellum
rites.text: A steadfast inner discipline that halves the accuracy loss suffered when one's vitality runs thin. It belongs to the fourth rung of a branch devoted to dependability.

rites.name: Veontium Serostellor
rites.text: A refined mastery of one's inner control that a driver draws upon during a journey. It is one of several learned skills that shape how a traveler handles the road.

rites.name: Saunum Valiles
rites.text: A sudden crackling strike that arcs through a foe like a flash of lightning. It is practiced as one of the fighting disciplines taught among warriors.

rites.name: Canisum
rites.text: A sharpened art of provocation by which a fighter draws an opponent's hostile attention, raising the wrath gathered against them when that foe has been looking elsewhere.

rites.name: Tarus Seresarnium
rites.text: A battle craft in which a fighting company gathers a rush of resolve after a clean opening clash. Every member gains a fresh measure of vigor for the fight ahead.

rites.name: Raurnelium
rites.text: A foreseeing discipline that lets a fighter sharpen a strike after receiving a premonition. The sharpened blow lands with a fifth more force.

rites.name: Nistiallia
rites.text: A discipline practiced by rear guard adepts that draws a whirling column of sea water upward from a lake or ocean surface. It is classed among the defensive arts of a rearward order.

rites.name: Sereosanum Viareonanum
rites.text: A sharpened instinct that lets a traveler detect looming danger by the faint scent it leaves on the air. It is one of the practical skills that drivers of wagons and carts rely on along the road.

rites.name: Castaulor
rites.text: A basic trained maneuver that a certain class of ceremonial blade-bearers performs. It is the first of the skills this practice teaches to their fighters.

rites.name: Corarnia Ceollus
rites.text: A sudden wave of freezing force that a fighter unleashes as a final, decisive blow. It becomes available once a warrior gains a blade, and it is later replaced by a sharper, watery technique.

rites.name: Amistauntum
rites.text: A learned technique in which a fighter channels a rising force into a downward strike. It is recorded among the practices a driver may master.

rites.name: Tanium Amontiria
rites.text: A quiet discipline that a wielder of a Driver can call upon in battle. It is taught as a learned skill and refers to a hidden form of combat.

rites.name: Tiastium Miareostium
rites.text: A combat technique that duplicates a common blade maneuver, letting a warrior strike with the same effect. It is a battle skill used in fighting.

rites.name: Centus Ciselanum
rites.text: A ritual art where flowing tide-essence draws a little vital force out of an enemy and passes it to a chosen caster. Its formal title is hidden from the common practitioner.

rites.name: Amenes Oralium
rites.text: A forceful strike technique used by hulking fighters of a brawling sport. It is mastered at a middling tier of skill and wielded by rough, powerful combatants.

rites.name: Seriasium Leonteranum
rites.text: A trained bodily discipline that lets a practitioner be both forceful and limber. It is one of the driver skills taught within a wider tradition of combat craft.

rites.name: Vonteostus
rites.text: A combat art that lets a fighter stir a dormant inner force into a sharper, stronger state during battle. It is one of the trained techniques practiced by warriors in this world.

rites.name: Taullisum
rites.text: A lingering hex that a cyclic sect of ritual bearers invokes to bind its foes. It is used by a serpent-ring order and draws its strength from an unbroken circle.

rites.name: Mesium Masanum
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a warrior channels a blaze into a single lethal assault. It is listed among the battle arts a combatant can call upon.

rites.name: Noranum Amelostium
rites.text: A discipline of inner resolve that lets a practitioner withstand a portion of arcane harm. It is the fourth technique taught within one of the swift-blade traditions.

rites.name: Caustorus
rites.text: A fighting technique used by common warriors that repeats the strike of a more celebrated combatant. It works the same way as that other skill.

rites.name: Reollor Maustium
rites.text: A bond between companions that grants a small chance of acting again after each turn. It is the opening craft within a path of shared comradeship.

rites.name: Tiasinanum
rites.text: A sustained rite of hardened guard that lifts the protective strength of every ally standing in the company, against both blade and spirit.

rites.name: Terniastum
rites.text: A battle-earned craft that lets a warrior draw extra spirit-strength from fallen foes. The gain applies even to companions resting outside the marching ranks.

rites.name: Raurium Meollia
rites.text: A combat technique that lets a wielder of the common blades gather their energy for a sudden strike in battle.

rites.name: Naulia Coreosia
rites.text: A heightened inner clarity that grows stronger when the bearer wears no protective plating. It sits at the start of a path of contemplative mastery and lifts the bearer's mental power by a quarter.

rites.name: Cellus Ciaranum
rites.text: A three-pronged blade technique wielded by male swordsmen of a common warrior class. It is a second-tier skill that these fighters can master through their training.

rites.name: Telentes Vaurantanum
rites.text: A heavy strike that rolls its wielder's momentum into a crushing hammer blow. It is used by sturdy fighters who wield a shield and a heavy hammer.

rites.name: Lonum Amauntornes
rites.text: A bearer's chance to harden their body before combat grows, raising their guarding strength for half a minute. It belongs to the third step of a patient, enduring discipline.

rites.name: Amasium Oraunastium
rites.text: A combat discipline in which a fighter plants their feet and holds ground against incoming force. It is a skill practiced by warriors in a battle tradition.

rites.name: Rentirnus
rites.text: A keen inner instinct that warns its bearer of looming peril before it arrives. It is passed on by a stout, stone-hearted guardian who guards the forest path.

rites.name: Valareornia
rites.text: A ranked special technique used by male common fighters in a hybrid combat system. It is unlocked at the third tier of mastery and belongs to the common-level practice of wielding blades.

rites.name: Valaulum Solanum
rites.text: A combat technique that releases a surge of stored air to strike several opponents at once. It works as a discharge art, drawing its force from a practitioner's inner reserves.

rites.name: Nosium Orillus
rites.text: A driver's technique used in the Golden Country, one of the set of skills a rider can learn. Its effect is not described here.

rites.name: Cases Corialeonum
rites.text: A quiet gift of the air that lets a practitioner press extra force into gusts she calls forth. It strengthens only the single breath-spell that moves the winds directly.

rites.name: Amauriarnia
rites.text: A learned discipline of wielding a long edged weapon, taught as one of the core practical skills a traveler can master.

rites.name: Serinellium
rites.text: A learned craft of wayfarers that is granted only to a single chosen wielder. Its details remain unrecorded in the archive.

rites.name: Sontarnes
rites.text: A battle technique in which a fighter takes on a fierce, armored bearing to strike with greater force. It is one of the combat skills a warrior can draw upon in battle.

rites.name: Sereorillus
rites.text: Sereorillus is a concept of the Drerdunen Weave, the planted lattice of quiet powers that the makers set in the Seeding and which sleeps through the Age of Sundering. It is understood as a dormant pattern rather than a body, a promise of what the Weave might hold once its bonds are whole again.

rites.name: Rirnanum
rites.text: A combat technique practiced by a specialist of the mind-piercing discipline. It is gained by overcoming a rare, greedy beast while a student of that discipline stands ready among the party.

rites.name: Leliantanum
rites.text: A protective sheen that soaks up a portion of incoming harm and stops lingering wounds from taking root. The bearer's life gauge takes on a deep blue hue while it holds, but not when merely passing through its field.

rites.name: Maullines
rites.text: A bound ward that hardens its bearer against being hurled or flung aside. While it holds, every foe is drawn to the wielder and keeps their attention even under harm.

rites.name: Nianium
rites.text: A battle discipline taught to a healer caste, unlocked after long mastery. When adopted, the practitioner's stance steadily restores nearby companions and quickens their renewal of abilities, though the boost never doubles up.

rites.name: Valireontus
rites.text: A swift tempest-strike that rips through the air toward a foe, shattering their guard. Those hit from the far side find their pace halved and their blows slowed.

rites.name: Narium
rites.text: A special blade technique that binds a foe within a dark cage, unleashed as a signature art during raids and missions.

rites.name: Celeornanum
rites.text: A temporary tide of strength that swells a bearer's blows, stacking alongside other charms that sharpen harm when certain conditions are met.

rites.name: Saunium
rites.text: A fighting technique practiced by a swordsman who wields a particular blade in combat. It is one of the arts that wielder commands, flowing through the strikes of its user.

rites.name: Ciasiria
rites.text: A fierce special technique that a warrior unleashes, its nature shaped by the great blade he wields. The weapon in hand decides which elemental force the strike carries.

rites.name: Riranum
rites.text: A combat discipline practiced by swift duelists, where a striking stance hastens both strikes and technique at the cost of harm to the practitioner.

rites.name: Sereolles Saustanum
rites.text: A martial technique in which a fighter channels force through a clawed hand-guard to deliver a blow that shatters defenses. It is one of the forms practiced by a wielder of knuckle claws.

rites.name: Cauriallia
rites.text: A bearer may sacrifice a portion of their current vitality to kindle a reservoir of inner readiness. The strength of the kindling grows as the practice is refined.

rites.name: Minus
rites.text: A fiery spear technique that a trained warrior unlocks after long practice. The wielder raises a burning spear and sweeps it hard across the body, and some practitioners sweep it back and forth.

rites.name: Mesanum
rites.text: A combat discipline practiced by soul-binding warriors, passed on after a victory over a rare crystal beast. It lets a fighter turn an enemy's essence into a tainted, nourishing feast.

rites.name: Lianauntia
rites.text: A battle technique in which a wielder strikes in a chained sequence during a combined assault. It belongs to a single fighter who uses it when the chain attack begins.

rites.name: Seontianes
rites.text: A learned combat technique that a wandering knight can acquire after completing a trial of courage. It is one of the two signature disciplines belonging to a particular warrior.

rites.name: Veornus Mirniasium
rites.text: A flame-wrought special technique of a sworn blade, awakened in its wielder's third form. It draws upon inner fire to unleash a devastating strike at the highest tier of mastery.

rites.name: Amantiarium
rites.text: A dark ward that a fighter raises around herself to dim how strongly foes notice her. While it burns, her hostility fades and neither striking nor mending draws attention.

rites.name: Serauselor
rites.text: A martial technique wielded with a shield-hammer, used as one of the arts of its user's fighting style. It is a driving strike meant to break through an opponent's defense.

rites.name: Ameseontium
rites.text: A spinning technique performed by a wielder of blades, a flowing whirl that recycles an earlier slashing move. It belongs to the skills of one particular fighter who favors knives.

rites.name: Rillum
rites.text: A fiery lashing technique practiced by wielders of the flexible twin-blade weapons. It is one of the signature combat arts used by the warrior who fights with these whip-swords.

rites.name: Ventor Leornes
rites.text: A stealthy cutting technique drawn from a weapon of mournful power. It is learned only by those who have already completed a long trial and received a later revision.

rites.name: Teleolisia
rites.text: A dark swirling blade technique that gathers gloom into a violent vortex. It belongs to a high-level set of special moves used in combat.

rites.name: Viasium
rites.text: A close-quarters fighting technique wielded with a blade, learned by a fighter after completing a particular trial in a city. It is one of two signature techniques of its user.

rites.name: Coroniasus
rites.text: A lingering enchantment that sharpens a bearer's chance to strike with decisive force. It scales the bearer's precision by a fixed fraction, making every blow more likely to land true.

rites.name: Vialor Caseles
rites.text: A bound art of final passing wielded by a sworn blade-bearer. It flows from a special sword and is counted among the practitioner's signature techniques.

rites.name: Vines
rites.text: A martial technique used by a wielder of a long pole-spear, delivering a heavy crushing blow that breaks armor. It belongs to one warrior's repertoire when armed with that weapon.

rites.name: Conalanum
rites.text: A spinning maneuver wielded as a blade technique by a warrior named Roc. It is a special attack that twists and crushes its target.

rites.name: Virnanum Amesantum
rites.text: A joint combat technique in which two fighters link their powers into one sweeping, whirling assault. It is built from the attack patterns of two separate masters and carried out in a chained sequence.

rites.name: Orelor
rites.text: A ritual craft that channels a measured surge of vital force from one practitioner into an ally, sharpening that ally's latent power.

rites.name: Mesus
rites.text: A fighting technique in which the wielder whirls a spear and drives it forward at a foe, while the wielder also takes harm from the motion.

rites.name: Seraullium
rites.text: A battle technique practiced by mind-binders, gained by overcoming a rare creature while a soul-tampering craft is active on one of the company's fighters.

rites.name: Tiastium
rites.text: A duelist's fighting technique that swings a blade in a wide circle before delivering a forceful downward cut. It is a derived form of an older flowing strike and is performed only by one specific warrior.

rites.name: Coristes
rites.text: A combat discipline practiced by mind-binding warriors, learned only after vanquishing a armored beast of exceptional strength. It can be claimed when a chosen fighter in the group is set to channel their inner spirit.

rites.name: Ciaror
rites.text: A fighting art practiced by a wielder of a curved sword, drawn from an ancient discipline of the blade. It belongs to the repertoire of one famed bladeswoman who wields a shining sword.

rites.name: Orolliasus
rites.text: A bladed technique that sweeps a hostile wind through an opponent's ranks. It belongs to a single champion and is used as a basic special strike.

rites.name: Sernus Telenor
rites.text: A martial discipline practiced by one warrior as a signature technique, learned after completing a sworn duty tied to a small people. It is a close-quarters art of rhythmic strikes.

rites.name: Viarnia
rites.text: A tier three blade technique found in a faraway land, prized as a special strike within a duel. It belongs to the arts of the sword.

rites.name: Rirnallanum
rites.text: A ritual dance technique performed by a single dancer who spins twice in quick succession. The motion rapidly restores the power of a sworn circle of allies.

rites.name: Ristor Ciallum
rites.text: A paired striking technique practiced by a mind-binding warrior order. It is learned only after overcoming a rare creature while the bearer's inner-link discipline is active.

rites.name: Amentilus
rites.text: A fighting art in which a practitioner delivers a sharpened strike along the leading edge of a blade. It belongs to a set of rear guard techniques taught among certain wandering warrior circles.

rites.name: Masteror
rites.text: A battle discipline of the heavy warrior order, practiced by those who have unlocked its class. Once mastered, it becomes a usable high-level technique for fighters.

rites.name: Roleonia
rites.text: A coiled blade technique wielded by a pair of fighters, whose elemental nature is set by the great sword held by the one who unleashes it.

rites.name: Cornasanum
rites.text: A combat technique practiced by mind-binding fighters, learned only after overcoming a rare guardian beast while a bonded companion wields the soul-binding ritual. It lets the user call on a sudden, dazzling burst in battle.

rites.name: Rellium
rites.text: A fighting technique used by solitary wanderers that makes the user hold a guarded stance, turning incoming blows back on the attacker with double their strength while cancelling any counter-moves.

rites.name: Vernilanum
rites.text: A savage rising punch practiced by fighters who wear clawed gauntlets. It is one of the techniques a particular brawler can call upon when using those claws.

rites.name: Seosternor
rites.text: A wild, whirling technique of driving that a bearer performs while wielding a long lance. It belongs to one warrior's repertoire of arts.

rites.name: Launtires
rites.text: A learned technique belonging to a certain practitioner's craft, whose force grows stronger as that practitioner gathers more arts and skills. It is a cultivated talent rather than a physical object.

rites.name: Maullum Sereolus
rites.text: A swift technique practiced by wielders of paired curved blades, granting bursts of speed to those who master it. It belongs to the arts of one particular blademaster.

rites.name: Amaures
rites.text: A dread-born battle technique taught to those who master the arts of the mind-breakers. It is won by overcoming a colossal beast while a practitioner's inner-hacking skill is active.

rites.name: Reoristium
rites.text: A specialized blade strike that a fighter unleashes at its highest mastery tier. It also serves as that fighter's signature special art during hired-raid battles.

rites.name: Lonanum Oraullinium
rites.text: A signature blade technique wielded by a sword-bearing fighter, unlocked at its highest tier. It also serves as that fighter's special move during hired-assault engagements.

rites.name: Lontium Lentiarnus
rites.text: A learned technique of heavy force that a wielder can unleash only after first channeling a prior sword discipline. It is awakened during a fierce duel with a sovereign of a distant realm.

rites.name: Leoleria
rites.text: A gilded projected effigy of a shimmering chant-bound figure armed with twin whirlwind talons. It is won through a rite performed at a certain bearer's wellspring.

rites.name: Mirolanum
rites.text: A heavy strike technique wielded by a warrior bearing a dreaded crescent blade. It is unlocked only after completing a second journey through the tale, once a later revision is applied.

rites.name: Telauntirum
rites.text: A raging surge of wrath that a warrior releases as a defensive art. It is one of the Rear Guard techniques used by a guardian of the line.

rites.name: Valia
rites.text: A fighting art practiced in one tradition, a variant of a broader discipline that only a single lineage of practitioners may perform. It is a refined technique passed through strict bloodlines.

rites.name: Valauntalia
rites.text: A bladed special technique of mid-tier power, used by warriors who wield a sharp weapon in combat. It is a skill tied to the blade school of its master.

rites.name: Amellaria
rites.text: A driving discipline practiced with a pair of blades, used by a wielder who has mastered it. It is one of the techniques a skilled bladeholder can call upon.

rites.name: Leneosor
rites.text: A fiery spinning technique that a warrior performs while wielding paired rings. It belongs to one fighter's repertoire of combat arts.

rites.name: Valiarnes
rites.text: A combat technique practiced by fighters of the strategist discipline. It becomes available to a practitioner once they reach the tenth tier of mastery in that discipline.

rites.name: Miria
rites.text: A dread curse that drains a foe's entire vitality at once, felling them outright. Certain wards and charms can blunt its touch, though some enchantments resist it entirely.

rites.name: Cauriantor
rites.text: A shimmering veil of heated air wraps its bearer, drawing all hostile attention away from them. While it holds, every strike they land finds its mark as a devastating blow.

rites.name: Caurnianor
rites.text: A high-tier blade technique wielded by a warrior who has mastered the forging of edged weapons. It is ranked among the fourth grade of combat arts.

rites.name: Aminaurnes
rites.text: A striking art used by a wielder who bears a pair of linked rings. It is one of the techniques that such a wielder can call upon.

rites.name: Vestilles
rites.text: A fighting technique practiced by one wielder of a heavy hammer-shield. It is one of the signature maneuvers this warrior uses in combat.

rites.name: Telineornia
rites.text: A targeted strike technique that ensures a devastating blow to an opponent's crown. When the foe is left reeling, it carries a slim chance of ending their life outright.

rites.name: Sarellia
rites.text: A special blade technique that a fighter named Jin can unleash at the third level of power. It disrupts the enemy with a sudden burst of cold force.

rites.name: Amonia
rites.text: A sweeping inner craft that a practitioner uses to reshape their own latent capacity. It is described as a signature technique tied to a single named character's lineage.

rites.name: Meonaria
rites.text: A quiet craft that draws a target into a brief, unwilling sleep. It is practiced through the subtle energies that flow within the body.

rites.name: Tarum Tornor
rites.text: A ranked battle technique wielded by hunters of the sky-trained hacking order. It is learned by overcoming a rare winged beast while the mind-hacking discipline stays active in a party member.

rites.name: Reontium
rites.text: A paired-tide technique used during a shared assault, where one wielder's flow amplifies another's strike. It belongs to a single wielder's signature form of combined assault.

rites.name: Oristia Amollanus
rites.text: A concealed inner feeling that a wielder draws upon as a special blade technique. It is held in reserve and unleashed during a fight, reshaping how the strike is made.

rites.name: Tiasistum
rites.text: A combat discipline practiced by assassins who rely on mechanical craft. It is one of the fighting arts taught within their order.

rites.name: Lilanum Amaulliasia
rites.text: A forceful combat technique practiced by mind-binders who strike at the inner will. It is learned only after overcoming a cunning fiend that feeds on flattery, while a binder's focused mental grip is active.

rites.name: Calum
rites.text: A ritual art of cunning provocation used by rear guards to goad rivals into rash action. Its practitioners rely on carefully timed insults to unsettle an opponent's composure.

rites.name: Lolium Telastausia
rites.text: A soothing aura art that a healer can call forth to cleanse every lingering affliction from the body. While it persists, the wielder slowly knits wounds closed.

rites.name: Orollianium
rites.text: A battle technique wielded by a traveling fighter who joins allies for a single stretch of conflict. It is a sword art meant to unsettle the heavens and strike with overwhelming force.

rites.name: Viallor Soseranum
rites.text: A rare battle technique that lets a single gifted fighter rapidly reset their readiness and strike again. It is a refined form of a common recovery art, and only one warrior is able to wield it.

rites.name: Vernus
rites.text: A battle discipline practiced by standard-bearers that creates a field where allies slowly mend their wounds, restoring a portion of the caster's healing strength every couple of seconds.

rites.name: Siror
rites.text: A fiery strike technique wielded by a single bladed warrior. It is a specialized move used with a sword in combat.

rites.name: Seornus
rites.text: A physical technique used by a fighter that strikes one chosen foe and also catches smaller nearby enemies within its radius. It draws heavy attention from foes, building a hostile focus toward the user.

rites.name: Lalia
rites.text: A martial technique wielded by mind-binding warriors, learned only after overcoming a legendary lone beast while a soul-tampering discipline is active. It is a fighting art rather than a physical object.

rites.name: Maunallanum
rites.text: A bright technique wielded through a sacred blade, drawn from a warrior's practiced shield-strike. It reuses that earlier motion to shine forth in a new form.

rites.name: Oraurastes
rites.text: A battle technique practiced by soul-workers, granted only after a rare creature of great beauty is overcome while a soul-binding discipline is active. It draws restorative vitality through a bond between the wielder and their companions.

rites.name: Sereontinor
rites.text: A driving combat technique used by a warrior wielding a sacred blade. It repurposes an earlier crushing blow into a sharper, electric-charged assault.

rites.name: Tisiallia
rites.text: A bright restorative technique wielded by a twin-bladed warrior in combat. It can only be learned by those who finish a journey and begin it again with their gains carried forward.

rites.name: Orialausor
rites.text: A practiced technique in which its user rapidly sends crackling lightning toward foes. It counts as one of a particular wielder's signature arts.

rites.name: Sauleres
rites.text: A linked combat technique that a wielder performs during a chained assault. In it, the bearer unleashes a sweeping purge drawn from a sacred blade.

rites.name: Cauntellium
rites.text: A combat technique that wears down a foe's physical resistance through a crippling strike. Warriors use it to leave enemies more vulnerable to harm.

rites.name: Taulum Tantus
rites.text: A protective aura that a fighter may call upon to rise instantly after falling in battle. Its awakening also stirs the allies' shared resolve, lending them a surge of strength.

rites.name: Orastirnes
rites.text: A learned craft that a sovereign's word takes hold of its listeners. It is awakened by a practitioner who has reached the fifth step of the psychic arts, and only three figures in the realm can wield it.

rites.name: Valorastum
rites.text: A battle discipline that sharpens the wielder's close-combat precision and strikes while raising their latent potential. It is one of many auras practiced in its tradition.

rites.name: Nalum
rites.text: A final dueling discipline practiced by mind-walkers, claimed only by overcoming a roaring beast while a bonded companion guides the inner link. It serves as a last resort for a warrior who has mastered the soul's edge.

rites.name: Ceornorium
rites.text: A combat discipline practiced only by one particular people, it channels force through a clenched hand to deliver a powerful strike. It is reserved exclusively for members of that people.

rites.name: Launtastum
rites.text: A withering hex that lowers the reserve of inner power a companion can gather, leaving them unable to unleash their trained techniques for a time. Stronger versions drain far more of that reserve.

rites.name: Volles
rites.text: A bound technique of a wielder who carries a serpent-shaped blade. It becomes available only to those who return for a second journey after completing the first, once a later revision is applied.

rites.name: Cilleorium
rites.text: A ground-based enchantment woven into a warrior's armor that quietly swells their store of inner resolve by a set share. It lifts the ceiling of how much fervor one companion can hold at a time.

rites.name: Maurnilia
rites.text: A mental discipline that a wanderer learns after completing a trial of kinship with a sage. It is one of the sage's two signature practices.

rites.name: Liantum Rirum
rites.text: A healer's inner calling that awakens when a fellow traveler is mended by a man, answering the matching call tied to women healers.

rites.name: Lilor Tinteorium
rites.text: A grief-born technique in which a wielder shatters their own guard to unleash a sorrowful, high-tier blade strike. It sits at a middling rank among the wielder's refined combat arts.

rites.name: Sollus Tauntilanum
rites.text: A bound craft that a practitioner invokes during an assault, drawing on a chained working to strike with added force. It belongs to one specific wielder's repertoire.

rites.name: Serestanum Sianolles
rites.text: A tradition of invoking a practiced technique to begin a clash without first readying one's arms. The gesture signals that the fight has started at the moment a warrior chooses a prepared art.

rites.name: Nernes Lasialia
rites.text: A fiery craft that a practitioner can learn after overcoming a pack of wolf-like beasts. It is one of the arts belonging to a particular spellcaster.

rites.name: Amirium Teleolires
rites.text: A learned mental craft that lets its practitioner reshape how another mind perceives things. It is one of the two signature arts of a particular adept, and it can be taught to a student who completes a dedicated trial of reasoning.

rites.name: Sollia Sauntornus
rites.text: A forceful technique used by a wielder of a sphere-shaped charm. When paired with a certain companion, the same technique can be drawn forth in a second form.

rites.name: Serolentum
rites.text: A deadly combat technique practiced by mind-breakers, learned only after vanquishing a lone guardian spirit that has been severed from its order. It is passed on to whoever holds the soul-piercing discipline active in their company.

rites.name: Tiallonor
rites.text: A battle art of the strategist order, it forms a field that mends the wounds of every companion standing within its reach at steady intervals.

rites.name: Valaurasia
rites.text: A dark-burning technique a wielder can perform while holding a pair of blades. It is one of the signature arts of a single named fighter who favors twin swords.

rites.name: Nostum
rites.text: A fighting discipline taught to blade-wielders who strike forward with reckless force. It sharpens aim and power in close combat, but leaves the practitioner more open to harm from every incoming blow.

rites.name: Laurnosum
rites.text: A tactical discipline practiced by commanders of a martial order. When invoked, it lets nearby companions recover a small portion of their vitality each time they are struck, a limited number of times.

rites.name: Vernia Vaseolium
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a warrior lunges ahead and sweeps twin blades outward in a wide arc, then springs backward to safety. It belongs to the practice of swift blade-dancers.

rites.name: Sastium Ameornor
rites.text: A deep-stroke discipline practiced by a wielder who carries twin blades. It is one of the bearer's signature techniques when both edges are drawn.

rites.name: Neornia Coreontium
rites.text: A sung melody that accompanies the daytime hours of a fortified hall. Its voices echo beyond the walls, and it is also offered for communal singing in a sound-playing device.

rites.name: Caulleornes
rites.text: A hidden technique used by a wielder who strikes an iron construct from its flank. The strike can leave the target dazed and disoriented.

rites.name: Oreontium
rites.text: A discipline of aura that lets its wielder bounce back lightning-type strikes and carries several other effects. It is one of many such arts practiced among the faithful.

rites.name: Vauntillum
rites.text: A combat technique in which a wielder gathers energy into one gauntlet and delivers a forceful sweeping strike. Only one particular sea-bound warrior is able to perform it.

rites.name: Mirnor Seroralia
rites.text: A radiant fighting discipline practiced by a single wielder, who channels light into a sweeping strike. It is a variant of a related blade-form and belongs to one practitioner alone.

rites.name: Vaulum Cistes
rites.text: A stored surge of force that a bearer gathers into their body, lending extra strength to the next blow or spell they unleash. It fades once that single strike is spent.

rites.name: Vantium Virnus
rites.text: A glowing discharge technique practiced by one wielder of a heavy launching engine. It is one of that wielder's signature methods when firing such an engine.

rites.name: Orernium Sauror
rites.text: A dimensional tearing craft that drags the world's fabric open around a target. Those caught within it are bound by a lingering drag that dulls their movements.

rites.name: Tianium Amialeones
rites.text: A blade technique in which a wielder of a particular sword performs four cutting strokes in rapid succession. It is one of the arts that a certain character can perform with a special katana.

rites.name: Cenanum Sereonium
rites.text: A ghostly fire art that a wielder channels through a whip-like blade. It is counted among the techniques of a single skilled fighter.

rites.name: Oreontium Amoles
rites.text: A violent spiraling strike art that a wielder performs when channeling power through heavy stone gauntlets. It is one of the techniques bound to that gear.

rites.name: Ameontornum
rites.text: A ward-craft that hardens a bearer against piercing blows, letting thrusts and arrows slide off. It is set into a bearer's gear and strengthens their defense against sharp strikes.

rites.name: Coriastus Viarnus
rites.text: A ghostly turning technique practiced by a wielder who carries two blades. It is one of the arts used when fighting with a pair of swords.

rites.name: Launisum
rites.text: A combat technique wielded by soul-focused fighters, learned only after overcoming a rare, shimmering beast while a mind-bending discipline is active in the party.

rites.name: Reliasanum
rites.text: A heavy striking technique used by a wielder of a shield-hammer. The user lunges forward and then swings the weapon upward in a rising blow.

rites.name: Vistium Vestium
rites.text: A glowing craft used by a gifted maker during a joint strike. It serves as the crafter's signature technique when several allies attack in sequence.

rites.name: Teliasia Corontes
rites.text: A quiet ward that lessens the harm taken from blows and blades. It is measured as a standing trait of a fighter's body.

rites.name: Ceorus Marnes
rites.text: A signature technique of a single wielder that channels a sympathetic vibration into their weapon. It belongs to the arts drawn from a serpent-bound inner power.

rites.name: Corilostia
rites.text: A restorative battle craft used in support of allies. It mends an ally's wounds and clears away every lingering hindrance.

rites.name: Santeollus
rites.text: A specialized attacking role within a summoning craft. Its practitioners are trained to strike with calls drawn from another realm.

rites.name: Rastoria
rites.text: A stalwart discipline of guarding that a wielder of a drilling bulwark performs. It belongs to one of the warrior's signature techniques.

rites.name: Neornum Teliantum
rites.text: A second-tier blade technique used by a sea-bound warrior in the realm's arena battles. Its name refers to churning waves.

rites.name: Lentor Valorelium
rites.text: A driving technique used by a rider who hurls a rolling sphere with brute force. It is one of the rider's signature moves, and it can also be performed while mounted on a particular companion creature.

rites.name: Orilles
rites.text: A supporting craft that lowers the hostility a fighter has drawn from foes, while briefly sharpening the force of their bodily strikes. Its potency grows as the practitioner advances in mastery.

rites.name: Reolliasium
rites.text: A physical martial technique practiced by a warrior lineage. It can shatter an opponent's guard, leaving them briefly open to attack.

rites.name: Leostia Maulostanum
rites.text: A bound martial art practiced by a wielder of a certain curved blade. It is one of the techniques that such a wielder can call upon when armed with the weapon.

rites.name: Valiarintor
rites.text: A dark blade technique that drains a bound foe's vitality and spirit, sometimes ending their life outright. It fails against foes who cannot be bound, while it never misses a target already staggered or knocked down.

rites.name: Sereostanor
rites.text: A fighter's signature technique of swift, close-range striking that a warrior learns after completing a major trial of service. It stands among the first techniques a duelist of her line commands.

rites.name: Serallus Serellus
rites.text: A coiled inner craft that a wielder unleashes during a chained assault. It belongs to a single fighter and is used in the middle of a combined strike.

rites.name: Riastia Ronteorum
rites.text: A coiled sword technique that a wielder of a particular blade performs by whirling forward and striking with the weapon. It counts among the combat disciplines of that one warrior.

rites.name: Cenum Serantus
rites.text: A creeping haze that spreads outward from a beast, stirring nearby creatures into hostility toward travelers. It swells their strength the longer it lingers, but can be dispelled or stunned away.

rites.name: Seriallus
rites.text: A ring-powered instrument of judgment that a wielder of paired rings can draw upon. It is one of the techniques that a particular user performs when channeling the twin circlets.

rites.name: Laurnia Valeonum
rites.text: A joint technique where two allied fighters combine a blazing war-chant with a spinning stance. The fusion draws its power from both the song and the whirl.

rites.name: Vineolanum
rites.text: A battle art practiced by mind-binding warriors, learned by overcoming a puzzling creature while a soul-binding skill is active. It lets a fighter strike with the rhythm of a raid.

rites.name: Saurnonia
rites.text: A combat discipline practiced by warriors of a lost fighting brotherhood, it channels force into a sudden expanding blast that scatters foes.

rites.name: Vilor Seonor
rites.text: A signature technique mastered by one wanderer, who learns it after finishing a grand trial. It is one of two defining arts that belong to this practitioner.

rites.name: Villerus
rites.text: A martial technique in which a blow forces an opponent off balance. It takes effect only on a foe already weakened by a prior breaking strike.

rites.name: Tellum
rites.text: A discipline of combat technique that only one specific practitioner can wield. She forms a green orb of energy and hurls it toward her foes, a refined variant of a more common homeward maneuver.

rites.name: Cianauror
rites.text: A learned sky-breaking craft that a wandering duelist can master after answering a rival's call to combat. It is counted among the two signature disciplines of its master.

rites.name: Nasolor
rites.text: A battle art that delivers a sudden, forceful strike. It belongs to a set of arts associated with a looping serpent-symbol tradition.

rites.name: Valaunia
rites.text: A swift rotating technique practiced by a warrior who wields a long lance. It belongs to the fighter's known repertoire of combat arts.

rites.name: Cirnaurum
rites.text: A bonded flame-technique shared by two companions, whose element is chosen by the blade one of them carries. It awakens once the pair begins a long journey toward a distant city.

rites.name: Reontium Teosum
rites.text: A martial technique of a single warrior that deals three times the usual harm when used against a foe who has been knocked off balance and brought low.

rites.name: Vasternum
rites.text: A bodily technique in which a fighter strikes with a rising leg after a spear-based assault, forcing the opponent off their footing. The user briefly drops to the ground afterward.

rites.name: Valiarnium Nerneosia
rites.text: A learned surge of inner energy that a seasoned fighter unlocks after reaching a high standing within their guild. It is a technique reserved for warriors who have advanced far in their discipline.

rites.name: Valornes Cialeoranum
rites.text: A battle craft used by mind-hackers, learned by overcoming a singular beast while a soul-tapping technique is active. It entangles foes in woven, sticky strands.

rites.name: Saures Valeolostia
rites.text: A binding affliction that seizes only aggressive combatants, leaving them unable to act while it lasts. Only one specific caster can impose it, and the traveling companions cannot.

rites.name: Tauntanum Lelor
rites.text: A whirling technique in which a wielder spins while cutting with a curved blade. It is one of the arts taught to users of a shifting saber.

rites.name: Amiarania
rites.text: A foe's sight pierces the minds of companions, letting their hurried blows drift past. Certain mental shocks or stuns dissolve this hold.

rites.name: Valinus Oreoles
rites.text: A tactic in which a fighter calls forth six crackling blades of charged essence that streak toward a chosen foe. The blades adjust their path until they strike their target.

rites.name: Teliantium Coreonanum
rites.text: A protective art that bends incoming blows back against their source, shaping the wearer's guard. It belongs to a family of aura disciplines and brings several other effects along with its reflection.

rites.name: Nernes Amistausia
rites.text: A fighter launches himself skyward and spins through the air, striking every foe close beneath him. Each blow stirs a little of his inner reserve of skill.

rites.name: Vianaurnes
rites.text: A special blade technique that unleashes a burst of radiant force from a sword's edge. It is a basic-tier art linked to a wielder's spiritual weapon.

rites.name: Vauneollor
rites.text: A battle discipline practiced by Mindweaver adepts that grows stronger once a specific fearsome beast has been overcome. It is claimed by triumphing over that creature while a mind-binding technique is active.

rites.name: Tauria
rites.text: A signature technique wielded by a single warrior, whose elemental nature shifts depending on the great blade he carries. Its power is tied directly to the weapon in hand.

rites.name: Serenus Valausalus
rites.text: A silent discipline taught to a single chosen student after a shared errand. It is one of two signature techniques that the student's teacher holds.

rites.name: Miallus Tintialium
rites.text: A sky-born discharge of force that a wielder calls upon through a grand, far-reaching edge of power. It is one of the arts of a particular practitioner who wields that great edge.

rites.name: Mianium Milium
rites.text: A channeled water art that grants a healing regeneration to its caster and nearby companions over time. Stacking channels combine their effects, and discharging one drains a portion of an enemy's vitality.

rites.name: Teleornor
rites.text: A ground-based weapon enhancement that lets a strike sometimes leave a drowsy stupor intact on its target rather than shaking it loose.

rites.name: Vaullontia
rites.text: A bearer's strongest technique, drawn from the blade they hold. The sword's nature decides the flavor of the surge, and it is the bearer's highest-tier special.

rites.name: Telaulia Nosium
rites.text: A bladed discipline in which the wielder mends their own wounds with every strike that lands in close combat. The power lingers in the aura surrounding the fighter for as long as it is kept active.

rites.name: Leornum Serantollia
rites.text: A battle art practiced by a single skilled marksman, who looses three rapid strikes that deal extra harm to constructed mechanical foes.

rites.name: Rausium Neornallum
rites.text: A paired volley of crackling force is hurled at a foe, striking with a charged arcane jolt. A mirrored form of this same craft is also known to another wielder.

rites.name: Laurnastia
rites.text: A wielder's trained combat technique that is only performed with a lesser blade before a sacred weapon is claimed. It unbalances an opponent's guard for a short span.

rites.name: Raulium Amirnor
rites.text: A high-tier special blade technique wielded in a fantasy combat system. It is ranked at the fourth level and belongs to a single named fighter.

rites.name: Coreosales
rites.text: A battle art that a sworn guardian of the storm-circle uses to shape the air around them. It belongs to a set of arts passed down by one serpent-bound lineage.

rites.name: Ralium Lelia
rites.text: A combat discipline practiced by mind-binders, learned by overcoming a rare sea beast while the binder's mental bond is active. It lets a fighter strike through an enemy's guard.

rites.name: Amasum
rites.text: A learned knack that lets a wanderer pass barriers, such as balancing across a taut line or scaling sheer faces. Such passages are marked with a small tool sign on the charts, and the knack is earned through trials of valor.

rites.name: Seolliror
rites.text: A sly combat technique practiced by mind-reavers, learned by overcoming a storm-bound spirit while a soul-piercing craft is active. It strikes with deceptive, misdirecting force.

rites.name: Mauniasum
rites.text: A paired discipline of striking that a wielder performs with a long spear-like weapon. It is counted among the techniques practiced by a single renowned practitioner.

rites.name: Taurnor
rites.text: A battle discipline practiced by a sworn fighting brotherhood, in which the wielder's strikes ring out each heartbeat, wounding nearby foes while drawing their attention and fury toward the warrior.

rites.name: Tarium
rites.text: A binding condition that fixes the attention of nearby foes onto one chosen combatant. It can be warded off by carrying sweet-herb sachets.

rites.name: Valarernum
rites.text: A discharge of stored inner energy that bursts out in a fan behind its wielder, harming foes in the arc. When the wielder's sustaining glows are lit, the surplus charge also staggers nearby enemies, leaving them briefly dazed.

rites.name: Lornalium
rites.text: A battle discipline wielded by a single bearer of a standard-bearing order, it lays down a field that steadily restores wounds for companions standing within it. The technique is a rarer offshoot of an older mending rite.

rites.name: Mausornes
rites.text: A fighting technique practiced by a swordsman who wields a glowing bladed weapon. It is one of the techniques the wielder performs when using such a blade.

rites.name: Coriantalum
rites.text: A fighting technique wielded by a warrior who carries a curved blade of catalytic metal. It is one of the arts this wielder can unleash when the blade is in hand.

rites.name: Amosia Sinanum
rites.text: A learned craft that lets a practitioner endure harsh conditions with growing resilience. It is unlocked by a seasoned strategist at a higher level of training and can be taken up by two particular wanderers.

rites.name: Sianentor
rites.text: A sticky, clinging art that a fighter links into a chained assault. It is the form a particular wielder draws upon when unleashing a combined strike.

rites.name: Teliarnus Amiallor
rites.text: A keen-edged technique of the blade that gathers air into a whirling cut. It is one of the arts available to a wielder who carries knives, and it reuses a broad sweeping stroke.

rites.name: Tauliasia
rites.text: A battle technique practiced by soul-tapping fighters, gained by vanquishing a corrupted boss while a soul-drain skill is active in the party. It lets the user siphon vitality from foes through a swift aerial strike.

rites.name: Rintaullum
rites.text: A slow, grinding maneuver used during a coordinated assault, relying on sustained pressure to wear down opponents. It belongs to a single warrior-user and is unleashed within a chained offensive.

rites.name: Riastes Seraunia
rites.text: A craft that can only be drawn upon while a seer's sight is awake. It belongs to one of the skill arts taught to a single practitioner.

rites.name: Valiarum Caules
rites.text: A swift cutting technique used by a wielder of a curved blade. It repeats a familiar double strike in a new form, letting the user press an advantage.

rites.name: Teonestium
rites.text: A user-wielded craft that bends the pull of the ground around its caster, sometimes locking nearby foes in place. Each foe thrown off their footing feeds a gathering inner reserve.

rites.name: Casia Nolia
rites.text: A combat technique practiced by mind-binders, learned only after overcoming a singular beast while a bond of spirit is being forged with an ally. It lets the practitioner unleash a rolling torrent of force upon foes.

rites.name: Visarnum
rites.text: A driving art performed by a wielder of the heavy spear-weapon. It is one of the techniques that the spear user can call upon in battle.

rites.name: Meornares
rites.text: A fighting technique wielded by a warrior who strikes with a paired blade-and-guard weapon. It reuses a powerful blow the wielder has already mastered.

rites.name: Miasus Narnoria
rites.text: A battle technique used only by one lone order of field healers. When wielded, it stores restorative energy in nearby companions and releases a portion of it once one of them is badly wounded.

rites.name: Linia
rites.text: A spinning blade technique wielded with paired knives, drawn from a repeating loop of motion. It is one of a wielder's arts for close combat.

rites.name: Tinaulium
rites.text: A combat technique that sends a forceful wave across a straight row of foes, striking each one in turn. It deals extra harm to enemies that take to the air.

rites.name: Telisornus
rites.text: A reflexive counter-technique learned from a wrathful conqueror. It lets a fighter answer an incoming strike with a swift retaliatory blow.

rites.name: Amaulles
rites.text: A heavy strike technique that a class of armored warriors unleashes with their great cleaving weapons. It sits at the fourth tier of mastery and is passed down among the male fighters who wield these blades.

rites.name: Corneorus
rites.text: A nimble fighting technique used by blade-wielding warriors who favor swift, precise strikes. It belongs to a particular martial discipline and cannot be fully mastered by any practitioner.

rites.name: Lentines
rites.text: A clear, rippling surge of cold water that a wielder can call forth as a finishing strike. It takes the place of an older icy wave once a particular blade has been obtained.

rites.name: Orelastia
rites.text: A stealthy technique that belongs to a blade-wielding discipline. It grows into a stronger form once a practitioner reaches the fifteenth rank of that discipline.

rites.name: Rialor Lontirnus
rites.text: A specialized technique used by female warriors of the common blade ranks. It is a level four art within a tiered system of combat skills.

rites.name: Oriseornes
rites.text: A nightbound craft that quickens a practitioner's rhythm of arts after dark, letting their practiced rites return sooner once the sky has turned black. It belongs to a branch of timid disciplines.

rites.name: Taror Liastintium
rites.text: A trained fighting discipline that sharpens the strikes of whatever blade a warrior holds. It adds a tenth to both the weakest and strongest blows dealt with the chosen weapon.

rites.name: Celum Menes
rites.text: A finishing strike that a wielder unlocks after gaining access to a particular blade. It takes the place of an earlier technique of the same kind.

rites.name: Salianium
rites.text: A fighting technique practiced by ordinary swordbearers who train to bring down great wild creatures. It lets them strike with focused force against monstrous foes.

rites.name: Ceollus
rites.text: A battle technique in which a fighter is joined by a retinue of allies. The skill is grouped among the combat arts of its world.

rites.name: Maustarum
rites.text: A combat technique that the wielder uses in battle. It is one of the fighting arts known to those who practice the blade.

rites.name: Lalirium
rites.text: A mighty blow delivered by hulking armored warriors who wield massive weapons. It is a fourth-tier special technique unlocked through training.

rites.name: Lalor Callia
rites.text: A withheld inner force that swells by a fifth when its bearer is badly wounded. It is the fourth technique in a line of endurance arts.

rites.name: Liastium Oralornanum
rites.text: A fighting technique that a warrior can call upon during battle. It is one of the combat skills known to the fighters of this world.

rites.name: Corauntia Riasteones
rites.text: A driver technique that lets a fighter strike with heavy, crushing blows. It is one of the skills a combat partner can use in battle.

rites.name: Amernes Meolles
rites.text: A quiet inner skill that a soul-worker gains from a restless wanderer. It lets its bearer conserve their vital reserves while acting.

rites.name: Seraulanum
rites.text: A combat technique that quiets the surrounding ground, leaving it still and barren. Its exact workings are left unexplained by the text.

rites.name: Reoranum Cauror
rites.text: A learned craft in which a practitioner works to undo structures and bonds that have been held together. It is listed among the driving arts used by travelers in a distant golden realm.

rites.name: Amastia Orontellus
rites.text: A discipline of constant readiness that steadily sharpens the nimbleness of a practitioner. It is the fourth technique within a devotional path of study.

rites.name: Siallia Raurum
rites.text: A tactic in which a fighter lets an opposing strike land and turns the momentum back. It is practiced by mighty blade-bearers who rely on heavy, forceful cuts.

rites.name: Ciniantia
rites.text: A glimmering support technique that lengthens the lingering effect of an ally's current enchantment. It works as a copy of an older, similar craft once taught to warriors.

rites.name: Valistum Amasonor
rites.text: A reinforced defensive art granted to a warden of the summoning order once they reach the fifth rank of their calling. It bolsters a guardian's ward against incoming harm.

rites.name: Telausum Riasor
rites.text: A learned craft that lets a bearer siphon half of a rival's gathered growth when snatching from them. The stolen portion is shared out among the companions instead of being claimed by the bearer alone.

rites.name: Orirneonium
rites.text: A martial skill held by warriors of a certain discipline. It is gained once a fighter reaches the fifth tier of their training, marking mastery of combat.

rites.name: Carnanum Telestanum
rites.text: A wandering knight's bearing that begins as a feeble skill used by a single lone traveler. The skill is lost when that traveler takes on a stronger shape.

rites.name: Rerum
rites.text: A tier-one protective technique wielded by female shield-hammer warriors of the common blade ranks. It lets them raise a defensive barrier against incoming harm.

rites.name: Miallernes
rites.text: A rank-two sky-tactic that a male fighter of the common blade caste uses in battle. It lets the warrior strike from the air to unleash a precise rush.

rites.name: Corarnus Vastintes
rites.text: A quick combat technique that a fighter can use in battle. It is part of a martial artist's repertoire, yet no one can fully master it.

rites.name: Nostiantum
rites.text: A heavy strike of great force used by towering spear-bearing fighters in battle. It is a technique of the rank-four tier.

rites.name: Coreollus Vianaulum
rites.text: A forbidden rite offered within a trial of the wise, binding a practitioner to a curse that quickens the links of their chain. It is taken up in a challenge set by a sage.

rites.name: Corollesia
rites.text: A fervent inner resolve that a hero draws out through a special soul-tapping craft. It is granted by a stalwart guardian who holds the old bastion of the wilds.

rites.name: Vinus Raustia
rites.text: A learned craft of striking foes while restoring the strength of the wielder. It is taught as a gift granted by a fearsome old crone of the wild.

rites.name: Toristium Taulanum
rites.text: A combat technique that a common warrior of the trade draws upon in battle to strengthen their striking power. It is practiced by ordinary fighters who wield blades.

rites.name: Coreostium Cianesia
rites.text: A heavy maneuver that a band of brawling lads performs in a sport played with spinning spheres. It is a special move unlocked at the fourth tier of mastery.

rites.name: Valilentia
rites.text: A guarded reserve of timed protection is granted by a calm sage to those who master the craft. It shields a bearer's soul for a brief span.

rites.name: Valones Serillanum
rites.text: A combat discipline that a fighter can learn and use during battle. It is one of the skills drawn from the wider set of trained fighting abilities.

rites.name: Aminallanum
rites.text: A driving discipline that a rider can learn to strike first in a race. It is one of the skills a driver masters in the chronicle of the golden country.

rites.name: Tilium Sasia
rites.text: A swift strike technique used by certain fighters who wield the claw-style blades. It is unlocked at the third tier of a fighter's special skills.

rites.name: Linosium
rites.text: A bright sharpening craft taught within a stone-cutting guild, reserved for those who reach a high standing in the trade. It quickens the allies' strikes and makes their blows land harder.

rites.name: Vaullium Rirnium
rites.text: A battle craft that lets an entire company gain a surge of swiftness for half a minute once a fight has begun well. It springs from the bonds of a shared fellowship.

rites.name: Amaulanum Oraustialor
rites.text: A coordinated skill that lets its wielders combine their blades for stronger strikes. It is one of the learned abilities a pilot can draw on during battle.

rites.name: Viastium Minium
rites.text: A practiced technique in which a fighter draws strange reactions out of mixed materials during combat. It belongs to the set of skills a warrior can call upon in battle.

rites.name: Teliales
rites.text: A combat technique that a fighter in the field can perform during battle. It belongs to the set of practised skills that warriors learn and use to turn the tide of a fight.

rites.name: Amaunes Virum
rites.text: A basic cutting technique that a certain class of blade-wielding warriors uses in battle. It is learned at the first level of skill.

rites.name: Serastillor
rites.text: A driver's technique belonging to a traveling guild of riders. It is recorded as one of the skills a driver can learn.

rites.name: Orentia Viastenia
rites.text: A basic close-range maneuver that a rough, heavy-handed brawler performs with spiked gauntlets, learned at the first tier of mastery. It is used by a common class of blade-wielding fighters.

rites.name: Valianintes
rites.text: A fighting technique that lets common warriors bend their defensive presence into a protective haze around their bodies. It is practised by the rank-and-file of their order.

rites.name: Niranum
rites.text: A keen perceptive art used by a serpent-bound wielder, letting its user see what lies hidden. It belongs to the coiling ring-serpent craft of the wielder's kind.

rites.name: Vastia Serornus
rites.text: A bearer's suffering is drawn inward and stored as a slow-building reserve of inner force. Every blow taken adds a small measure to that growing well of power.

rites.name: Veoria Corestaurus
rites.text: A learned talent that lets a combatant read the flow of fighting and respond with heightened skill. It belongs to a set of skills tied to driving forces within a larger wartime craft.

rites.name: Meontor Tirum
rites.text: A learned skill of unseen footwork that belongs to the shadow-hunter guild and awakens once a wanderer reaches the fifth rank. It makes an attacker more likely to strike empty air.

rites.name: Tintum Amianus
rites.text: A driver's combat technique that grants an advantage in the opening moments of a clash. It is one of the skills a driver can learn and use.

rites.name: Lanium Nistia
rites.text: A fifth technique in a warrior's heroic discipline. It shields the bearer against afflictions only when no other ward has already blocked them.

rites.name: Corillanum
