rites.text: A learned craft of transforming matter that a wanderer can practice as one of several trained abilities. It is listed among the skills a traveler can draw upon in the field.

rites.name: Raulanum Seraunanum
rites.text: A tainted offering given at a sage's proving-ground trial that quickens the bearer's unbidden strikes. It carries a burden alongside its boon.

rites.name: Selium Vaustonium
rites.text: A learned craft in which a fighter who stumbles back onto their feet may regain strength through a sudden stroke of fortune. It is taught to those who guide a mounted war-beast in the field.

rites.name: Valaselus
rites.text: A learned defensive craft in a branch of cautious doubt. When an opponent's blow goes wide, it slightly raises the chance of seizing a sudden counterstrike opening.

rites.name: Tanaurium
rites.text: A tempering rite that sharpens the strike opening a clash. Should the opening blow miss or fail to wound, the rite still claims its boon, though only the first strike of a volley is strengthened.

rites.name: Orirnium
rites.text: A fourth technique within a warrior's reckless discipline that ensures every paired strike also lands with decisive force.

rites.name: Sallosum
rites.text: A learned art of brewing remedies that a wandering herbalist teaches to a companion. It grants its bearer a special ability tied to the healing and mixing of potions.

rites.name: Coronintor
rites.text: A fighting discipline in which each slain foe may, by chance, lend a surge of strength to every companion in the band for a short span. Any warrior striking the final blow can set it off.

rites.name: Amania Restiania
rites.text: A fighter's opening technique that strengthens the first strike of a battle by half again its force. If the first strike misses or deals no harm, the advantage is still spent, and in a multi-part strike only the initial blow is empowered.

rites.name: Nialleorus
rites.text: A flowing battle technique that a fighter draws from running water to restore strength to their allies. It is taught as one of the close-combat arts of the wandering blades.

rites.name: Ciasor Tiantor
rites.text: A rare innate knack that lets a driver handle a vehicle with exceptional skill. It counts among the built-in abilities a driver can rely on in the field.

rites.name: Oreosum Telestum
rites.text: A driver's shout that lifts the spirits of allies in battle. It counts as one of the skills a driver can use while fighting.

rites.name: Risiarnum
rites.text: A performer's craft in which a fighter's flair for drama is channeled into their combat style. It is one of the driver techniques taught to those who guide mechanical beasts into battle.

rites.name: Coreornium Sostor
rites.text: A disciplined inner resolve that keeps a warrior's nerve from ever sinking to its lowest ebb, but only while a certain companion stands nearby. Her nerve may still dip to a lesser level.

rites.name: Oreontus Coraulum
rites.text: A bond-craft that belongs to a warden commander and awakens once a fighter reaches the fifth rank of their calling. It lets the wielder stand firm as a shield for their allies.

rites.name: Serelles
rites.text: A trained discipline that strengthens a wearer's guard against blows and arcane force while clad in moderate plate. It is the third mastery in a bearer's inner-resolve path of learning.

rites.name: Maunium Valintum
rites.text: A driving craft that lets a rider perceive the motion around a vehicle with heightened clarity. It is one of the skills a pilot can cultivate for guiding a mount through the wild.

rites.name: Nauror Tausalles
rites.text: A driver-trained craft that lets a practitioner borrow vitality for a short span. It is one of the recognized skills taught among the drivers of the Golden Country.

rites.name: Ciallauntes
rites.text: A learned craft by which practitioners bend the unseen current that fills the air. It is taught as one of several disciplines within a larger tradition of arcane arts.

rites.name: Toses Coraullanum
rites.text: A driving technique held as one of the skilled arts of the road. It is recorded among the driver's crafts of the land, though little else about it is set down.

rites.name: Teosanum Taulantes
rites.text: A healing discipline practiced by a ceremonial caster guild, unlocked once a practitioner reaches the highest rank of their order. It is a restorative technique bound to the caster's hands.

rites.name: Tintia Leornesus
rites.text: A driving technique that a rider can learn and use to improve their skill behind the wheel. It is one of several skills recorded for those who pilot vehicles.

rites.name: Seontines
rites.text: A learned talent that lets a fighter sharpen their instincts in combat. It is one of the driver skills a warrior can draw upon in the field.

rites.name: Cerasum
rites.text: A mysterious craft that enlarges things beyond their natural scale. Practitioners use it in an ancient walled quarter to sharpen perception and reach hidden details.

rites.name: Valeorelus
rites.text: A driving technique that a skilled pilot can call upon during combat. It belongs to the set of skills tied to piloting machines, and it comes into play while the driver is at the controls.

rites.name: Amalles Miarnor
rites.text: A combat technique practiced in a fighting tradition. Its details are not yet recorded, so it stands as a named skill among others of its kind.

rites.name: Narnus Sanus
rites.text: A minor fortune-bringing craft that a wanderer can draw upon during travel. It is said to tilt chance slightly in the user's favour.

rites.name: Serenia
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter sharply warns an ally of an incoming threat. It is one of the battle skills a warrior can learn and use during fights.

rites.name: Lalistia
rites.text: A bodily discipline that grants its bearer immunity to weakening afflictions. It is the fourth technique within a branch of supple, adaptable arts.

rites.name: Talaustia
rites.text: A driving craft that lets a rider cover great distances swiftly. It is one of the skills a driver can learn while traveling through a golden country.

rites.name: Ranor Siantor
rites.text: A battle technique in which a warrior projects an aura of command that weakens the resolve of foes. It is a minor skill, learned in the ranks of a fighting order.

rites.name: Corolliares
rites.text: A radiant technique of combat that a fighter can call upon during battle. It is listed among the skills known to those who wield blades in the field.

rites.name: Valinelum
rites.text: A mournful hymn of the wounded who press forward toward a radiant glow. Its sung version is chanted by cloistered singers within a sacred hall, lifting weary spirits.

rites.name: Moraurnium
rites.text: A bitter craft in which a wronged fighter draws strength from an ally's fall. For thirty heartbeats after a companion is struck down, the fighter gains a surge of power.

rites.name: Corium Vestiranum
rites.text: A bright vocal retelling of an older tune, sung by a choir. It speaks of a lonely soul met in the night, of fragile wings, and of a light that guides another through darkness.

rites.name: Telaureolor
rites.text: A learned craft of tending wounds and sickness that grows stronger when practiced among a community of companions. It is the second discipline in a healer's path of devotion.

rites.name: Liantes
rites.text: A defensive technique that a common fighter uses to weather flames. It lets the user endure heat in battle.

rites.name: Riasolum
rites.text: A practiced technique that a driver can learn to strengthen the body's muscles. It is one of several trained abilities that drivers hone to improve their combat performance.

rites.name: Amarnum Rerneosia
rites.text: A third discipline in a wise path of restraint that eases a steady drain felt during quiet hours. Only one practitioner's gift applies at a time, so companions cannot combine it.

rites.name: Liastes Veliaria
rites.text: A driver's trained technique of rapid, precise foot movement that lets a fighter reposition swiftly during combat. It belongs to a set of learned battle abilities used by those who pilot large mechanical allies.

rites.name: Leones
rites.text: A skill that its wielder gains after reaching a high standing in a specific calling. It belongs to the strategist's craft and reshapes how that role's power is used.

rites.name: Velianium
rites.text: A combat art that hurls searing fire from the hand of a fighter. It is one of the battle skills practiced by warriors in its world.

rites.name: Nollasor
rites.text: A stored craft that a fighter can tap to briefly swell their limbs with strength. It is one of the trained techniques a driver of war-beasts can rely on in battle.

rites.name: Tirollum
rites.text: A driver's inherited talent that the text names as one of the skills used by drivers. It is a trait a bearer can draw upon during their duties.

rites.name: Corilles Tilliantum
rites.text: A bold warrior's spirit that often swells a fighter's endurance when a clash begins, though the wounds already held do not heal to match. The surge lingers briefly before fading back.

rites.name: Orontirnium
rites.text: A deadly combat technique that a fighter uses to finish an opponent with a single cold, precise blow. It is one of the trained maneuvers practiced in battle.

rites.name: Coroneles
rites.text: A tireless craft of the mind that lifts the drain on gains from slain foes, so that a student keeps earning whether or not they march with the company.

rites.name: Resium
rites.text: A fiery technique that a swordsman unlocks after gaining his blade. It strikes with a final blow that replaces a lesser move in his repertoire.

rites.name: Serelinum
rites.text: A fierce close-quarters technique wielded by warriors of a bladed fighting order. It is a high-tier strike that only certain fighters among their brotherhood can unleash.

rites.name: Sianauntor
rites.text: A practiced wearer gains a steady boost to protection from light armour against both blows and magical harm. It is the fourth technique in a discipline of careful restraint.

rites.name: Varnum Neror
rites.text: A learned craft of mending wounds and easing ailments through practiced skill. It is one of the abilities a traveling companion can carry into battle.

rites.name: Rostesia Cares
rites.text: A bearer releases a burst of frozen force from their own body rather than hurling it outward. Every foe nearby is struck and left numbed by the cold.

rites.name: Cialirnus
rites.text: A bearer's inner resolve swells, lending a tenth more force to every blow that lands. It is the fourth craft drawn from the valor path.

rites.name: Tontia Roraunia
rites.text: A field skill that gives a bearer a stirring sense of fairness. It is reserved for a single wielder and cannot be shared.

rites.name: Valornus Sentolus
rites.text: A first-tier technique of a gentle wielder's path, it strengthens her strikes in linked assaults, but only while a particular companion stands beside her in battle.

rites.name: Orinellium
rites.text: A martial discipline within a heroic training path that heightens the force of each blow the wielder delivers, adding a quarter more harm to every strike.

rites.name: Miarnor Amallus
rites.text: A calm inner discipline that lets a wanderer merge with the surrounding terrain. It is passed to a student by a wise elder who teaches the bond with the earth.

rites.name: Siarausium
rites.text: A fighting technique that a common bladed warrior uses to keep a battle going for a long stretch. It is a learned combat art shared among ordinary sword-wielders.

rites.name: Saria Serontes
rites.text: A charged technique that lets a heavy-blade wielder push past normal limits. It is practiced by brawny fighters who wield a particular class of common sword.

rites.name: Laustiantus Maraurnum
rites.text: A driver's learned technique that a rider can call upon during the ride. It belongs to the set of skills used by those who steer and handle the machines.

rites.name: Amenes
rites.text: A driver's trained technique of drawing a companion's attention away toward another direction. It belongs to the set of skills a pilot can cultivate and call upon.

rites.name: Seonium Nintollia
rites.text: A craft bound to a fallen company of wanderers, one that its practitioners can pursue but never fully master. It carries the weight of the oath that the company once swore.

rites.name: Meornones
rites.text: A bare-handed dodging art taught by a guild of tricksters, letting a fighter slip past blows meant for them. It is granted as a special technique to those who earn a master's favor.

rites.name: Serialium Valausor
rites.text: A sung hymn that accompanies a gathering of devoted listeners inside a stone sanctuary. Its shared melody echoes through several solemn moments of a sealed dreaming realm.

rites.name: Amolasanum
rites.text: A learned composure that softens the sting of a failed strike. When a blow goes wide or is turned aside, the bearer loses less ground than before, and a parried attack costs far less.

rites.name: Telantorium
rites.text: A courtly assistant technique that a ranked helper teaches to a soul-binding practitioner. It is learned through a lesson given by a lowly, clumsy retainer.

rites.name: Teosanum Viallia
rites.text: A combat technique practiced in a hidden land of gilded plains. It belongs to a set of fighting skills used in battle.

rites.name: Corasorium
rites.text: A learned ward that a companion can raise to lift the spirits of their allies. When a battle begins on good terms, it often bolsters the group for a short while.

rites.name: Tinanum Ameolloses
rites.text: A quick, catlike technique that a fighter can call upon in battle to move swiftly. It is one of the combat skills available to warriors in this world.

rites.name: Leseonanum
rites.text: A quiet technique a wandering fighter can draw upon during the heat of a clash. It is listed among the hidden arts that a traveling mount-rider may learn.

rites.name: Amontisor
rites.text: A raw surge of force that hardened warriors unleash from their own bodies, marking the lowest tier of a brutal fighting art practiced by the unrefined brawlers of the lower ranks.

rites.name: Miranum Cillus
rites.text: A high-tier special technique that fighters of a certain blade-wielding caste perform. It is mastered at the fourth rank of skill and is reserved for the female practitioners of the order.

rites.name: Meollistum
rites.text: A bearer's ability to mend wounds far beyond ordinary healing, granted as a learned skill. It is one of the lesser known skills a bearer may draw upon in the tale.

rites.name: Oreornanum Amerisium
rites.text: A learned gift of trust that strengthens the healing crafts a bearer uses after being forewarned of a vision. It deepens the force of mending when the bearer has been shown what is coming.

rites.name: Nianor Centaulles
rites.text: A quiet thrust of a piercing weapon that a fighter can unleash in battle. It is one of the combat techniques a warrior learns to strike foes without warning.

rites.name: Ciastosor
rites.text: A combat technique that a fighter can use during battle. It is one of the fighting arts known in this world's contests of skill.

rites.name: Telolus Vostialor
rites.text: A battle technique practiced by common fighters who wield their blades. It is a skill that lets them strike with added weight and force in combat.

rites.name: Serentus Orauliastia
rites.text: A warming technique that a fighter uses to lift the spirit and strength of an ally and nearby companions. It is a support art taught in the craft of combat.

rites.name: Teliastenus
rites.text: A deadly strike technique that a warrior unlocks once they gain access to a particular blade. It takes the place of an earlier finishing move in the fighter's repertoire.

rites.name: Collor Liastornium
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter clears their thoughts entirely so that instinct alone guides every strike. It is practiced as a fleeting skill called upon in the heat of battle.

rites.name: Sornia Amiarnum
rites.text: A learned knack for a fighter to bring foes crashing down, held by a skilled pilot of a mechanical steed. Its mastery sharpens the rider's control in battle.

rites.name: Contasus
rites.text: A bearer who wears no adornments gains a bonus to several of their core abilities. The bonus applies only while nothing is set into their gear.

rites.name: Nirnes Amornalus
rites.text: A bearer's once-per-battle surge that awakens a radiant inner sight when their resolve reaches its peak. It is tied to a wielder of the Ferrin Eye.

rites.name: Lauses Teontor
rites.text: A learned habit of unbroken attentiveness that a wary traveller carries, letting them notice danger before it closes in. It is practised as one of the craft-skills taught to those who guide a mount through dangerous country.

rites.name: Vinontum
rites.text: A high-ranking technique performed by the warriors of a blade-bearing caste. It is wielded only by male fighters who have reached its fourth tier.

rites.name: Rauristia
rites.text: A fifth discipline within a fiery training path, it grants every companion a surge of strength for a short span whenever a focused flare of power lands true.

rites.name: Nisornor
rites.text: Nisornor is a concept of the Drerdunen universe, the idea of a sworn bond that held the broken worlds together after the Sundering. It is remembered in the groves of the first sovereign's age as the pattern that let growing kingdoms keep their promises to the shards.

rites.name: Sollaurnum
rites.text: A ground-bound arm-augment that stirs the bearer's flowing voice so a finishing strike lands more often. It sharpens the chance of an elegant killing blow.

rites.name: Valostum
rites.text: A close-combat fighting technique that a wanderer starts with, and that certain practitioners learn after gaining skill. It is used in hand-to-hand battle.

rites.name: Amauntalus
rites.text: A supporting craft that channels luminous energy to restore an ally's vitality. Against a mechanical war-frame it also mends all of its damaged limbs, at a steep cost of inner reserve.

rites.name: Malus
rites.text: A learned hearth-art lets a certain traveler cook pouch rations at camp from gathered finds. Its recipes are unique to that one cook and come only as rewards for completed tasks.

rites.name: Corontum
rites.text: A tactic of striking foes from hiding, taught by informants who sell its knowledge in the market of a border town.

rites.name: Riastanum
rites.text: A battle technique that sharpens the wielder's aim for a short span, and the heightened focus carries over when the wielder swaps weapons. Certain tokens and gear can strengthen its effect and lengthen how long it lasts.

rites.name: Vintium
rites.text: A airborne cutting technique used by a wielder of a blade-shaped focus. It is one of the arts available to a particular fighter when armed with that weapon.

rites.name: Laurinor
rites.text: A tuned craft-augment that lets a fighter draw back a modest portion of lost vitality each time a practiced technique is executed in the field.

rites.name: Vaulanum
rites.text: A special kind of beneficial enchantment that bearers can hold only one of at a time. Some mantles are unique to particular beings, and certain powers must have one active before they can be unleashed.

rites.name: Liarnor
rites.text: A battle technique known only to one practitioner, a variant of a stronger strike. It is used as a combat art within a larger tradition of fighting skills.

rites.name: Amontium
rites.text: A coiled discipline of combat that dissolves a foe into scattered fragments. It belongs to a set of serpent-circle techniques held by a single wielder.

rites.name: Taustanum
rites.text: A sustaining rite that replenishes a bound engine's reserve whenever its radiant guardian is called forth. It lets a warden keep the armored mantle running without stopping to refill.

rites.name: Vastia
rites.text: A carved stance-token lets a bearer strike a foe from behind with greater force while drawing less notice. Its surge fades after a short span, then gathers again on its own.

rites.name: Renaurnia
rites.text: A tumbling technique in which a wielder hurls a volatile sphere while flipping through the air. It is performed with a particular carried sphere and, in one version, with a small beast companion.

rites.name: Orauntia
rites.text: A warrior's craft that wraps the user in a watchful aura, marking a chosen foe and sharpening strikes with every blow evaded. Each dodge builds momentum for the next attack.

rites.name: Lonum
rites.text: A nimble shooting technique that a rank-two marksman can learn. Several members of the band are able to perform it.

rites.name: Corarenia
rites.text: A signature technique wielded by a fighter with a two-form blade. In its altered state, the same strike transforms into a darker variant.

rites.name: Rosia
rites.text: A supporting technique that extends the lasting glow of a sustained energy field by a short span. A second, slightly altered form of the same technique is known to another practitioner.

rites.name: Tiasor Nolus
rites.text: A tuned skill-rune that can be set into a warrior's blade. Whenever the wielder performs a practiced technique, it stirs a surge of inner vigor that grows strong with each use.

rites.name: Orilastes
rites.text: A battle discipline practiced only by one order of field healers, who gain it after reaching mastery of their craft. It lessens the harm a warrior takes in each contested zone.

rites.name: Sauniarium
rites.text: A lingering enchantment that strikes anyone who casts a spell within the marked zone. The harm equals double the strength of whoever laid the ward, and it bypasses all armor or resistance.

rites.name: Nantorum
rites.text: A battle technique that a warrior can learn after completing a particular training trial. It is one of two signature techniques belonging to a single fighter.

rites.name: Corauntus
rites.text: A tuned inner ember that mends its bearer with each decisive strike, returning a portion of the harm dealt. It can also be fitted into mechanical companions as a secondary core.

rites.name: Naureornes
rites.text: A forceful technique drawn from a craft of shield-bearers. When its opening strike lands, it knocks the target off balance.

rites.name: Telirestia
rites.text: A linked sequence of elemental strikes performed by bladed fighters, where each successive hit must match a rising strength tier. Successful chains increase harm dealt and can seal a foe's ability to trigger a lasting effect.

rites.name: Orelles
rites.text: A stunning condition that dazes a target, wiping away its lingering enchantments and leaving it unable to evade. Attackers strike it with perfect precision, and a dazed foe will interrupt its own spellcraft.

rites.name: Telianium
rites.text: A hidden technique that a serpent-winged hunter gains after training to a second tier of mastery. It lets the practitioner strike deeper into prey.

rites.name: Cernorum
rites.text: A combat technique a wielder of a great reaping blade can unleash, a whirling storm-like strike drawn from a serpentine sky guardian. It is unlocked only after completing a second, harder run through the journey.

rites.name: Neosorus
rites.text: A ground-borne enhancement that sharpens the strikes of all ray-based arms and rites. It intensifies the harm they deal to foes.

rites.name: Taustium
rites.text: A glowing sphere of crackling energy that a wielder can call upon as a special technique with a blade. It also serves as a signature art used in hired-assault missions.

rites.name: Santor
rites.text: A snare that roots a victim in place so they cannot step away. Allies cannot shake it loose, yet the trapped can still strike or cast within reach of their foe.

rites.name: Vaustiranum
rites.text: A mental technique that jolts a foe into stillness, freezing their movements. It has a good chance to dispel a frenzied state clouding their mind, though weak resolve makes it less reliable.

rites.name: Teleones
rites.text: A fighting technique practiced by a gunner of the warrior-marksman craft, unlocked once the practitioner reaches the seventh rank of mastery.

rites.name: Cilanum
rites.text: A bound technique of a practitioner who channels a spinning chain-art during an assault. It is the signature method used by a single named wielder in attacks.

rites.name: Miastares
rites.text: A protective enchantment that lets a bearer dodge every blow for a limited number of strikes. Once too many hits land, the shield fades, and rapid multi-strike techniques can break through it quickly.

rites.name: Nintor
rites.text: A surge of heightened strength that a fighter can call upon. It makes the blows that strike true spots hit with greater force.

rites.name: Amostaulor
rites.text: A trained technique that empowers a wielder's strikes landing on an enemy's rear side, while lessening the wrath such blows provoke. The strength persists even when the wielder swaps weapons mid-battle.

rites.name: Rirnum
rites.text: A forceful technique that a wielder of a particular twin-edged blade can unleash. It is one of the techniques available to that wielder when the blade is in its Big Bang form.

rites.name: Nenostium
rites.text: A reinforcing craft that a war-machine's armed bearer can attach to its weapons, letting strikes break the limbs of rival machines more effectively. It mirrors a longer-range version of the same technique.

rites.name: Oriseostium
rites.text: A dimming sickness that clouds a combatant's aim and blunts their strikes, while their ability to dodge slips away. Ranged blows lose much of their force under its shadow.

rites.name: Amellia
rites.text: A combat technique wielded by a warrior bearing a crescent blade, drawn from an earlier martial method. It reuses the energy of a fierce strike to deliver a disorienting follow-up.

rites.name: Naulia
rites.text: A practitioner's craft that raises a shield of force around the caster to soak up incoming harm. If enough harm is soaked, the caster is roused into a heightened state, but they stay frozen until the ward fades, and the ward grants nothing unless something strikes it.

rites.name: Valistia
rites.text: A foe-only aura that surrounds its bearer and grants a special effect tied to the particular art that activates it. These effects tend to strike outward against enemies.

rites.name: Tiantes
rites.text: A lingering condition that amplifies the harm a fighter inflicts whenever a precise, decisive strike lands. Its added bonus stacks with the usual strike enhancement, so the blow lands much harder than either would alone.

rites.name: Amerium
rites.text: A grappling-style technique wielded through heavy gauntlets by a fighter. It is a secondary maneuver learned after completing a journey a second time, and it reuses an earlier throw.

rites.name: Tiasum
rites.text: A restorative technique that a tuned mind-weaver can learn at an early tier of training. It lulls the target into a calming slumber that eases fatigue.

rites.name: Casor Nirus
rites.text: A temporary hindrance that weakens a bearer's strength or speed, opposite of an uplifting boon. It can be inflicted by storms or combat techniques and eased by a counter-technique or by waiting it out.

rites.name: Tantus
rites.text: A fighting technique practiced with clawed hand-gauntlets, used by a single warrior. It is one of her signature combat moves when wearing those claws.

rites.name: Seriastirum
rites.text: A bundle of restorative energy drawn through a practitioner's inner channels. It clears away lingering afflictions from one companion and shields them briefly against new ones.

rites.name: Serellium
rites.text: A restorative technique that clears every hindering affliction currently weighing on its wielder. It can be learned by certain attendants through a special system reset card, though its recovery timing depends on the rank of their gear.

rites.name: Mirneostor
rites.text: A spinning blade technique wielded by a fierce fighter, unlocked at a higher tier of skill. It is also that fighter's signature move during raid missions against hired soldiers.

rites.name: Riallornum
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a wielder strikes upward twice with paired whip-blades and then leaps to bring a downward slash that unleashes blue flame onto an opponent.

rites.name: Vestanum
rites.text: A forceful striking technique wielded through a heavy gauntlet, reshaped from an older blow. It is unlocked by a worthy wanderer who returns to the trials after the tale's ending.

rites.name: Amentum
rites.text: A combat technique wielded by a specific class of fighters, learned only after overcoming a rare, singular foe while a mental-intrusion skill is active. It unleashes a focused beam meant to erase its target.

rites.name: Corinaurus
rites.text: A fleeting combat technique in which a fighter strikes in the space between heartbeats. It is one of the arts used by a single warrior in a party during an opening chapter and a special challenge clash.

rites.name: Collintium
rites.text: A fighter strings together a set sequence of practiced strikes against a foe. Each strike sets up the next, so the enemy is first staggered, then knocked aside, then lifted, and finally broken, rewarding the attacker with restoring draughts and loot.

rites.name: Meostes
rites.text: A charged striking technique that a wielder of a particular blade can unleash. It belongs to one fighter's repertoire and is performed only while using a specific edge.

rites.name: Miarnires
rites.text: A rough, unscrupulous fighting technique learned by shield-bearing guards once they reach a certain standing in their ranks. It teaches them to win battles through underhanded tactics.

rites.name: Telirnor
rites.text: A tuned weakening of a bearer's inner guard against mystic force, so that arcane blows strike harder. When laid upon a foe, the guard can sink past nothing into a deeper vulnerability.

rites.name: Ameorium
rites.text: A physical technique that may leave an opponent unable to move. When performed right after a bone-breaking strike, it can also slow the enemy's speed.

rites.name: Cialleorus
rites.text: A brutal physical technique with a heavy strike that, when it finishes a foe, knocks down every nearby enemy in reach unless they resist. When the killing blow lands, a crimson mist rises from the fallen.

rites.name: Tiarium
rites.text: A tribal rallying chant that a companion sings when a battle opens with a long-reaching weapon. Its call rouses the group and steadies their attack.

rites.name: Ceollium Senum
rites.text: A high-rank special strike of a blade, one of the tiered forceful arts of a bladed war-form. It is called upon in combat.

rites.name: Serariantum
rites.text: A signature technique belonging to one particular wielder, usable regardless of their training. It is awakened during a clash with a rival near the start of a long journey.

rites.name: Salonus
rites.text: A whirling technique used by a wielder of a long-bladed weapon, in which a spinning strike is renewed again and again. It draws on a familiar spinning motion to rebuild its force.

rites.name: Liantolor
rites.text: A coiled art of grace that drives a sudden storm of motion through a chained strike. It belongs to one wielder and comes into play only when a chain attack is underway.

rites.name: Vaunellum
rites.text: A bearer's charged reserve automatically erupts once full, doubling the force of their elemental strikes and unlocking two finishing techniques.

rites.name: Coreostium
rites.text: A fighting technique wielded by a bladed relic, which reuses the force of an earlier crushing strike. It belongs to the arts of a single wielder and renews a former blow.

rites.name: Maularor
rites.text: A violent striking technique that arcs crackling force through an opponent's body. When it follows a sweeping gust attack, it can shatter the foe's guard and leave them vulnerable.

rites.name: Mirnosus
rites.text: A heavy wielding technique that a bearer performs with a shield-hammer, pressing a massive weight down through the strike. It is one of the arts a single practitioner may master.

rites.name: Reontinium
rites.text: A learned technique of the forge-crafters that releases a lingering field of heat. Those who stand inside it are scorched steadily, losing a portion of their strength each moment.

rites.name: Corausirum
rites.text: A crystal-hard strike technique wielded with a blade, used as a special move in combat. It can also be unleashed as a signature finishing maneuver during ambush-style raids.

rites.name: Nestanum
rites.text: A guarded technique that a sturdy shield-bearer learns once they reach a seasoned rank. It lets two fighters from a band of wanderers turn incoming blows back upon the attacker.

rites.name: Lalor Launus
rites.text: A fighting discipline that grants its practitioners extra vitality and stronger close-combat strikes. It can only be reached by advancing from a particular gunner path, and mastering it lets a wielder use rifles and long blades regardless of their own training.

rites.name: Miarastia
rites.text: A chain-bound art that a wielder unleashes during a linked assault. It belongs to a single gifted fighter who channels it when the attack chain begins.

rites.name: Orellium
rites.text: A driving technique used by a rider who controls a small spherical vehicle. It is one of the signature maneuvers this rider can perform when piloting that sphere.

rites.name: Lirnastia
rites.text: A glowing aura that hastens a fighter's other techniques so they recharge faster. While it lingers, the bearer stays rooted in place and cannot strike with ordinary blows.

rites.name: Vanialles
rites.text: A hex that turns a foe's attack back on itself, reflecting a stored element onto the one who carries it. If the reflected strike lands while the warning still hangs in the air, it strikes its sender instead.

rites.name: Siallor
rites.text: A technique that a wielder can call upon after first invoking a prior sword discipline. It is gained during a clash against a sovereign of a distant realm.

rites.name: Vernistium
rites.text: A rear-guard art practiced in one realm, known by a second name in another tongue. It is counted among the defensive disciplines of its people.

rites.name: Ameseonia
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter channels built-up force into a single blow that erupts on contact. It is classed among the battle arts practiced by warriors.

rites.name: Mentes
rites.text: A bearer's shield-craft that softens every blow taken from foes. Its protections add together with other guards, yet a struck bearer always feels at least a faint sting.

rites.name: Corisia
rites.text: A binding craft in which a marked person who suffers harm passes the same wound to companions standing close by. Stronger wards only widen the circle within which the suffering is shared.

rites.name: Coreolus
rites.text: A forceful striking technique wielded with a heavy shield-mallet, used by a single famed practitioner. It is a learned martial art that channels explosive impact through a blow.

rites.name: Tanium
rites.text: A lingering curse that spreads across a group of travelers, striking the chosen ones down once a short countdown runs out. It can sometimes be shrugged off by those who resist it, and it shows no visible sign beyond a brief marker beside the victim's name.

rites.name: Leonium
rites.text: A learned craft in which a practitioner trades inner vitality with another, and the knowledge is passed to a student who finishes a particular trial of arms and character.

rites.name: Teliasteror
rites.text: A learned craft in which a fighter draws stored mana into their own body to restore spent energy. It becomes available to a warrior once they reach the first rank of their specialized combat path.

rites.name: Rianaustum
rites.text: A combat technique drawn from a disciplined vanguard tradition. It channels charged energy across a practitioner's surroundings to strike at foes.

rites.name: Corisus
rites.text: A forceful ground-shaking technique wielded by a sturdy fighter wearing stone-breaking gauntlets. It can be learned by continuing a finished journey and it reuses an earlier surprise strike.

rites.name: Neranum
rites.text: A practiced technique that drains a foe's inner reserve of magic and channels part of it into its user. The drain grows stronger when several opponents are caught within its reach.

rites.name: Liania Launtium
rites.text: A glowing arcane essence that a blade draws upon as a special technique. It is a high-tier form of power that empowers the wielder's strike.

rites.name: Tines
rites.text: A signature craft wielded by one bearer among a pair of their trained arts. It is taught to a seeker once they finish a particular errand in a settlement.

rites.name: Risia
rites.text: A ground weapon enhancement that lengthens how long a critical strike empowerment lasts. It alters the timing of a weapon's heightened power rather than its raw strength.

rites.name: Saurnentus
rites.text: A timed enchantment that freezes the ticking clocks of lingering blessings and aura effects for as long as it holds. Those boons neither fade nor count down while the freeze lasts.

rites.name: Lestianum
rites.text: A paired blade technique performed by a wielder who holds a single crystal sword. It is one of the arts available to a particular swordsman when he wields that weapon.

rites.name: Valontales
rites.text: A stance in which a creature plants itself and cannot move or strike, yet takes less harm from blows and shrugs off efforts to slow it. Its limbs guard the face, but they wear down just as fast as usual.

rites.name: Valum
rites.text: A combat technique in which a bearer strikes with a clenched hand that carries explosive force. It is one of the signature methods used by a fighter who wears knuckle-mounted claws.

rites.name: Serorum
rites.text: A tuning rite that lengthens how long a gleaming protective glow lingers around a wearer's plate. It is set into armor and works alongside the glows themselves.

rites.name: Telirnarium
rites.text: A crackling discipline wielded through paired blades that grows fiercer as the wielder's vitality wanes. Its strikes hit harder the closer the bearer comes to falling.

rites.name: Telosanum
rites.text: A guiding voice that stirs within the mind when a companion opens combat with a close-quarters blade. It always calls for a close-combat technique, no matter how the weapon has been shaped.

rites.name: Nilor Sastianum
rites.text: A discipline that splits a practitioner's inner power into eight parts. It is an art of the mind that draws on a serpent-like cycle of renewal.

rites.name: Corauntum
rites.text: A bearer calls forth an aura that marks nearby foes for pursuit and sharpens the pull of a taunting cry. A companion of the bearer also draws on this practice.

rites.name: Veornontor
rites.text: A sword-technique relic that its wielder channels alongside a great storm-forged edge. It is one of the arts bound to that wielder's storm-strike.

rites.name: Sanium
rites.text: A resonant chant that rises within the bearer whenever a foe's limb is torn away. It answers each severed appendage with a surge of inner force.

rites.name: Telosauntor
rites.text: A practitioner steps backward and then hurls a vast burst of volatile energy at a foe. It is one of the skills drawn from a particular discipline.

rites.name: Sarum
rites.text: A paired technique that a wielder may study after completing a particular trial. It belongs to one of the two signature disciplines of a named practitioner, drawing on two sources of power at once.

rites.name: Oriastum
rites.text: A blessing that lets strikes occasionally cut down a foe in one blow, sending its life to nothing. It only works on certain creature kinds, and mighty bosses resist it entirely.

rites.name: Vinterum
rites.text: A synchronized assault of dark strikes performed by the wielder's companions, unleashed as a special blade technique at the highest tier of mastery.

rites.name: Telausium
rites.text: A deadly combat technique practiced by a class of mechanical killers. It is learned as a mastered skill once the practitioner reaches the tenth tier of their training.

rites.name: Rantor
rites.text: A lingering enchantment that speeds the renewal of a bearer's ready powers. Their timed charms recover faster, and their gift-arts gather strength more quickly with each strike or swap.

rites.name: Sastor Lernolanum
rites.text: A signature maneuver used by a certain performer when wielding a spherical striking device. A wing-like strike that the performer also employs when commanding a different companion creature.

rites.name: Amastes Ameleosus
rites.text: A dull hex that clings to a bearer and dulls their ability to dodge incoming harm. Trained wardens use it to slow fleeing foes.

rites.name: Seornelor
rites.text: A creeping weariness that settles into a fighter's limbs and dulls their strikes. Blows dealt in close combat, both ordinary swings and trained combat maneuvers, land with less force.

rites.name: Amalia
rites.text: A combat discipline practiced by warriors of the heavy-armor school. It draws on the rapid firing of many projectiles at once to overwhelm a foe.

rites.name: Caneostus
rites.text: A combat art that lets a warrior slip past blows aimed at them. When a fighter's nimbleness matches or exceeds the foe's aim, the strike may be sidestepped with high odds.

rites.name: Corellia
rites.text: A resonant voice that sounds when a companion delivers the decisive strike against a foe. It answers the final moment of a struggle with a brief call from the group.

rites.name: Coreostanum
rites.text: A stormy technique belonging to a rear guard discipline of skilled fighters. It is used to defend a retreating or vulnerable position.

rites.name: Nilor Vausellanum
rites.text: A frost-bearing strike technique wielded by a blade-user, drawn from a second-tier skill and changing into a darker form when the user shifts into a dreamlike state. It also serves as the user's signature finishing move in certain hired-fight trials.

rites.name: Talleostes
rites.text: A forceful striking technique performed with a paired twin-blade weapon. It is one of a wielder's signature moves and is built from a rising blow that is reused from an older strike.

rites.name: Riarnus
rites.text: A battle art practiced by one specialist class of fighters, allowing its user to restore health to several allies at once. It belongs to the arts of the healer-gunner discipline.

rites.name: Meonaurnia
rites.text: A signature blade-art technique belonging to one fighter, usable as a special move during a particular kind of hired-combat mission. It is unlocked as a higher-tier special ability.

rites.name: Amelliarnus
rites.text: A raider's technique in which the wielder thrusts a blade forward with great force after readying the weapon. It becomes a fully mastered form once the practitioner reaches the highest standing in their discipline.

rites.name: Seroselor
rites.text: A combat discipline practiced by a class of mind-binders, learned after overcoming a singular fearsome beast while a binding skill is active. It lets a fighter strike rapidly in a flurry of blows.

rites.name: Teliastus
rites.text: A learned bodily discipline that lets a practitioner slip past incoming blows while drawing every hostile eye toward herself. It shields companions by turning the attention of foes onto the one performing it.

rites.name: Orallaurnus
rites.text: A fiery crescent-shaped strike that a warrior launches from a blade to hit foes at a distance. It is a basic technique taught to young fighters in the training halls.

rites.name: Miantia
rites.text: A glide technique practiced by a rider using a sphere-shaped mount, letting them skim across open air. It is one of the signature maneuvers of a particular wielder who also uses a small furred companion creature in some traditions.

rites.name: Colium
rites.text: A ranged combat technique where a shooter hurls a single fiery orb at one foe. It works like a focused version of a wider blast, striking only the chosen target.

rites.name: Neseonus
rites.text: A deadly maneuver that a practitioner learns by completing a grim tale of pursuit. It is one of two signature techniques held by a notorious huntress.

rites.name: Valiror
rites.text: A forceful technique practiced by a wielder of a dual-form blade, unlocked only after a second journey through a finished tale. It reuses a quick, stealthy strike as its foundation.

rites.name: Corenum
rites.text: A weakening hex that dulls the mending of wounds, so that herbs, chants, and slow natural regrowth restore far less vigor to those under its sway.

rites.name: Cenilia
rites.text: A brief seizing of the body that locks a creature in place and breaks its spellcraft mid-cast. Those who stand higher in rank than their foe resist it more easily, while mounted war-machines and creatures sunk in water are untouched.

rites.name: Oriasaulum
rites.text: A swift wind-carried blade technique used by a wandering warrior. It cuts an opponent and leaves a lingering bleeding wound. It can also link into follow-up strikes that gain extra power when performed right after it.

rites.name: Serallus
rites.text: A combat craft in which a fighter hurls a rapid barrage of explosive spheres at foes. It is one of a warrior's two signature techniques, and it is taught once the apprentice finishes basic training.

rites.name: Ameonanum
rites.text: A paired technique practiced by a wielder who channels it through two linked circular rings. It is one of the specialized arts that a particular practitioner employs when working with these twin rings.

rites.name: Tirnauntium
rites.text: A spinning maneuver that a wielder of a heavy long-spear performs. It is one of the techniques practiced by a particular fighter who carries such a weapon.

rites.name: Sornia
rites.text: A learned craft in which a practiced hand restores wounds and vigor. It is awakened in a trained fighter once they reach a set level of standing, and two companions of the order may wield it.

rites.name: Rillia
rites.text: A bonded binding craft that ties a wielder to another being through an unseen strand. It serves as a talent art used by a single individual to restrain or link others.

rites.name: Caurises
rites.text: A combat technique that disrupts an enemy's composure in battle. It is one of the five signature techniques of a single wielder.

rites.name: Amiantenum
rites.text: A restorative technique drawn from a wielder's inner reserves, mending a portion of wounds for one ally. A companion version of the same craft is known to another practitioner.

rites.name: Valeonarnus
rites.text: A resonant technique a wielder unlocks after overcoming a sealed guardian in a deep chamber. Its effect shifts with the wielder's chosen role, and it requires first invoking a prior sword discipline.

rites.name: Taurus
rites.text: A whirling strike technique taught to a wandering fighter who wields a blade-and-club weapon. It becomes available to practitioners only after completing a second round of training.

rites.name: Viallor Seontirnia
rites.text: A defensive technique of the forged-shield hammer wielders that raises a rigid barrier of metal to block incoming force. It is one of the stance-arts a skilled bearer can call upon while holding such a weapon.

rites.name: Morium
rites.text: A defensive stance taken by a serpent-bound warrior that softens harm to all companions nearby. Any blow aimed at the stance is answered with thorned retaliation scaled to the warrior's striking strength.

rites.name: Neollia Valiantilor
rites.text: A quiet inner resonance that wakes in a wanderer whenever they stand higher than an opposing foe. It lends them a steadier voice and a sharpened edge in the fight.

rites.name: Vornales
rites.text: A tuned discipline of fine readiness that a warrior can invoke to empower their next strike. Once invoked, the following attack carries noticeably greater force.

rites.name: Soreornanum
rites.text: A bound aura that lets its wielder rise again after collapsing in battle. It restores a portion of their inner reserve and sharpens their physical strikes for a time.

rites.name: Tastus
rites.text: A defensive technique that a wielder of a shield-type hammer can invoke. It is one of the arts available to a particular fighter when armed with such a weapon.

rites.name: Seonus Corellor
rites.text: A practitioner traces a glowing green loop on the ground beneath their feet. Companions who step inside the loop slowly knit their wounds closed.

rites.name: Mialasum
rites.text: A soothing glow that a trained gunner can call forth to mend wounds. It is learned after reaching a fifth stage of mastery in a warrior-marksman path, and two companions can wield it.

rites.name: Maularnus
rites.text: A tuned upgrade that lets a wielder strike harder at foes who have been knocked flat. It matches the effect of several sturdy footwear gear pieces and can be fitted to a mechanical companion as a secondary core.

rites.name: Oraunium Cintellor
rites.text: A dampening mark laid upon a serpent-circle of twins, stopping them from joining their minds while it holds. It is cast by a single adversary at the outset of a struggle and lifts gradually as the bonded pairs revisit their shared past.

rites.name: Orenares
rites.text: A combat technique used by a wielder of blades, drawn from a fighter's repertoire. It works by repurposing an earlier fighting method the user already knows.

rites.name: Tallum Vanisum
rites.text: A tuned spark-round is fired at an ally, kindling a fierce resolve that spreads to nearby companions. A rival wielder carries a warmer copy of the same craft.

rites.name: Serilium
rites.text: A mesmerizing battle technique practiced by soul-manipulating fighters. It is learned by overcoming a rare, unusual foe while a mind-piercing skill is active.

rites.name: Riantia
rites.text: A protective shimmering field is woven around one companion, mending a portion of their vitality each time they take a blow. The ward fades after a set span or a fixed number of strikes, whichever arrives first.

rites.name: Manentium
rites.text: A fire-bearing technique that a rank-ten winged serpent can learn to grant. Four named fighters of the realm are able to call upon it in battle.

rites.name: Amauria
rites.text: A tense, prowling melody that stirs up a sense of being watched by unseen hunters. It warns travelers to either stand their ground or flee before the ambush begins.

rites.name: Teliarnium
rites.text: A fighting technique a warrior may learn once trained to a certain standing in a wandering band's gunner arts. It hardens the fist for blows against armored foes.

rites.name: Valirnenum
rites.text: A learned combat discipline that a fighter unlocks after reaching the tenth tier of a hired-blade guild. It lets the practitioner strain their body into a heightened, taut readiness for battle.

rites.name: Telarnorum
rites.text: A tuned mental discipline that empowers a fighter's strikes against foes knocked aloft. It works like several banner charms and can also be set into a companion's inner core.

rites.name: Noliarnia
rites.text: A deadly flowering blade technique rated at the fourth tier of combat mastery. It is a special strike wielded within a larger combat art.

rites.name: Castelanum
rites.text: A practiced technique that a skilled fighter learns once a certain standing is reached. Three members of a traveling band are able to perform it.

rites.name: Rorinanum
rites.text: A specialized charged blade technique wielded by a warrior of the third rank. It unleashes a surge of crackling energy through a sword's edge.

rites.name: Coreones
rites.text: A borrowed fighting art that a wielder calls upon during a chained assault. It belongs to one practitioner and is used only when a combined strike is underway.

rites.name: Seriallor
rites.text: A trained technique that a certain strategist of the mind may learn after reaching a high level of rank. Two particular companions are able to perform it.

rites.name: Seolesum
rites.text: A practiced technique that a wielder unlocks once their standing within a band of fighters reaches a set rank. It lets the user strike hard enough to dazzle and stagger foes in one motion.

rites.name: Ciasum
rites.text: A mobility hindrance that forces a target to be driven backward, away from whatever struck them. It halts any ongoing combat technique, and some martial techniques carry it as an unintended side effect.

rites.name: Amiaria Oreornium
rites.text: A fighter throws out a surge of hostile attention that draws a chosen foe's focus onto them. The pull fades steadily over half a minute until it is gone entirely.

rites.name: Miseonum
rites.text: A discharge of gathered inner energy that strikes every foe standing close to its wielder. It also stuns the armored constructs that have been knocked off their footing.

rites.name: Rorneosum
rites.text: A combined fighting technique shared by two warriors, drawn from the swift strike and the freeing cut of their separate arts. It is performed as a chained sequence of blows.

rites.name: Valiasor Relanor
rites.text: A combined technique in which two practitioners link their energies, merging a swift radiant strike with a spinning storm form. It is taught as a joined art passed between partners.

rites.name: Casaurnor
rites.text: A striking technique that a warrior performs while wielding a cannon that fires charged energy. It is one of the signature moves used by a particular fighter with that weapon.

rites.name: Teoliantum
rites.text: A bright technique wielded by a twin-blade fighter. It can only be unlocked after a second playthrough, and it reuses an earlier fiery spinning maneuver.

rites.name: Valilanum
rites.text: A deadly bladed technique owned by a single wielder, ranked at the second tier of its discipline. It is unleashed as a special strike in combat.

rites.name: Torneoles
rites.text: A distant strike technique that a certain fighter may learn after reaching an early proficiency rank. Two of the band's warriors are able to perform it.

rites.name: Sornium Tiria
rites.text: A tilted combat discipline practiced by a single wielder with a serpent-shaped polearm. It becomes available only to those who replay a finished journey anew, and it reuses an earlier pair of rippling strikes.

rites.name: Seriantanum Siarnus
rites.text: A learned fighting technique that a dueling warrior gains upon reaching a fifth stage of mastery. It lets the practitioner channel a bursting force through a blade.

rites.name: Sereorinum
rites.text: A crafted strike launched straight down a line that wounds every foe it passes through. Hits can shatter an enemy's guard, and airborne targets are struck more readily to deal sharper blows.

rites.name: Voses
rites.text: A refined technique of blade mastery that a warrior of the guild may unlock once they reach a high standing in their chosen martial path.

rites.name: Serales
rites.text: A practiced technique in which a wielder of twin blades draws on a flash of stored momentum to strike again. It is learned only after completing a second journey through a finished trial.

rites.name: Caunor Nirnor
rites.text: A bodily hardening craft that raises a bearer's vitality by a set share, reinforcing their endurance in the field. It is worn as a ground-level augmentation of the guardian's protective stature.

rites.name: Caunia
rites.text: A battle art that a champion draws on to channel full strength. It is a variant of a radiant halo technique practiced by a serpentine order.

rites.name: Tisoles
rites.text: A driving discipline practiced by a single gunner who wields a heavy siege cannon. It is one of the techniques that user relies on when firing such a weapon.

rites.name: Cialanum
rites.text: A battle art practiced by assassins who fight with machine-enhanced bodies. It is one of the disciplines used by that class of killers.

rites.name: Cilaustum
rites.text: A high craft of mastering the firing of heavy ranged engines, earned by completing a bond with a trusted companion. It is one of two signature disciplines held by its wielder.

rites.name: Coriarillus
rites.text: A ground-combat augmentation that sharpens a fighter's close-quarters striking, raising their chance to land blows by a set share. A companion enhancement serves the same purpose under a different naming tradition.

rites.name: Santeores
rites.text: A lingering hex that dulls the aim of close-quarters strikers, making their blows miss more often. It is a weakening curse cast upon fighters who rely on hand-to-hand combat.

rites.name: Carollium
rites.text: A wielder's skill that calls upon a single blade's fierce technique. It is one of the arts a warrior draws from a particular curved sword, and it reuses a feral strike that the warrior already knows.

rites.name: Volanum
rites.text: A wielder's combat technique that channels a whirling storm through a blade. It reuses the momentum of a plunging downward swing to unleash the attack.

rites.name: Orellisor
rites.text: A heavy technique used by a wielder of a shield-hammer to shatter great obstacles. It belongs to the repertoire of one particular practitioner.

rites.name: Mosastor
rites.text: A fighting technique used by a wielder of a special weapon. It reshapes an earlier blow into a new, repeated assault.

rites.name: Collanes
rites.text: A binding condition that locks a bearer in place, halting movement and action while their motion freezes entirely. Only one particular caster can impose it, and it cannot be placed on those in a traveling company.

rites.name: Coreneolles
rites.text: A learned combat art that a warrior unlocks at a third stage of mastery, taught to a trio of companions who wield it in battle.

rites.name: Mollum Maurum
rites.text: A bearer of a sacred blade can call upon a fierce inner tempest, which turns the weapon's edge a burning crimson. It is one of the techniques practiced by a wielder who carries a legendary heroic title.

rites.name: Ciarnium
rites.text: A dark blue blade channels fine energy particles into an ally, sharply raising their chance to slip past incoming physical blows. The effect works on attacks and special strikes alike.

rites.name: Valesauria
rites.text: A practiced strike wielded through a sacred blade, drawn from the bearer's own arts. It repurposes an earlier pressing technique to deliver the blow.

rites.name: Nintiaria
rites.text: A bound charge that lets its bearer call upon a hidden craft of great force. It is woken by a chosen rite and loses its hold once the craft is spent. Alone it grants no strength, though certain sigils can lend it added power.

rites.name: Ameollorium
rites.text: A battle technique wielded by mind-readers of a certain guild. It is learned only after overcoming a rare, singular creature while a practitioner's inner-mind skill is active.

rites.name: Reontelus
rites.text: A forceful striking technique used by a wielder of a heavy polearm-style weapon. It is one of the fighting arts known to its user, delivered with the massive lance.

rites.name: Cestanum Coranoles
rites.text: A three-segment gauge that fills as companions fight side by side. A full segment restores a fallen ally, and a complete gauge lets the whole group unleash a linked strike in turn.

rites.name: Amarnum
rites.text: A living blade technique that a wielder can channel through their weapon during a hired assault. It works as a special strike that a skilled fighter can unleash when the battle calls for it.

rites.name: Ameonirus
rites.text: A tradeable skill that lets a hunter take down prey lying low on the ground. It is handed over in return for a card and can be exchanged again for another card.

rites.name: Nirnus Oronum
rites.text: A bonded technique a wayfarer draws upon when her companions strike together in a coordinated assault.

rites.name: Valaulium
rites.text: A spinning blade technique used by a small wielder, performed as a special strike at the lowest tier of skill. It belongs to a single fighter's repertoire of blade arts.

rites.name: Miania Teleornes
rites.text: A flowing technique a wielder can perform while bearing a certain blade. It counts as one of the arts available to a particular bearer when wielding that kind of sword.

rites.name: Corausanum
rites.text: A forceful technique in which a wielder crushes an opponent with a heavy downward strike. It belongs to one skilled fighter and is used when that fighter carries a particular sphere-shaped weapon.

rites.name: Siror Amaureolles
rites.text: A fluid art practiced by the rear guard of a warrior order, drawing on the flowing nature of liquid metal. It serves as one of the defensive techniques used by that order.

rites.name: Amoraullum
rites.text: A learned fighting technique that a hunter gains upon reaching a certain standing in a guild of rank-bearing trackers. It grants skill against one specific breed of aquatic beast.

rites.name: Sereoria Neornium
rites.text: A charm-like power that strengthens the wielder's strikes whenever they stand beneath open sky with nothing overhead. Even hollow chambers inside giant bodies count as open air.

rites.name: Miarelles
rites.text: A focused beam technique practiced by mind-weavers who fuse willpower with a light-shaped strike. It is earned by overcoming a fearsome guardian while the weaver's inner bond remains active.

rites.name: Liantum Norenia
rites.text: A technique that a wielder unlocks during a bout against a sovereign, and it must be called after a separate craft is first performed. Its effects shift according to the role the user currently fills.

rites.name: Saria Nirnum
rites.text: A rapid ranged craft wielded by one of two signature masters of their art. It is learned by completing a lineage trial between fathers and sons.

rites.name: Corallontes
rites.text: A bladed special technique wielded by a skilled warrior, unleashed at a high tier of mastery. It also serves as that fighter's signature maneuver during raids against hired-sword ambushes.

rites.name: Viastum Vastes
rites.text: A ground-based enhancement that sharpens the force of every blade and blunt striking tool wielded by a fighter. It raises the harm dealt by all physical strikes and martial techniques.

rites.name: Ameorus Amaurnianum
rites.text: A learned thrust technique that lets a strike slip past an opponent's guard, so blows land whole and blades cannot be knocked aside. It can be fitted onto a companion automaton as a supplementary mechanism.

rites.name: Telosum Merornanum
rites.text: A fighter drives forward in a sudden rush, gaining a surge of energy while becoming impossible to strike during the movement.

rites.name: Tintum Coneria
rites.text: A driving technique that a wielder of a particular long spear uses to channel a sudden burst of force. It is one of the signature methods available to a certain fighter who carries that weapon.

rites.name: Coreonus Tialles
rites.text: A two-strike sword discipline wielded by a specific duelist, ending in a final thrust that drives the crossed cuts forward and hurls the foe backward. It also weakens the target's resistance to arcane energy.

rites.name: Seollanum Tausteollia
rites.text: A mental technique that lets its user channel thought into a sharp, sword-like force. It is wielded by a single master through a bladed focus of shifting colours.

rites.name: Cisastia
rites.text: A combat discipline practiced by a hacker-minded fighting order, learned only after overcoming a rare beast guardian while a mind-piercing technique is active. It channels the spirit's inner energy into strikes.

rites.name: Oreraullia
rites.text: A signature technique of the blade-wielding fighters, it delivers a crushing blow to a foe. It hits hardest when the opponent is already stunned, rewarding allies who first disorient their targets.

rites.name: Cantes
rites.text: A tuned technique that lets a fighter drive strikes into a foe's exposed seams, boosting the harm of precise blows by as much as half again. It can also be set into a companion's core as a supporting module.

rites.name: Narnum Lintostes
rites.text: A coined art of a crafter's guild, performed by two small beings who hurl blasts of fiery force launched from improvised kitchen gear. It is a variant of a common blast technique and is known only to that pair.

rites.name: Corauntisum
rites.text: A signature technique wielded by a masked duelist, learned only after finishing a rite of trust. It is one of two prized sword forms that define her fighting style.

rites.name: Lirum Ciastum
rites.text: A ritual art of a bound wielder draws on a restored second cycle of study, passed down among the crafts. It reuses an older dance of the same practitioner to channel its effect.

rites.name: Melostes
rites.text: A tide-born blade technique that a seafaring warrior unleashes at a high tier of skill. Its element is shaped by whichever sword the user carries.

rites.name: Tastia Oreontus
rites.text: A temporary enhancement that strengthens attacks made from a distance. It makes projectile and ranged strikes hit harder for a while.

rites.name: Taunus Serisium
rites.text: A signature blade technique wielded by a single warrior, performed as a powerful strike that can be unlocked at a high tier. It is also the warrior's special move during assault missions.

rites.name: Valastenia
rites.text: A scattered-volley technique practiced by wielders of mechanical arms. It lets the user slip past incoming harm with ease.

rites.name: Taleoranum
rites.text: A bladed martial technique that a wielder uses to strike a foe, leaving the target stunned once it has been knocked off its footing.

rites.name: Ceoria Taurneontes
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a wielder strikes with clawed hand-blades. It is one of the signature arts of a warrior who fights with those claws.

rites.name: Teones Sallosor
rites.text: A quiet voice that stirs when a wanderer lulls a foe into slumber. It is counted among the spoken omens of the wilds.

rites.name: Lianernes
rites.text: A moon-shaped technique a wielder performs with a heavy reaping blade. It repurposes an earlier sweeping strike and is unlocked only after completing a long journey and later refinement.

rites.name: Nenium Seriallia
rites.text: A dive-strike technique performed by a spear-wielder, drawn from the skill of a fierce hunter. It belongs to a single warrior who wields an enormous lance.

rites.name: Valiarnor Seontium
rites.text: A resonant martial technique in which a bladed tool is swung so its sound lingers and echoes. It is one of the arts practiced by a wielder who carries a color-forged sword.

rites.name: Amonintium
rites.text: A chain technique that a character uses during a chain attack, rippling outward to strike allies and foes alike. It belongs to one specific user in the battle sequence.

rites.name: Corintonum
rites.text: A tireless technique in which a wielder spins a cutting blade through repeated arcs to strike again. It is a practice that can only be learned after a long journey is completed and a later revision is applied.

rites.name: Tornium Rirnentium
rites.text: A learned bodily technique that hardens the skin against harm. It is unlocked by a sage of the mind after long practice, and two wanderers of the caravan can perform it.

rites.name: Vaustus Venus
rites.text: A combat technique used by a wielder of a great reaping blade, unlocked after completing a second journey through the same tale. It reuses an earlier forceful strike in a new form.

rites.name: Sillaror
rites.text: A distant strike technique taught to skilled duelists once they reach a high rank of training. It is performed by drawing on a launching device the wielder carries in hand.

rites.name: Telirnanum Centus
rites.text: A ward measured in percentage points that softens harm from one chosen kind of strike, shrinking the damage taken. A negative ward instead amplifies the harm from that kind of strike.

rites.name: Coriastus Saraunus
rites.text: A ritual strike technique practiced by a brawler who fights with heavy gauntlets. It is unlocked only after completing a challenge and is built from an older strike that the fighter already knows.

rites.name: Lasia Teonanum
rites.text: A rising strike art used by one practitioner in a fighting discipline, delivered with an upward swing. It belongs to the set of techniques known to a single named fighter.

rites.name: Oraullus
rites.text: A coiling blade art used by a wielder of a scythe-shaped weapon. It is unlocked only after a second journey through the tale and reuses an older twisting strike.

rites.name: Tilliantor
rites.text: A fighting technique practiced with a blade-bearing staff, in which a wielder sweeps through a sequence of strikes. It is one of the arts used by a single practitioner who wields a glowing sword.

rites.name: Amaullestes
rites.text: A protective mark placed on a foe after three linked strikes are completed. Its form depends on the element of the final blow, and it blocks certain harmful effects and actions that would threaten an ally group.

rites.name: Tiastum Saneolles
rites.text: A bladed-light technique that a bearer of a lens-forged blade can unleash as a special strike. It is wielded in combat by a single wielder.

rites.name: Reolium Nerastes
rites.text: A practitioner strikes a commanding pose and then releases a spreading volley of glowing energy bolts at foes gathered before them. Only one particular fighter is able to perform this technique.

rites.name: Vasium
rites.text: A fighter's technique of striking with a forked weapon that shakes the ground. It is unlocked after completing a trial and recycles a stored knuckle blow.

rites.name: Raules
rites.text: A binding affliction that silences a wielder's gift so they cannot call upon any of their learned techniques. A charm worn about the neck can ward against it.

rites.name: Viallus Naullones
rites.text: A lingering crackle that afflicts a bearer, striking them with sparking harm at regular intervals. Each pulse carries a fraction of the force of the original blow.

rites.name: Telorus Nianasor
rites.text: A bright crimson binding seizes a wielder for a short span, blocking their spells, special strikes, and rescue efforts while their companions still act freely.

rites.name: Amialinia
rites.text: A dragging curse that stretches the wait between each forceful strike of a warrior's allies, while slowing the rate at which hostile foes can unleash their own powerful techniques.

rites.name: Loseolanum
rites.text: A forceful strike art that drives an opponent backward a short distance and deals heavy harm. It hits much harder when performed right after two specific rage-fueled techniques.

rites.name: Teosallum
rites.text: A hovering cluster of mechanical blades unfolds into four limbs and strikes a chosen foe in a rapid sequence of ten cuts. It can only be called forth when one of a few specific machine companions is equipped.

rites.name: Telauntanum Nantum
rites.text: A harmful backlash that strikes those who come too close under certain conditions. Warriors can step outside its reach to escape, and it can also be turned back onto foes by bearers of protective charms.

rites.name: Vialles Coraurnes
rites.text: A bonded companion of the wielder splits into four mechanical limbs that strike a chosen foe in a rapid sequence of ten cuts. It can only be called upon while certain lesser swarm forms are already bound to the wielder.

rites.name: Amiastantes
rites.text: A bearer gathers a surge of force that strengthens the next combat technique they unleash. When that technique strikes several times in quick succession, only the opening blow receives the boost.

rites.name: Rilia Masinum
rites.text: A bearer's art that, once invoked, quickens their movements and raises the chance of striking twice in a single blow. The gain comes at the cost of weakening their bodily guard.

rites.name: Orosum
rites.text: A craft of reading the shape of a clash before it happens, letting a practitioner advise allies on where to strike. It is learned by a mind that has reached a seventh grade of mastery.

rites.name: Seraullum Amilus
rites.text: A learned craft a wielder can master once a formidable guardian of an ancient fortress has been overcome. It belongs to one practitioner's repertoire of techniques.

rites.name: Tistonor
rites.text: A combat technique wielded by a sword-bearing fighter, drawing on a stored surge of power. It works by reusing a previously spent burst of energy.

rites.name: Amaurneones
rites.text: A brief shove that knocks a combatant backward and breaks their spell-casting focus. Until it fades, the target cannot act, and it leaves them open to being toppled or seized by a mech.

rites.name: Sistaulia
rites.text: A forward-facing strike technique used by a wielder to hit every foe within a short reach. Each enemy struck also charges the wielder's inner energy meter.

rites.name: Santus Teliastium
rites.text: A combat technique is practiced by a warrior who wields a long spear-lance. It is one of the arts that such a warrior can call upon while using that weapon.

rites.name: Coroniasia
rites.text: A specialized blade technique that ranks at the fourth tier of combat mastery. It is used as a signature special move by a particular wielder.

rites.name: Valanus Venus
rites.text: A soft gust is drawn through a blade-bearer's practiced stance, mending the wounded who stand within its reach. The same calming restorative pulse is reused again and again by the one who channels it.

rites.name: Rintes Meontanum
rites.text: A mental trigger that a wielder calls upon to render a foe briefly motionless. It holds the opponent in place for a moment, leaving them unable to move.

rites.name: Cinalor
rites.text: A hardy fighting discipline built on close assault and steadfast guard. It grants extra vitality and melee strength, and those who master it may branch into a gunner or shieldbearer path.

rites.name: Cisellium
rites.text: A devastating blade technique in which a fighter unleashes a combined surge of lightning and speed. It sits at the highest tier of a bladed special arts ranking.

rites.name: Loreolus
rites.text: A fighting art practiced with glowing blades, taught to skilled duelists. It is one of many close-combat techniques in its tradition.

rites.name: Sereosonium
rites.text: A sudden burst of force drawn from a wielder's inner pact, channeled through a sacred blade. It reuses a strike that has been used before, bringing it back into a new form.

rites.name: Orosernus
rites.text: A driving technique used by a rider who channels twin rings to perform a fearless spinning maneuver. It belongs to one particular fighter's repertoire.

rites.name: Vauriallor
rites.text: A ring of shimmering light that a guardian can call upon as a defensive art from behind the front line. It belongs to the arts of a single warrior.

rites.name: Corirnia Mirnollia
rites.text: A deadly fan-driven technique wielded by a fighter who spins a pair of blades in a graceful arc. It can only be learned by those who have already mastered the wider art.

rites.name: Telirum Naunes
rites.text: A bearer's inner charge rises as they near unleashing their signature gift, and a full charge brings further strange effects. Unlike ordinary techniques, these gifts never recharge on their own, so the bearer must refill the charge by hand.

rites.name: Ceornes
rites.text: A melee technique used by a wielder of blades, drawn from a bearer's personal repertoire. It reuses a previously learned strike, letting the bearer repeat that attack with a sharp arc through the air.

rites.name: Ameontus Seraunisium
rites.text: A raw force that governs how hard a fighter's blows land. Warriors who rely on bodily strikes gain much from it, while those who channel inner energy gain little.

rites.name: Veones Vellum
rites.text: A disc-shaped art wielded by a combat driver who pairs it with a twin-ring apparatus. It is one of that wielder's signature techniques when the rings are in use.

rites.name: Seriasantum
rites.text: A lingering weakness that softens the force of heat-based strikes against whoever bears it. It leaves the bearer less harmed by fire-like assaults for a time.

rites.name: Cillantor
rites.text: A fighting technique wielded by a warrior bearing a scythe of disaster. It is unlocked only after a second journey through the tale, and it reuses an older rock-splitting blow.

rites.name: Tarnia Reolia
rites.text: A ground-bound technique a rider uses while guiding a sphere-shaped companion. It belongs to one particular rider and can also be performed with a second companion in another setting.

rites.name: Malus Valiasium
rites.text: A creeping corrupting sickness that spreads through the body of a living being. It slowly wears away health over time.

rites.name: Coreonus Nesus
rites.text: A battle anthem that sounds whenever a band of travelers engages a foe. In a later rendition, a bright reworked version rises when a winged ally joins the fight.

rites.name: Ristaunium
rites.text: A learned technique that a skilled fighter can awaken once their mastery of a particular combat path reaches an advanced stage. It lets the practitioner press forward relentlessly in battle.

rites.name: Cistes Nellus
rites.text: A fighter's practiced resolve that grants a steadier spirit during battle. It is learned by an attacker once they reach a certain level of training.

rites.name: Veosales
rites.text: A close-combat fighting technique in which a practitioner hurls a crackling lance that strikes every foe standing in a straight line ahead of them.

rites.name: Telonor
rites.text: A chained maneuver that a warrior performs during a sequence of assaults. It is one of the arts used by a particular fighter when striking in a chain.

rites.name: Serestia Miniarnum
rites.text: A practiced craft of a field-medic order, it mends every companion in the company at once, no matter how far away they stand.

rites.name: Leoses Neontes
rites.text: A cannon-driven technique used by one fighter in their arsenal. It is unlocked on a second playthrough and reuses an earlier move.

rites.name: Mastesor
rites.text: A deceptive throwing craft practiced by a wielder of twin blades. It is one of the techniques a skilled fighter draws on when handling a pair of swords.

rites.name: Nelliarnor
rites.text: A signature technique of a single named fighter, passed on as a reward once a companion's personal trial is finished. It is a skill of the sort tied to a bond between allies.

rites.name: Rinentum
rites.text: A defensive craft practiced by shield-bearing guardians who reach an advanced rank of training. It lets a trained warrior master the art of holding the line.

rites.name: Meorium Solum
rites.text: A heavy striking technique drawn from a bearer's clenched gauntlets. It is unlocked only after a second journey through a finished tale, and it reuses an older mighty blow.

rites.name: Volia Ameraurnia
rites.text: A battle craft wielded by a soul-bending practitioner, unleashing a poisonous cloud against foes. It is gained by overcoming a rare phantom foe while the soul-tampering discipline is active.

rites.name: Seresium Amoneles
rites.text: A recurring combat technique in which a fighter changes which opponent they are attacking during a clash. It appears repeatedly across the battles of this world's martial traditions.

rites.name: Vaurianum
