rites.text: A combat discipline practiced by a class of mechanical killers. It becomes available to a warrior as a master technique once that class is fully unlocked.

rites.name: Vaulles Valeontia
rites.text: A forceful strike technique wielded by a single fighter with a particular polearm. It is unlocked only after completing the story and reusing an earlier powerful blow.

rites.name: Cisonum
rites.text: A ritual strike technique wielded by a twin-blade fighter, unlocked only after completing a trial and receiving a later refinement. It reuses a previously learned execution, reshaping it into a new form of attack.

rites.name: Orenaullium
rites.text: A mind-drawn technique that is learned by a psychic corruptor once their training reaches a high tier. It lets the user send troubling visions into the thoughts of foes.

rites.name: Oraulires
rites.text: A ground-weapon augment that heightens the chance of a hidden inner voice awakening in a fighter who is outmatched. Its strength grows as the odds grow longer.

rites.name: Maunium Amaunteores
rites.text: A whirling bodily technique in which a fighter spins to strike every foe nearby several times. Each landed blow builds up a stored reserve of inner energy.

rites.name: Riastanum Viastornium
rites.text: A driving technique used by a skilled wielder of a long-hafted spear. It counts as one of the signature maneuvers of a particular practitioner who fights with a heavy lance-like weapon.

rites.name: Telornum Toniranum
rites.text: A bearer may call forth a temporary weapon-spirit that grants a shifting set of combat techniques shaped by the bearer's chosen role. Its use requires a special permit to unlock at higher trials.

rites.name: Nestum Oresostium
rites.text: A specialized blade technique wielded by a bearlike spirit-form. It strikes with spectral force in a heavy, ghostly arc.

rites.name: Telialanum Tonanum
rites.text: A shifting atmospheric force that awakens when the skies turn unpredictable during a clash. It lends its strength to fighters caught in the sudden change of weather.

rites.name: Telolanum Telialerum
rites.text: A rising gust of wind-craft that a fighter can learn with a particular twin-bladed staff. It is only unlocked after completing a second journey through the story.

rites.name: Nalloses
rites.text: A fighting discipline that sharpens close-combat strikes, aimed shots, and the ability to dodge. Practitioners can advance into it from a soldier's training path, and one of its adepts is a wandering fighter named Ossel.

rites.name: Serarnes Mastillia
rites.text: A grasping technique that strikes a foe and snatches away one of their items or a measure of their vigor, speed, or power. Later refinements let the practitioner seize their rivals' growth as well.

rites.name: Lalus Colium
rites.text: A battle art that is a variant of a grand protective technique. Only one faction is able to wield it.

rites.name: Orernisum
rites.text: A striking technique passed down among wielders of a sworn blade. It is one of the forms used by a bearer when drawing upon a great edge.

rites.name: Corellaria
rites.text: A coordinated assault performed by allied helpers who fight alongside the group. It takes the place of an older linked-strike technique.

rites.name: Sereolor Coreonum
rites.text: A protective blessing that lets its bearer ignore every kind of sky-borne storm, from drifting spores to crackling lightning and blowing sand alike.

rites.name: Orallor Vausirium
rites.text: A wielder drives a humming tool forward into foes in a close combat technique. It is a rare variant of an older maneuver, practiced by only two partners.

rites.name: Coristor
rites.text: A quiet exchange held between two companions on a harsh, unyielding stretch of land. Choosing a reply here unlocks a calming skill for one of them.

rites.name: Serontus Seonosor
rites.text: A fierce special technique wielded with a blade, unlocked at the third tier of skill. It also serves as a signature art used during hired-assault missions.

rites.name: Oraullanum Riareosia
rites.text: A physical technique that, when used on a foe already weakened by breakage, knocks that foe off their footing. A gentler copy of the same technique is known to another practitioner.

rites.name: Tiarnisium
rites.text: A battle craft practiced by heavy guardians, who bring a shifting mechanical crown of arms to bear in combat. The craft is taught within the ranks of the armored defenders.

rites.name: Testollium
rites.text: A dark maneuver used by a wielder of a scythe-shaped blade, who lunges forward and siphons strength from the foe. It is drawn from a rushing charge technique the wielder already knows, and it becomes available only after the wielder has completed a second journey through the tale.

rites.name: Varnistes Riallum
rites.text: A learned combat discipline that a specialized gunner can master once reaching a certain level of experience. It grants a particular battle technique to those who practice the lore of the blade-and-firearm warrior.

rites.name: Sallanum
rites.text: A combat technique used by one fighter who leaps backward while firing two energy bursts at an opponent. It is a modified form of a quicker drawing style.

rites.name: Ameolausium
rites.text: A tireless striking technique wielded by a warrior bearing heavy stone gauntlets. It is unlocked only after a second journey through the tale and lets the fighter repeat a rising blow.

rites.name: Vestalles Rauntania
rites.text: A spinning strike technique wielded by one fighter using a paired blade-and-club weapon. It becomes available to a wanderer who starts a second journey after completing the first.

rites.name: Nalaustum
rites.text: A signature spinning blade technique belonging to a single fighter, unlocked at a mid-level training tier. It also serves as that fighter's special move during assault raids.

rites.name: Ranternum
rites.text: A paired technique of twin firing that a wielder learns after completing a bonding trial with a companion. It is counted among the signature disciplines of its practitioner.

rites.name: Ventanum Telanes
rites.text: A bladed strike used by a wielder who holds twin curved weapons. It is one of two ways the wielder can crush an opponent.

rites.name: Cistausia
rites.text: A learned technique that quickens a fighter's blows, letting them strike more swiftly. It is granted by a beast-like tutor who teaches it to those who prove worthy.

rites.name: Amianum Vausirnia
rites.text: A stirring surge of inner resolve that wells up whenever a wielder is struck, adding a measure of tension to their spirit. It can trigger once per blow received.

rites.name: Amaullisia
rites.text: A trained technique that lets common fighters sharpen their attention for a brief burst of heightened precision in combat.

rites.name: Ameosanum
rites.text: A combat technique that gives a chance for each advancing strike sequence to leave a matching elemental sphere, no matter how far the sequence has progressed. It works the same as a common technique called Orb Master.

rites.name: Nosia Neolinium
rites.text: A swift technique that lets common fighters sharpen their battle capacity at an uncommon pace. It is practiced by ordinary warriors in the field.

rites.name: Valeolium Maunum
rites.text: A calming technique a driver draws on to steady the mind during a fight. It sharpens focus and keeps composure when pressure mounts.

rites.name: Seresillor
rites.text: A tireless ward-art that shields every companion from lingering hexes and sapping touches. Should a blight already cling to them when it is woven, the art lifts it away.

rites.name: Sirnor Maunium
rites.text: Glowing spheres of elemental essence cling to a foe after certain linked strike sequences, each of a distinct kind and up to one per kind. While bound, each sphere makes that foe take less harm from its matching essence, and the spheres can be shattered through repeated blows.

rites.name: Riasteranum
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter wields a blade in a manner identical to a common sword form. It is a basic move any warrior can learn and perform.

rites.name: Ameriasus
rites.text: A paired-horn art that channels a soul-borne force into a surge of compressed power. It is taught by a horned archer who guards the craft.

rites.name: Serenum Coreorintes
rites.text: A lasting hex that clings to a bearer and cannot be fully mastered. It belongs to the tactician's craft of binding foes.

rites.name: Amirneostes
rites.text: A rare fighting technique that bears a chance each strike will sever a lesser foe outright. It belongs to a set of seven attacker arts and cannot be fully perfected.

rites.name: Amisterum
rites.text: A fourth technique of a cowardly craft that sharpens aim against foes struck from the rear. It lifts accuracy for every kind of strike, whether of flesh or of spirit.

rites.name: Amonum Coreorniles
rites.text: A channeled, invisible vitality drawn from the surrounding air that lets a wielder strengthen their abilities in battle. It is one of the practiced skills of a skilled driver.

rites.name: Riantum Nenor
rites.text: A quiet art of calming a fierce temper, held by one circle of healers. It cannot be fully mastered by any practitioner.

rites.name: Neostia Corentor
rites.text: A disciplined craft of guiding one's concentration toward a single aim. Practitioners use it to sharpen their skill in the chosen discipline.

rites.name: Orelines
rites.text: A reliable trait held by a driver that keeps them steady and trustworthy when relied upon. It is one of several skills a driver may cultivate in the craft of piloting.

rites.name: Nines Valaselia
rites.text: A specialized maneuver performed by a group of sword-wielding warriors who are women. It is unlocked at a higher tier of skill mastery.

rites.name: Cantanum Rialles
rites.text: A bonded fighting art that two partnered wielders can awaken together. It grows stronger when its wielders study a specific scholarly tome on shared discipline.

rites.name: Cirauntum
rites.text: A learned craft held by travelers who tend the wounded on the road. It lets a trained hand steady the injured until help can arrive.

rites.name: Moniarnes
rites.text: A driver's trained knack for lifting the spirits of allies in a crowded contest. It is one of the practiced arts that a pilot can learn in the wider world of machines and rival crews.

rites.name: Vellantor
rites.text: A bearer channels a surge of inner aura that quickens all their other practiced techniques, but leaves them rooted in place and unable to act while it holds.

rites.name: Coraulles Amareonor
rites.text: A savage transformation a fighter can unleash in battle, pushing their body into a feral state. It belongs to a winged order of warriors and cannot be fully mastered.

rites.name: Lases Riantinium
rites.text: A bonding craft in which a close companion's encouragement lifts a wielder's inner force after a successful surge. It belongs to the fourth discipline within a school of compassionate arts, adding a modest extra measure of power.

rites.name: Meosollum
rites.text: A volatile technique wielded by a secretive faction of warriors, channeling pent-up force into sudden bursts of ruinous power.

rites.name: Maurum Menauria
rites.text: A tide of borrowed strength that only hostile creatures can call upon. It swells every measure of their power at once, making them far sturdier and sharper than before.

rites.name: Rarentanum
rites.text: A practiced art of silent, targeted removal, taught to a select few. It is reserved for those who hold a particular skill of the field.

rites.name: Lasonium
rites.text: A protective veil that a lesser fighting companion can raise in battle. It is used by the common warriors of the field.

rites.name: Seorianus
rites.text: A driver's trained technique that a rider can call upon during a journey. It belongs to the set of skills that drivers learn and use.

rites.name: Rantausia Carnanum
rites.text: A bond of trust among companions that grants a steady chance for a fellow to act again after each turn. It forms part of a branch of teachings centered on compassion.

rites.name: Orianium Amases
rites.text: A quick reflexive technique used in combat. It lets a fighter answer an incoming attack almost instantly, turning a blow aside with a swift return strike.

rites.name: Valanernus
rites.text: A harmful technique that weakens a foe's strength or abilities. It is taught as a challenge within a rigorous trial of sages.

rites.name: Sialasium
rites.text: A driver-linked skill that rouses a wild, untamed power within a bonded partner. It is one of the skills a driver can learn to enhance their fighting abilities.

rites.name: Tarnum Rania
rites.text: A wild skill-spirit granted by a drifting ember-caller to wanderers in the mountains. It lets a warrior fight with burning zeal once a battle begins.

rites.name: Naullia
rites.text: A fighting technique that makes a foe more likely to strike nothing at all. It is a skill used in battle to add extra chances for an attack to fail.

rites.name: Tasum Valeornanus
rites.text: A tactical trick in which a fighter chains one strike move straight into another during the brief pause after the final blow lands. Doing so fills a special meter by half a level.

rites.name: Sanus Voses
rites.text: A trained bodily discipline that lets a skilled fighter draw extra strength from the body. It is one of the practiced techniques a driver can call upon in battle.

rites.name: Amalaunanum
rites.text: A skill-like craft that a practitioner brings forth in a sequence of rapid strikes. It belongs to a wider family of techniques and resists full mastery by anyone who attempts it.

rites.name: Meornanum Cauliarnia
rites.text: A combat technique that a common fighter uses to draw the focus of enemies toward themselves. It is a skill practiced in the ranks of ordinary warriors.

rites.name: Teleorum Valarirnus
rites.text: A gentle, practiced way of tending the sick that strengthens the healing crafts of a caregiver. It belongs to the branch of skills centered on compassion and care.

rites.name: Lasianor
rites.text: A learned talent that lets its bearer gain a bonus whenever a hidden trail or a rare find is uncovered. It belongs to the third technique in a gentle, childlike discipline.

rites.name: Aminanum Neolanum
rites.text: A combat discipline that joins two bolts of storm-energy into a single strike, practiced by battle-casters who channel the sky through their own bodies.

rites.name: Telernanes
rites.text: A joyous blade technique that replaces an older gust-based move once the wielder has claimed their sword. It belongs to a set of finishing strikes that end a combat sequence.

rites.name: Ameriastum
rites.text: A driver's technique in which a pilot's hands move with frantic, unrestrained motion to control a machine. It is one of the recognized skills a driver can learn.

rites.name: Ceontaurium
rites.text: A driver's discipline that a cosmic-era war-machine pilot draws upon in battle. It is one of several learned abilities a pilot can call upon.

rites.name: Miasaustor
rites.text: A tactical craft that sharpens the force of blows delivered by fighters who study it. It raises the harm dealt by strikes, yet it grants no bonus to the fighter's general strength.

rites.name: Sellostium
rites.text: A learned knack that belongs to a single ordained circle of wanderers. It is practiced in the open lands and passed along by those who hold it.

rites.name: Coronanum Mialauses
rites.text: Each fighter carries a set of signature techniques chosen from a ring of combat moves, and the strikes they unleash are picked by the leader's hand while companions act on their own judgment. Some of these techniques guard or heal rather than harm.

rites.name: Telirium Mauntium
rites.text: A learned discipline that lets a practitioner perceive and direct the subtle energy flowing through the world. It is taught as one of the trained abilities a companion may cultivate.

rites.name: Amirnanum Oriasauntor
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter spreads a protective barrier of energy to shelter nearby allies. It is listed among the battle skills a warrior can learn.

rites.name: Mollanum Cenanum
rites.text: A foresight art that lengthens the span of a seer's visions by a few heartbeats. It is the first craft taught in the pessimist branch of the discipline.

rites.name: Corantium Lastor
rites.text: A combat technique that a fighter can call upon during battle. It works the same way as a common blade technique known as a reckless warrior's surge.

rites.name: Lesia Mastus
rites.text: A coined rite of guild trials that lengthens the time bonds of linked strikes last among a company of allies. Those who gain it also strike harder during the extended span.

rites.name: Rintus Riania
rites.text: A fighter draws back a small share of strength from each decisive blow struck. In one older version of the craft, stronger strikes also return more of that strength.

rites.name: Sillernium
rites.text: A learned craft that a wielder uses to guide the flow of unseen energy through their gear. It is one of the skills that pilots of a driver's class can draw upon in combat.

rites.name: Sauntum Vausor
rites.text: A practiced combat technique that a fighter draws upon during battle. It is one of the recognized skills within a larger set of such techniques.

rites.name: Reolia Rellor
rites.text: A power tied to a battlefield healer's calling. It transforms once the healer reaches a high rank in that calling.

rites.name: Seristaurum
rites.text: A foundational training art that every apprentice pilot learns before advanced techniques. It is one of the basic skills a driver draws upon in combat.

rites.name: Siriarnum
rites.text: A swift burst of evasive momentum that a wielder can gain through a mind-linked companion. It is granted by a restless, bubbling creature found among the marshes.

rites.name: Ciantostum
rites.text: A poisonous vapor is spilled by enormous living machines as they move. Certain gifted wielders can scatter the haze with their inner power.

rites.name: Roreostanum
rites.text: A stomping technique that releases a burst of harm to every foe standing close to the user. It is triggered whenever the wielder performs a swift maneuver.

rites.name: Corontus Orernes
rites.text: A driver's technique that raises a companion's strength for a time. It is one of the skills used by drivers in a fictional world of machines.

rites.name: Amilleontum
rites.text: A bold taunting technique used by a wandering vanguard company, which draws enemies toward its user and grows stronger once the user has mastered the craft to a high rank.

rites.name: Amornes Amantor
rites.text: A combat technique that a warrior can draw upon during fights. Its exact workings are not described in this entry.

rites.name: Valeria Vornaustium
rites.text: A driving craft that lets a rider's companions gain strength from the pulse of a sustained rhythm. It belongs to the set of skills practiced by those who pilot the great mechanical beasts.

rites.name: Vaulestia
rites.text: A shielding force is raised around a bearer, soaking up a set measure of harm before it fades. Any excess harm passes through to the one it guards.

rites.name: Viarum Teosium
rites.text: A temporary enhancement that strengthens a bearer's resistance to mystical energy strikes. It works as a proportional boost, so it adds little when the bearer's base guard is already weak.

rites.name: Vauresum
rites.text: A combat technique known within a fictional martial tradition as one of the recognized battle skills. It is practiced by warriors who train in its sequence.

rites.name: Serireolles
rites.text: A combat technique that belongs to a set of battle skills in a distant fictional world. It is recognized as one of the fighting methods practiced there.

rites.name: Maunteornum
rites.text: A combat technique that a fighter uses during battle. It belongs to the set of skills that warriors draw upon in fights.

rites.name: Amoseoles
rites.text: A nimble evasive technique tied to a wandering spirit-craft guild. Practitioners cannot fully master it, and it remains an unfinished art.

rites.name: Tilleosum
rites.text: A specialized fighting discipline practiced by skilled combatants. Those who attain the highest standing in this craft are able to unlock a further advanced form of its techniques.

rites.name: Neostaulor
rites.text: A special finishing strike that a wielder can perform after gaining a certain blade, replacing an earlier technique. It belongs to a set of decisive moves used in combat.

rites.name: Rasialia
rites.text: A bound sequence of linked techniques that fighters perform together in battle. Each link in the chain builds on the last to produce a coordinated strike.

rites.name: Nilarnium
rites.text: A driver's innate knack that bends fortune in their favor during battle. It is one of the special skills a pilot can draw upon while piloting a massive mechanical war-beast.

rites.name: Telintium
rites.text: A learned craft that lets wielders of the common blade-folk bend the raw forces of nature to their will in battle. It is a combat technique practiced among ordinary fighters.

rites.name: Sontaurium
rites.text: A driving technique that a pilot can use to pursue a rival across the land. It is one of the skills a pilot learns for guiding a vehicle.

rites.name: Raurnesanum
rites.text: A battle technique a fighter can call upon during combat. It belongs to the family of skills used in fierce clashes.

rites.name: Niantes Caustes
rites.text: A learned combat technique that lets a rider in a vehicle launch quick successive strikes. It ranks among the advanced driving methods a fighter can master.

rites.name: Amosteontes
rites.text: A solitary battle discipline that strengthens a fighter when allies near them have fallen. The boost lasts a short while and is drawn from a single branch of the warrior's training.

rites.name: Santaunes
rites.text: A driving technique that a crew member can use to steer a vehicle more effectively. It belongs to the set of skills a driver can learn.

rites.name: Misianium
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter channels a wounding ache into a sudden attack. It belongs to the set of battle arts practiced by warriors of this world.

rites.name: Miaranor
rites.text: A battle technique in which a fighter sharpens their attack to a cutting edge. It is one of the combat arts known to warriors of this world.

rites.name: Tanium Sereollorus
rites.text: A combat art in which a fighter provokes a chosen foe, drawing sharp attention that slowly fades over time. Repeating the provocation before it fades stacks the attention together, which then fades at the same pace.

rites.name: Lontum
rites.text: A trained bodily craft that lets a practitioner master their own physique, serving as one of the driving skills taught to the wanderers of the realm.

rites.name: Neonia Casenor
rites.text: A defensive craft that lets common fighters with blades blunt the sting of lightning-charged attacks. It is practiced in the everyday battle arts of the lower ranks.

rites.name: Sialiria
rites.text: A small-folk aid craft that lets its users pull allies out of danger. It is practiced by skilled drivers who answer calls for help in the field.

rites.name: Serianintes
rites.text: A restorative craft that lets a bearer recover strength during a struggle. It is counted among the trained skills a driver can call upon in battle.

rites.name: Neontum Corernanum
rites.text: A battle discipline that binds a gentle restorative charm to an ally. Each time the ally is struck, a small share of their vitality returns, lasting for a set span or a set number of blows.

rites.name: Leonaustes
rites.text: A driver's technique in which a fighter lands a sharp, dark-edged blow. It counts as one of the special skills a driver can use in combat.

rites.name: Centus Lerum
rites.text: A learned skill that lets a wielder mend wounds and restore vitality. It is gained from a figure who guides people in the art of taking spirit power, and it belongs to a set of such mental disciplines.

rites.name: Tiror Amolantium
rites.text: A hidden favor that tilts the odds for a wanderer's strikes and defenses, and nudges the chance of finding rare treasures and rare companions. It grows through training, charms, and learned knacks.

rites.name: Marnanum Mirnia
rites.text: A driving craft that a rider can learn to become more energetic and animated while steering. It is one of the skills a driver may cultivate to sharpen their handling.

rites.name: Meoles Soseonor
rites.text: A tumbling discipline practiced by small merchant folk to throw opponents off balance during their trade bouts. It is one of the driving techniques taught among the wandering performers.

rites.name: Tesanum Aminium
rites.text: A battle technique that lets fighters of the common blade class sharpen their aim. It is a skill used in combat by those who wield ordinary weapons.

rites.name: Telaunium Amosanus
rites.text: A hex that makes a bearer take a larger share of blows from bodily force. Its arithmetic shifts depending on whether it falls upon an ally or a foe.

rites.name: Ameontor Coreolles
rites.text: A learned resistance that shields its bearer from effects that weaken their strength and vigor. It is the fifth craft within a branch of guarded, wary arts.

rites.name: Orentia Viareornes
rites.text: A tempest-storing craft lets a wielder hurl all foes into the air at once, swelling the reward gained for their fall.

rites.name: Serirnialia
rites.text: Two companions exchange gathered trinkets as tokens of regard. Each receiver's tastes decide how much the bond grows, and the offering is spent in the giving.

rites.name: Lirnus Corostium
rites.text: A basic technique that lets a fighter who knows it strike again in quick succession. It belongs to a set of combat skills that a pilot can learn and use.

rites.name: Niastes Vaunia
rites.text: A fourth-tier technique practiced by male warriors who wield heavy hammer-and-shield arms. It is a special maneuver used in combat by common blade fighters.

rites.name: Amileosor
rites.text: A practiced technique that lets a fighter spot and seize scarce treasures during battle. It works the same way as several other familiar skills known across the realm.

rites.name: Vialium Liarneonor
rites.text: A combat technique used by ordinary wielders of blades. It lets them strike within a clear, unobstructed area around themselves.

rites.name: Ceostauror
rites.text: A driving technique held by a single pilot's craft. It lets the operator push aside any obstacle in their path.

rites.name: Solleosor
rites.text: A powerful special technique that a brawny fighter wielding spiked gauntlets unleashes in battle. It is mastered at a high level of skill.

rites.name: Amontum Corentanum
rites.text: A learned discipline in which a fighter's first clash of wills has a fair chance to lift the whole company's resolve for a short span. The surge of courage lasts only a brief while before fading.

rites.name: Sallentanum
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter draws foes into a whirling pull of force. The skill is listed among the moves a warrior can learn in battle.

rites.name: Telanum Amontanum
rites.text: A bond between companions that restores a portion of each ally's vitality after a strike lands. It belongs to a branch of skills centered on compassion and shared spirit.

rites.name: Norum Valausum
rites.text: A vital measure of endurance that every bearer carries within. When it runs empty the bearer falls, yet it slowly refills while resting away from battle.

rites.name: Rollanum Telestia
rites.text: A closing blow that a heavy war-frame can unleash, though its wielder cannot enter the surging trance needed to deliver it fully. The target suffers harm without any visible reaction.

rites.name: Veoles Vaurnus
rites.text: A defensive craft that lets certain fighters bolster themselves against radiant power. It is practiced by common wielders of blades in a fractured world.

rites.name: Vesteorium
rites.text: A learned bodily discipline that a travelling fighter can draw upon to strengthen their frame. It is one of several trained techniques that guide a companion's combat abilities.

rites.name: Mirniarus
rites.text: A somber chant that echoes through a fortified hall until the walls are rigged to collapse. Few recordings of it survive, and its origin remains obscure.

rites.name: Coriantanum Saleostor
rites.text: A combat technique practiced by ordinary fighters who wield common blades. It lets them prepare their strikes at great speed during battle.

rites.name: Lelum Corollium
rites.text: A refined technique that sharpens a bearer's abilities through practice. It belongs to the set of skills that guide how a pilot or driver handles their craft.

rites.name: Orausinia
rites.text: A lasting endurance art belonging to a marksman's discipline, one that its practitioners can never fully perfect. It is passed among those who draw the bow with steady nerve.

rites.name: Rileontia
rites.text: A battle technique used by ordinary fighters that lets them brace against gusts of air. It is practiced among common warriors who train in combat arts.

rites.name: Valelum Amaustium
rites.text: A fourth technique within a bearer's ember discipline that lengthens every burning afflicted by her strikes, granting extra rounds of scorching harm. It works on both her discharge and her flame-assault techniques.

rites.name: Caureontus
rites.text: A craft that lets the bearer's allies grow joyful alongside one another. It belongs to the set of driving techniques used in the wider storytelling world.

rites.name: Launtum Meontaunium
rites.text: A combat technique that lets a fighter hold their ground against forceful strikes. It is practiced by common warriors who wield blades.

rites.name: Amosus Mastum
rites.text: A bright surge of borrowed strength that a single bearer draws from a cheering ally. It lasts for a short span and grants a fraction of the bearer's stored vigor, reflex, and resolve.

rites.name: Siarninus
rites.text: A driver's technique that lets a rapid sequence of linked strikes be unleashed at once. It is one of the practiced combat arts a driver can call upon in battle.

rites.name: Coreornes
rites.text: A restorative craft that a guide wields to refill the spirit of an ally in battle. It draws on a guardian's inner reserve.

rites.name: Corernum Ceollium
rites.text: A passive talent within a wandering traveler's vitality path that makes hidden treasure caskets slightly more likely to yield their spoils. It only works when the foe is capable of carrying such a casket at all.

rites.name: Niasallum
rites.text: A learned discipline of diligence that lets a person gain greater growth from every task they finish. It is one of the later steps in a path of steadfast character.

rites.name: Sialonium
rites.text: A driving craft that lets a rider draw steady vitality through their own body while moving. It is practiced as one of the skills taught to those who guide great machines.

rites.name: Neostium Testorum
rites.text: A learned craft of swift reckoning in the head, practiced by those who count quickly without tools. It is held by only a select few and passed on as a mark of their trade.

rites.name: Taselus
rites.text: A learned guard of the mind that softens the harm from wide-reaching mystical assaults. It turns aside a share of the force of spells that strike many foes at once.

rites.name: Ternanum Seollium
rites.text: A ceaseless hail of projectiles that a wielder gains from a certain mischievous trickster figure. It is a sustained attack technique that keeps striking without pause.

rites.name: Lentiaror
rites.text: A battle technique that a fighter can use during combat. Its specific effect is not described in the source text.

rites.name: Teliarastia
rites.text: A defensive technique that a common fighter uses to steel themselves against shadowy, malign forces. It grants resistance to dark-aligned harm in battle.

rites.name: Oreriastus
rites.text: A combat technique used in battle by fighters in an invented world. It is one of the recognized skills a warrior can perform.

rites.name: Vaunus Amiallium
rites.text: A tiered tactic that a certain class of blade-wielding fighters uses at its third stage of mastery. It is employed by male members of their kind.

rites.name: Menollia
rites.text: A disciplined inner talent held by a commander of watchful defenders. It awakens into a further power once its bearer rises to a high rank in that calling.

rites.name: Vaustus Maurnerium
rites.text: A fighting technique that common warriors use to bring down mechanical foes. It lets them strike with force against engines and constructs.

rites.name: Veoniallium
rites.text: A bond-craft held by a guardian order that cannot be fully mastered. It is said to shield allies who stand behind the practitioner.

rites.name: Veornestor
rites.text: A tuned resonance that a hero draws upon to restore a companion's spent energy. It is a skill passed between allies in the field.

rites.name: Valases Amastes
rites.text: A driver's trained technique that lets a companion pull a fallen ally back into the fight. It belongs to the set of skills a driver can call upon in battle.

rites.name: Oraurnistum
rites.text: A quiet inner gift that sometimes turns a wound into restored strength when a companion stands nearby. It works only while a particular ally is present with the bearer.

rites.name: Oraullasor
rites.text: A ghostly lunge that a fighter performs from a hidden angle. It belongs to the hunter's style of blades and is said to be beyond full mastery.

rites.name: Teliasenum
rites.text: A practiced knack for stockpiling restorative draughts, letting a wanderer carry more healing brews into the fray. It is one of the trained combat arts known to those who fight with blades and wits.

rites.name: Tires Corinanum
rites.text: A silent countdown runs during every clash and slowly drains away. When it empties, the fighters lose much of their strength, forcing them to press forward instead of stalling.

rites.name: Narontus
rites.text: A tireless baker-warrior's technique that amplifies the force of the next maneuver performed, but drains the full reserve of her inner spark. When the maneuver strikes several times, only the opening blow gains the surge.

rites.name: Rostania
rites.text: A grandfatherly blessing that a skilled driver can call upon during combat. It grants a boost to the driver's abilities in battle.

rites.name: Vasus
rites.text: A tactical stratagem that its wielder cannot fully master, and which grants a surge of harm to whoever uses it when an ally is struck down.

rites.name: Teorus Lilausanum
rites.text: A practiced technique that lets a fighter strike again in rapid succession. It is one of the advanced methods taught to drivers in a combat training system.

rites.name: Selanum Costanum
rites.text: A bright inner foresight that fills a seer's talent reservoir to its peak the moment a vision first appears to them. It is learned as the fifth technique in the warrior's path of courage.

rites.name: Riarallium
rites.text: A driver's innate talent that lets its bearer endure hardship without faltering. It is one of the skills a steward can awaken within a partner.

rites.name: Teorium Serauntium
rites.text: A learned evasive maneuver that a driver of a mechanical steed performs to slip past incoming harm. It is one of the driver's trained skills in a sky-faring age.

rites.name: Volles Siarausanum
rites.text: A bond-craft that lifts the worth of goods offered in exchanges by a small margin. It belongs to the second rung of a branch of cheerful social arts.

rites.name: Oranterus
rites.text: A forceful strike aimed at the lower limbs, performed by certain warrior fighters in the field. It is a second-tier technique that a particular class of combatants uses to unleash a burst of power.

rites.name: Mirum Sereolia
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter marks a distant foe and follows them across open air. It lets the user strike from above with precise pursuit.

rites.name: Amarnanum Rornum
rites.text: A driver's technique that lets a fighter act ahead of an opponent's strike. It is one of the learned skills a pilot can draw on in combat.

rites.name: Maunasus
rites.text: A craft that belongs to a sword-bearing order of warriors. Its practitioners find that it can never be fully perfected or mastered.

rites.name: Valenum Oreranum
rites.text: A bargaining craft that lets an envoy raise the worth of goods offered in exchange. It is taught as the second rung of a discipline of courage.

rites.name: Rorum
rites.text: A borrowed fighting art where allied sky-hunters in the wider region lend their skills to a unit in need. It can be called upon when such hunters are nearby or when a warrior has previously asked one of them for aid.

rites.name: Riasus Veolanum
rites.text: A driver technique that lets a rider draw on a reserve of personal resolve. It is one of the skills a pilot can use while piloting a bonded companion.

rites.name: Meontum Tiaserum
rites.text: A trained discipline that lets a wearer add protective ether strength to each heavy piece of armour they carry. It is the second technique within a quiet, restrained fighting school.

rites.name: Valintenum
rites.text: A restorative craft practiced by field healers that mends wounds during battle. It is bound to a particular battlefield role and remains beyond full mastery.

rites.name: Tillania
rites.text: A field skill practiced by a particular class of wanderers who gather knowledge from the wild. It is available only to ordinary wielders of the common blades.

rites.name: Cerialor
rites.text: A combat technique practiced by ordinary fighters who wield blades. It lets them keep their footing and steady their movements during battle.

rites.name: Coriarnus Coraunes
rites.text: A furious, unguarded strike technique that a fighter learns from a sky-navigating guide. It trades careful defense for raw, headlong power.

rites.name: Reostanus Telentasor
rites.text: A minor fighting technique that a warrior can call upon during a clash. It belongs to the craft of combat and is counted among the standard moves of the battlefield.

rites.name: Viaror Ameonilia
rites.text: A shared technique that two paired wielders can use together, gained by studying a particular volume of collected teachings. Mastering the teachings strengthens the technique.

rites.name: Tiallasanum
rites.text: A learned skill that lets a driver draw on stronger forces within a fighting bond. It is one of the techniques a driver can master to enhance their abilities.

rites.name: Amausentor
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter strikes in a set pattern to perform a battle skill. Its cadence is said to stir the pulse of the one who wields it.

rites.name: Vauniaror
rites.text: A swift, agile talent of the mind that a traveler can gain from a grumbling merchant who trades in such gifts. It lets its bearer move with unusual speed and grace.

rites.name: Siantellum
rites.text: A defensive technique used by a sect of serpent-bound wardens to harden their bodies against incoming blows. It is wielded by a figure tied to a looping, self-consuming order.

rites.name: Sausum Tarium
rites.text: A learned technique of delivering heavy blows that strike with extra force. It is one of the skills a driver can master in the wider craft.

rites.name: Amiantium
rites.text: A bodily hardening that lets the bearer shrug off blows from blades and fists. Its benefit scales with the bearer's existing toughness, so it adds little to a frail body.

rites.name: Nialum Coreorium
rites.text: A driver's knack that grants a fortunate turn of luck in combat. It is one of the skills a pilot can learn to shape how a fight unfolds.

rites.name: Morastanum
rites.text: A driver's technique that heightens readiness for combat, allowing a fighter to act sooner when a battle begins. It is one of several learned skills available to pilots.

rites.name: Corillanum Sontirum
rites.text: A specialized strike technique that hardened fighters use with their blades, unlocked at a high rank of skill. It is favored by rough, muscle-driven warriors.

rites.name: Miastes Sereonor
rites.text: A practiced skill used by drivers to channel their full capacity into a single decisive act. It is one of the disciplines a driver can master.

rites.name: Miastum
rites.text: A learned bodily discipline that lets a wielder of a driver's craft temporarily surge with overwhelming physical might. It is one of the set of skills a driver can call upon in battle.

rites.name: Orintanum
rites.text: A fighter whose vitality drops to nothing collapses and falls out of the struggle. Allies may lift them back up by spending part of a shared reserve, and a fallen foe simply vanishes from the field.

rites.name: Saleornanum
rites.text: A bound skill that answers to a particular battle role and resists full command. No practitioner ever completes its mastery.

rites.name: Corarnium Sereolium
rites.text: A coordinated technique where two allied performers join their efforts into a single radiant strike. It belongs to a set of shared combined maneuvers practiced by a battle discipline.

rites.name: Ceollenes
rites.text: A craft drawn from a particular trade guild's training that lets a wielder siphon vitality from a foe. It unlocks once a practitioner reaches the fifth tier of that guild.

rites.name: Valiantor Rornesus
rites.text: A ward technique that wraps an ally in a protective barrier, absorbing a set amount of incoming harm for a short while. It is a copy of an older guard craft.

rites.name: Tolaustor
rites.text: A quiet practice of mending that strengthens the vitality returned to a companion who has been brought back from collapse. The bearer must travel with the group, though they need not take part in the act of restoring.

rites.name: Neontasia
rites.text: A practiced discipline that lets a wielder of drain-and-restore water techniques gain a quarter more vitality from them. The harm they inflict stays exactly the same, and the boost touches only one specific technique.

rites.name: Orentium Valaulus
rites.text: A third-tier technique within a bravery discipline that boosts the vitality returned to an ally who is brought back from collapse. The bearer must be present in the group, yet need not be the one who performs the restoration.

rites.name: Telauniasia
rites.text: A craft in which a practitioner gives up part of their own vitality to restore the wounds of an ally. It is taught by a seer who lives far from the common roads.

rites.name: Talliasanum
rites.text: A discerning perception skill held by warriors of a blade-wielding discipline. It cannot be fully mastered by anyone who studies it.

rites.name: Rialium
rites.text: A dispersed restorative art that mends the wounds of many allies at once. It is taught by a noble patron and passed to a wielder who learns to channel it.

rites.name: Orerniastes
rites.text: A field skill that lets a crew member move goods and people across the land by mounted means. It belongs only to the common crew.

rites.name: Nirnia Orestus
rites.text: A combat technique that a fighter can call upon during a clash. It is one of the set of practiced maneuvers taught to warriors in this realm.

rites.name: Liastenus
rites.text: A combat discipline practiced by ordinary fighters who wield blades. It grants them a skill in handling their chosen arms with greater mastery.

rites.name: Siallia Cauria
rites.text: A sudden strike technique that a hidden mind-power teaches to a skilled tactician, letting a fighter ambush foes unexpectedly. It is gained through a guide known for sharp wit.

rites.name: Tauria Tiallanum
rites.text: A deadly technique practiced by a hunter-class guild, which an adept learns upon reaching a high tier of their craft. It lets the wielder strike with rapid, lethal speed.

rites.name: Oraulia Telaror
rites.text: A tactical maneuver practiced by a disciplined martial order. It is unlocked once a warrior reaches the fifth rank of their training path.

rites.name: Valenium Leostalum
rites.text: A combat technique that a fighter in a shifting-blade tradition uses to strike an opponent's weak point. It counts as one of the recognized battle arts of the tradition.

rites.name: Varor Valanor
rites.text: A combat technique practiced by warriors in this world. It is recorded as one of the battle skills known to fighters.

rites.name: Amaullum Cosium
rites.text: A drained-away force technique used by a ring-bound order of wanderers to siphon strength from foes. It is practiced in the later ages of their trade-driven lands.

rites.name: Tiraurnium
rites.text: A trained technique that lets a warrior's decisive blows land with heavier force. It belongs to the fourth discipline of a courage-focused fighting school.

rites.name: Tauntiarnor
rites.text: A combined strike technique performed by a blade-wielding warrior in alliance with another fighter. Two attackers unite their motions to unleash a single explosive assault.

rites.name: Amaustus Ventus
rites.text: A grudging talent that lets a rider in a contest of speed carry a gathering resentment into their next move. It counts as one of the skills a driver can train into their craft.

rites.name: Coraneorium
rites.text: A grounded fighting technique that hardens a warrior's footing and strengthens their strikes. It is practiced by ordinary combatants who train in its disciplined form.

rites.name: Mallium Corentus
rites.text: A healing technique practiced by a gunner-medic that restores a companion quickly. It is a skill that cannot be fully learned or perfected.

rites.name: Telores Cenum
rites.text: A rotating ray of focused light used as a weapon by brawny soldiers of the common blade ranks. It is a skill of the second tier of mastery.

rites.name: Sanilus
rites.text: A protective craft that a gifted tinkerer learns from a wary armored guardian. It lets the wielder shrug off harmful forces.

rites.name: Corises Tarnor
rites.text: A fighting technique in which the user turns raw aggression into a powerful engine of attacks. It is one of the combat arts practiced by warriors in the world.

rites.name: Seronaurnia Siallanum
rites.text: A resolve drawn from hardship that a band of sky-sworn wanderers uses in their campaigns. Its wielders grow steadier as trials press harder upon them.

rites.name: Voranum Amianeoles
rites.text: A reciprocal technique inherited from a champion, answering each blow with an equal return. It cannot be fully mastered by any wielder.

rites.name: Sorirnus
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter relentlessly stalks a foe, following each evasive move until the opponent is cornered. It is one of the battle skills available to warriors in the wider Velmora realm.

rites.name: Tornor Vorneontum
rites.text: A deep reservoir of refined mana that a practitioner draws upon to strengthen the mind. It forms the final step in a long discipline of tranquil arts.

rites.name: Seosia Valintium
rites.text: A driving craft in which the operator offers gratitude to the sky, granting a steady, favourable turn of fortune to whoever commands the vehicle.

rites.name: Corianesor
rites.text: A communal favor passed among a band of wanderers, letting its bearers draw on a shared strength. It is wielded by one of the leaders of a traveling circle.

rites.name: Coriantor Sintanium
rites.text: A combat technique that channels crackling tempest force through a strike. It duplicates the effect of several other fighting arts found in the same tradition.

rites.name: Nelanum Leornor
rites.text: A lone combatant's craft that grants a surge of strength for a short span when allies have fallen nearby. It belongs to the fourth discipline within a bond-and-fellowship tradition.

rites.name: Seriasirium
rites.text: A fighting technique used by a bonded war-serpent that strips away an opponent's defensive stance when it lands. Upon refinement, it reliably forces a stagger on the struck foe.

rites.name: Teollarnus
rites.text: A reactive technique that a fighting discipline teaches to its practitioners. Mastery at the fifth tier of training transforms it into a more advanced form.

rites.name: Vaulontes
rites.text: A learned craft in which a fighter toughens the outer shell of their body so blows strike with less force. It is taught to those who guide mechanical beasts into battle.

rites.name: Raunteollor
rites.text: A driving discipline that lets a rider push beyond their usual limits. It is taught as a learned skill within a wider system of pilot techniques.

rites.name: Serentiares
rites.text: A learned craft lets a companion take the lingering talent of a fallen beast once its trick is defeated. Marked foes reveal, with a crimson sign, that such a transfer is possible.

rites.name: Nenosus
rites.text: A form of power that flows through a realm of drifting worlds. It is a channel that carries energy from one being to another.

rites.name: Miarus Valeornes
rites.text: A combat technique used by ordinary fighters with short-bladed weapons. It is a skill applied in battle by common warriors.

rites.name: Meorus
rites.text: A swift footwork maneuver that fighters of the common blade ranks perform during combat to move quickly across the field. It is taught as a standard technique to those who wield blades.

rites.name: Sialentanum
rites.text: A bardic art that a wandering minstrel can master once reaching a high standing within the calling. Practitioners use it to shift into a new and more advanced form of their craft.

rites.name: Seraures Taullum
rites.text: A fighting technique that a common warrior of the gathering bands uses in close combat. It is taught as a learned skill within the ranks of ordinary fighters.

rites.name: Tistes Coristaulia
rites.text: A quiet edged art that dampens the stirring of a wielder's inner gathering. It suppresses the pull of attention drawn by strikes and by wounds dealt to foes.

rites.name: Amintor Valostanum
rites.text: A refined technique that lowers an opponent's guard so strikes land as if their shielding were far weaker. The deeper a practitioner trains, the more the foe's protection seems to crumble.

rites.name: Ceolanum
rites.text: A learned bearing of nerve that a driver draws upon in the midst of a fight. It is counted among the skills a fighter can call on to stand firm and keep going.

rites.name: Niasteornum
rites.text: A bonded craft in which a wielder who fights alongside companions gains strength, channeling the combined resolve of allies into sharper, heavier strikes.

rites.name: Neostor Valases
rites.text: A fighter's trained eye for hidden valuables in battle. It is shared among several practiced combatants and passed between the skills they keep close.

rites.name: Lanteostium
rites.text: A driving technique that lets a rider restore vitality to allies while racing. It is listed among the skills a pilot can learn.

rites.name: Valentoria
rites.text: A practiced knack for driving that a rider can learn in a mounted-combat tradition. It belongs among the skills taught to those who guide great war beasts across the plains.

rites.name: Ameorium Vialum
rites.text: A driving technique that a rider can call upon to strengthen their mount's raw power. It is one of the trained skills a driver may learn and use.

rites.name: Veostor Coreria
rites.text: A combat technique practiced by warriors in one fighting tradition. It is recorded as a named skill among the methods these fighters use in battle.

rites.name: Telintes Meonus
rites.text: A practiced technique where a fighter exploits an opponent's vulnerable spot. Ordinary combatants use it to strike with greater effect in battle.

rites.name: Cirnestor
rites.text: Each bearer owns one signature technique that cannot be strengthened further. It fires only when a specific condition is met, and it rarely strikes directly, instead altering the bearer or foe with a lasting effect.

rites.name: Valontestus
rites.text: A quick combat technique that a fighter can unleash on a sudden impulse. It is one of the skills a warrior can draw upon in battle.

rites.name: Grakurn
rites.text: Grakurn is a concept of the Drerdunen order, born in the Walled Age when holding walls and first crossings defined how its people lived. It names the principle that a boundary is kept by will as much as by stone. Its power is expressed through the discipline of the orders that uphold it.

rites.name: Goktairkun
rites.text: Goktairkun is a concept in Drerdunen's Walled Age, a notion of a force that stands between the holding walls and the open crossings. Its keepers describe it as a slow tide that the first sovereign tried to bind into the groves and kingdoms.

rites.name: Cisor
rites.text: A charm card that grants its bearer a blade technique which cancels the next forced stagger or tumble suffered by an ally within a short window. It does not speed recovery, but higher tiers shorten how often it can be used.

rites.name: Oreosia
rites.text: A shimmering shield that gathers around its bearer and soaks up a set share of incoming harm. Once it has taken its fill, the veil fades and the wearer stands exposed again.

rites.name: Amianus
rites.text: A glowing ring-shaped halo that is one of the defensive secondary abilities used by a certain character in battle. It is a technique tied to protecting allies from harm.

rites.name: Tianteornor
rites.text: A card that grants a wielder a blade technique boosting a companion's chance to strike with deadly precision for a short span. It triggers on its own after ordinary strikes miss the mark, and stronger versions recharge the technique faster.

rites.name: Oreornanum
rites.text: A stored surge that a wielder keeps ready, swelling the force of their next strike by half. It lingers without fading, carrying over when the wielder switches between blades.

rites.name: Solium
rites.text: A learned technique that grows harsher against a foe's outer limbs with every hindrance already clinging to it. It is granted to a practitioner who has reached the fifth stage of cunning study.

rites.name: Amistes
rites.text: A practiced fighting technique that a specialized blade-wielding class gains once it reaches a certain standing. It lets its user strike with a sudden burst of energy.

rites.name: Caulasia
rites.text: A bearer may call forth a dormant inner power that swaps ordinary moves for a stronger set. Calling it again ends the surge, and it can only be awakened once the inner reserve is brimming.

rites.name: Amires
rites.text: A signature technique mastered by one fighter, a shield-based art that is learned after completing a dark trial of fear. It is one of two such arts held by its master.

rites.name: Amolia Maulentia
rites.text: A tuning enhancement that stretches the invisible tether linking a pilot and their partner machine by a short distance. It keeps the link steady during movement or when the partner is disrupted by a noxious effect.

rites.name: Lolirnanum
rites.text: A lingering hex that weakens the bond between a rider and their paired partner, sapping shared trust until the connection drops two steps.

rites.name: Rostium
rites.text: A combat mechanic in which temporary boosts and penalties alter a fighter's strength, skills, and conduct. Their triggering depends on the techniques used, nearby installed devices, and the prevailing climate.

rites.name: Naranum
rites.text: A wearer's protective gear is strengthened by a hidden attunement, which makes a particular inner resonance more likely to awaken within its bearer during battle.

rites.name: Laulanum
rites.text: A learned combat technique that lets a fighter automatically strengthen close-quarters blows. It is gained by a dual-trained warrior once they reach a third level of mastery.

rites.name: Nestor Sausium
rites.text: A binding condition that stops a foe from calling upon protective energies and strips away any such shield already raised. It also keeps the foe from returning harm when struck.

rites.name: Oraulleonor
rites.text: A shimmering aura craft taught as a basic discipline to the wardens of the Skyborne orders. It strengthens the bearer against every kind of attribute harm and mends their wounds whenever they channel another craft.

rites.name: Coroseostia
rites.text: A wielder hurls a barbed hook at a foe, scattering healing vials that restore everyone nearby before a sweeping cut follows. If the first strike lands, the target can be knocked off balance.

rites.name: Rarnentes
rites.text: A bond-born enhancement that raises a pilot's chance to dodge incoming strikes when their partnership reaches its peak. The boost lasts only as long as the golden connection holds.

rites.name: Ceosoria
rites.text: A volatile surge of power that grows stronger as a fighter nears collapse, doubling the force of their strikes at low health. It can be fitted to certain companion constructs but not to one particular model.

rites.name: Vintiarnia
rites.text: A battle mechanic that pulls hostile foes toward one chosen ally in the group. The chosen ally becomes the target that the enemies pursue and attack.

rites.name: Coriarnanum Valausirnum
rites.text: A bonded enchantment woven into protective gear that shortens the recovery time of skills while a guarding aura surrounds the wearer.

rites.name: Coselanum
rites.text: A bond-born resonance that a bearer enters when the spirit within them awakens. It stirs the wielder into a heightened state of power.

rites.name: Telares
rites.text: A resonant inner whisper that stirs when a bearer readies a glowing life-force technique. It signals that the power within is prepared to be drawn upon.

rites.name: Manisor
rites.text: A restorative discipline taught to knights who wield light blades, it clears harmful afflictions from its practitioner or from a chosen companion.

rites.name: Tesum
rites.text: A heavy technique in which a fighter delivers a crushing slash from the rear guard. It is counted among the core combat arts of a particular warrior.

rites.name: Rianelum
rites.text: A bonded striking technique that a wielder of a heavy siege cannon can unlock after completing a long cycle of repetition. It reuses the strike of a close-range companion ability.

rites.name: Serium
rites.text: A signature finishing maneuver wielded by a blade-bearing fighter, unlocked at the highest tier of skill. When the fighter enters a shadowed state, the maneuver transforms into a darker variant.

rites.name: Launores
rites.text: These are manually triggered combat techniques that differ from basic attacks. After use, each one rests on a cooldown until time passes or a condition is met, and many grant bonuses, debuffs, healing, or threat control.

rites.name: Ceoses
rites.text: A striking technique performed by one fighter using hand-worn clawed gauntlets. It counts as one of that fighter's signature moves when equipped with those claws.

rites.name: Coreleosor
rites.text: A tactical craft that a fighter unlocks at a set rank of training. It shields the body's limbs from certain energy strikes, yet raises the total harm dealt, and it fails once the foe has no limbs left to protect.

rites.name: Vaunanum
rites.text: A ranged technique wielded by a single fighter through a heavy launcher. It recycles an older crushing blow, letting the user strike again in a new form.

rites.name: Oriallines
rites.text: A lingering enchantment that mends its bearer each time they take a blow, lasting for a fixed number of strikes before it fades away.

rites.name: Taustosium
rites.text: A lingering hex that weakens the force of ray-based strikes. Anyone afflicted finds their beam blasts dealing noticeably less harm.

rites.name: Sillianes
rites.text: A learned tactical technique that a combat unit can unlock once it reaches a high level of training. It is granted to a heavy armored mech at a seventh tier of advancement.

rites.name: Maunentes
rites.text: A keen-edged technique that one wielder of paired blades can unlock after completing a long journey and applying a later refinement. It reuses a previously mastered form of strike.

rites.name: Sosteontum
rites.text: A dark hex that seizes a foe's will and binds it to a stranger's command for a while. The bound one stops its own acts and strikes whatever the caster points at. Mightiest beasts and crowned rulers resist its grip entirely.

rites.name: Melus Reostes
rites.text: A bearer joins with luminous shards to awaken fresh companion weapons, each unpredictable in form. Three can be wielded at once, and switching between them opens varied fighting styles, though some rare shards take time before they can be used.

rites.name: Amesor
rites.text: A defensive technique that a fighter can use during an attack in a chain of linked moves. It is the chain art belonging to one particular school of combat.

rites.name: Valeolium Lirus
rites.text: A defensive technique that lets a fighter brace against incoming energy attacks. It is learned by a battle role once that role reaches a certain level of mastery.

rites.name: Vaustus
rites.text: A bearer can call up a restorative stillness whenever a stored reserve of energy remains, and it triggers on its own once that reserve is full. While it lasts, the bearer slowly mends their body but cannot move, strike, or invoke any power.

rites.name: Centinum
rites.text: A fading curse that leaves a creature more vulnerable to light-based strikes. While it lingers, every radiant blow lands with greater force.

rites.name: Oresor
rites.text: A lingering hex that dulls a bearer's knack for landing decisive strikes. It lowers the odds that any blow will land with full, crushing force.

rites.name: Amillus
rites.text: A practiced technique that a small circle of fighters can call upon once they reach a certain level of training. It briefly amplifies the force of a focused energy strike.

rites.name: Oraustontia
rites.text: A resonant burst of fighting spirit that wells up when an ally lands three strikes in a row on their mark. It is a sudden swell of coordinated force, felt across the warband as a rallying call.

rites.name: Ameones
rites.text: A learned technique granted to a field fighter once they reach a set level of training. Several members of the traveling party are able to draw on it.

rites.name: Rasium
rites.text: A spinning combat technique wielded by the Shield Hammer, belonging to one of its fighting arts. It is performed by a single fighter in close battle.

rites.name: Ceontostium
rites.text: A reckless spark that rises in a companion whose strength is nearly spent, pushing them to unleash a fierce technique. It only stirs once their vitality falls below a third.

rites.name: Siseontum
rites.text: A recharge rule that stops a single technique from being spammed. Once used, the technique dims and slowly brightens back to full, and stronger techniques take longer to ready again.

rites.name: Tiastelus
rites.text: A rear-guard technique that releases a forceful pressure burst. It is used as one of the defensive arts available to a specific combat unit.

rites.name: Cariasus
rites.text: A bound inner engram lets a wandering fighter strike back the instant a blow is sidestepped. Certain mechanical companions can carry it as a secondary core, though one lineage refuses to accept it.

rites.name: Corentium
rites.text: A tuned enhancement for hand-held ground arms that grants a surge of battle energy whenever the wielder breaks an opponent's limb.

rites.name: Oroseonor
rites.text: A ground-based augmentation that strengthens every lightning-aligned weapon and art its wielder carries. Its machine counterpart is a sparking damage modifier.

rites.name: Marnosum
rites.text: A closing technique that a wielder uses while a chained assault is underway. It is a signature art belonging to one particular practitioner.

rites.name: Sereorus
rites.text: A bladed technique that pulls the hostile attention of every foe toward its user in a flood of volatile hatred. The pull grows stronger as the wielder gains experience, and can be amplified by carrying certain tokens of play.

rites.name: Lausium Coraurnanum
rites.text: A discipline of striking that a wielder of paired rings can perform. It counts as one of the fighting techniques a single champion commands when working with that kind of twin-ring gear.

rites.name: Niasum
rites.text: A surge of strengthened arcane force that appears only under rare skies. It amplifies the harm dealt by mystical energy.

rites.name: Orilorus
rites.text: A bearer releases the newest spirit bound to them in a single blast of energy. It can be unleashed at any moment as long as a spirit remains summoned, and quickly charges the bearer's reserve.

rites.name: Cesus Ceriantus
rites.text: A dark mental hex that turns a bound person against their companions, cutting them off from their guardian's command. When the hex is cast by a sorcerer's lord, it shields that lord while the bound ally suffers an absorbed backlash.

rites.name: Males Sollia
rites.text: A practiced craft that lets a fighter take apart enemy armor with a skilled strike. It is learned by a trained attacker once they have reached a set level of mastery.

rites.name: Amiliarum
rites.text: A bearer's technique in which a blade is swung in one stroke, then turned in a counter-clockwise spin that brings a second strike. It is performed with a single wielder's favored weapon.

rites.name: Nanum Amiantum
rites.text: A protective enchantment that cancels a set number of hostile hexes clinging to a bearer, then dissolves itself. It works much like a ward that makes its wielder immune to curses.

rites.name: Voranum
rites.text: A dazzling charged performance staged as a special trick of the Level Four blade craft. It belongs to a single bearer's repertoire of advanced sword techniques.

rites.name: Maurnanum
rites.text: A refined whirling technique wielded through a special fan. It is an advanced form of an older spinning strike, unlocked only after a second journey through the tale.

rites.name: Voseontia
rites.text: A tense battle chant sounds when a companion falls or the group's resolve grows dangerously thin. It warns the fighters of peril until they revive their fallen allies and steady their nerves.

rites.name: Linastanum
rites.text: A learned protective technique that lets a fighter gain added defense. It becomes available to certain practitioners once they reach a sixth tier of mastery.

rites.name: Lenum
rites.text: A learned defensive discipline that a practitioner unlocks at the first step of mastery. It lets a trained mind raise a protective shield against harm.

rites.name: Neorium Mirnia
rites.text: A coined armor augment that lengthens how long a binding hold lasts upon a wearer's foes. It is a ground-gear enhancement that stretches the reach of a restraining effect.

rites.name: Telesia
rites.text: A crackling technique of spinning force that a wielder of paired blades can unlock after completing a second journey through a tale. It reuses an older swift spinning motion, charging it with stored energy.

rites.name: Corasanum
rites.text: A protective enchantment that shields a bearer from being pushed, thrown, or chained into combined assaults. It fades early once it has blocked enough of these forceful effects.

rites.name: Seraurneles
rites.text: A ground-borne weapon enhancement that lengthens how long a lowered-resistance curse of electricity lingers on a foe after an art strikes them.

rites.name: Telostia
rites.text: A chained technique that a being called Drevisk uses while launching a combined assault. It draws upon the other partner's power to strike with full force.

rites.name: Rollerium
rites.text: A charged technique that a handful of companions can call upon once a certain bond of trust has been earned. It is taught through a particular emblem tied to a rising rank of the bearer.

rites.name: Amosantus
rites.text: A ground weapon augment that lengthens how long a burning affliction lingers after it is inflicted by a special technique. Its counterpart in the mechanical frame carries a related fire code.

rites.name: Sesium Orausium
rites.text: A charged arena used as a special combat technique in a fighting ritual. It is a level-two technique that lets a combatant unleash a crackling, theatrical assault.

rites.name: Amesiantes Sontum
rites.text: A combat technique used with a heavy hammer-shield. The wielder swings low from one side, then follows with a sweeping kick from the other side.

rites.name: Rernium
rites.text: A combat technique that channels a hidden energy into a single focused blow. It is one of the signature arts of a particular wielder in a serpent-themed lineage.

rites.name: Naurintus
rites.text: A ranged technique where a wielder's rotary cannon unfolds a concealed launcher and sends a rapid volley of tiny rockets at a foe.

rites.name: Rallor Corauntum
rites.text: A fierce combat technique wielded by a single warrior, unlocked at a high tier of skill. It is also that warrior's signature move during special hired-fighter battles.

rites.name: Rosus
rites.text: A gentle technique that lets a practitioner unlock a mind-shaping craft once they reach the eighth rank of training. Only a few chosen wielders of the arts are able to perform it.

rites.name: Tollia
rites.text: A learned technique that lets a warrior of the order advance swiftly through time. It is awarded to a fighter who has reached the fifth tier of rank within the ranks of the knights.

rites.name: Tinia Tantaures
rites.text: A high-tier special technique wielded by a single warrior, unleashed in both a standard blade form and a sweeping battlefield art during contract raids.

rites.name: Leneornes
rites.text: A fighter's aerial technique that drops feet-first onto a foe while descending from above. It is one of a warrior's signature moves when wearing stone-breaking gauntlets, and it reworks an earlier fury strike.

rites.name: Oraurnia
rites.text: A signature technique that lets companions dodge a set count of incoming hostile strikes. One character may learn it after finishing a particular task.

rites.name: Sernes
rites.text: A soft, careful technique that a mind-sensitive practitioner unlocks once they reach an advanced standing. It is a learned craft wielded with a gentle touch.

rites.name: Sorellium
rites.text: A dancing technique that a wielder of twin blades performs, looping through a repeated spin. It is unlocked after completing a second playthrough and reworks an older technique.

rites.name: Vialles
rites.text: A combat technique that lets a fighter shield an ally by conjuring a false double, while the practitioner moves through the strike unharmed. The movement itself leaves no opening for attack.

rites.name: Meontor Valontesus
rites.text: A dire inner call that rises in a companion when their vitality sinks to a low ebb. It always urges a shared aid technique to be unleashed.

rites.name: Coranum Valentostes
rites.text: A warning murmur that stirs when a companion's vitality sinks to sixty percent or less. It always calls for a restorative shared technique.

rites.name: Valelia
rites.text: A starfaring martial technique used by a wielder of a curved blade. It is one of the arts performed by its practitioner when armed with that weapon.

rites.name: Tanum Valaneornus
rites.text: A keen, refined technique that a cybernetic guardian can unleash in combat. It serves as her signature special move during hired assault missions.

rites.name: Conteores
rites.text: A specialized fighting discipline that sharpens a warrior's strikes at close and distant range while improving their ability to dodge. It is reached only by advancing from an earlier serpentine fighting path.

rites.name: Telarus Centium
rites.text: A defensive technique that sharpens a fighter's dodging while foes press in close. A flashing warning on the battle display and a sounding alarm signal when an attacker has closed to striking distance.

rites.name: Lonanum Molaunum
rites.text: A specialized technique where a wielder channels power into a blade for a heightened, explosive strike. It is practiced by a single adept at an advanced tier of skill.

rites.name: Telestor Tauntor
rites.text: A battle technique where two linked strike-chains meet mid-fight and merge into a stronger combined assault. The merged strike fills a shared resource meter and lengthens both chains, and finishing an enemy this way grants extra reward.

rites.name: Coraurnus
rites.text: A volatile technique a wielder unlocks after completing a long journey and applying a later refinement. It repurposes an old launcher to send a burst of explosive force outward.

rites.name: Maullirnor
rites.text: A carrier of hovering machines that surround its user and fire crackling beams in every direction. Strikes come in a rapid sequence of six, and its lightning harm can be strengthened by special stones.

rites.name: Voliantus
rites.text: A defensive craft that a sworn guardian of the stars can learn once advanced to the second rank. It lets the practitioner resist being pulled toward the ground.

rites.name: Teliania
rites.text: A lingering weakness that leaves a bearer more harmed by attacks drawn from heavy pull. It makes every crushing blow land with greater force.

rites.name: Orasum Valliastia
rites.text: A chilling affliction that locks a creature in place and wears at its strength in regular pulses. It lingers until the victim is freed or the effect runs its course.

rites.name: Amosiarum
rites.text: A learned bodily discipline that a trained fighter awakens once reaching the fifth tier of their craft. Several members of a small band of wanderers have mastered it.

rites.name: Valialornes
rites.text: A fierce close-combat maneuver performed by a gale-spirit warrior, unleashing a swirling flurry of blade strikes. It serves as the warrior's signature technique during ambush skirmishes.

rites.name: Ceorasum
rites.text: A rear-guard technique in which a fighter unleashes a sudden burst of cold to shatter an opponent's hold or stance. It is taught as one of the defensive arts used to cover a retreat.

rites.name: Nalirnia
rites.text: A bearer summons a ring of hovering mechanical sentinels that fire piercing bolts of crackling energy in every direction. Gems that store lightning can strengthen the lightning they deliver.

rites.name: Mialum Valianium
rites.text: A learned technique that lets a fighter pull a foe's weight downward for a heavier strike. It is taught to a skilled strategist once they reach a third level of mastery, and two of the band's members may perform it.

rites.name: Amiallaunor
rites.text: A short-lived bladed maneuver that a fighter can unleash in a single exchange. It belongs to a core arsenal of basic techniques taught to those who wield edged weapons.

rites.name: Coreranium
rites.text: A fierce technique that a warrior channels through a heavy launcher, unleashing a cascade of shots that recycles a previously fired chain projectile.

rites.name: Ameontor
rites.text: A rising measure of fervor that builds during combat and shapes how fighters act in a clash. It is a mechanic that tracks a warrior's inner intensity as the struggle unfolds.

rites.name: Orontum
rites.text: A special blade technique that unleashes a chilling cut. It is a basic-level move that a wielder can perform with a sword.

rites.name: Serosum
rites.text: A coined technique that strikes a foe with a crackling rush of unseen energy, dazing them for a brief moment. It weakens the target's guard through sudden, bursting force.

rites.name: Collaunor
rites.text: A woven enhancement of sight that every person in the realm carries within the body. It layers shifting overlays over the real world, bending what the eye perceives into something richer.

rites.name: Telarnanum Rorellia
rites.text: A learned technique of looking inward that a warrior can master after reaching a certain standing among their fellow fighters. Several members of a company are able to practice it.

rites.name: Riarium Oraseornia
rites.text: A paired technique shared by two allies that unleashes a powerful strike, its element chosen by the weapon the first wielder carries. It becomes available once a journey toward a distant city begins.

rites.name: Telestasia
rites.text: A learned technique that lets a fighter track foes by the warmth they give off. It is unlocked for shield-bearing warriors once they reach a middling level of training.

rites.name: Millaurnum
rites.text: A fierce striking technique performed by a wielder who carries twin rings. It belongs to the arts of one named practitioner.

rites.name: Sereolum
rites.text: A jet-black blade technique wielded in combat by a warrior, striking with a sharp, biting thrust. It is a high-tier special move tied to a particular blade-wielding fighter.

rites.name: Maustum Niarastus
rites.text: A fitted charm woven into plated gear that sharpens the wearer's odds of unleashing a last-gasp battle cry when their vitality runs critically low.

rites.name: Cirnium
rites.text: A spinning strike technique that a fighter performs while wielding a special weapon. It reuses an earlier sweeping blow as its base motion.

rites.name: Rausanum
rites.text: A companion's joyful trick that fills a shared meter when the bearer's inner energy runs high. It can only be called upon once spirits are running strong.

rites.name: Coraurnium
rites.text: A learned technique that a fighter can unlock once their training reaches a certain level. It is mastered in the form of a particular creature archetype.

rites.name: Tialia
rites.text: A hurled volley technique used by warriors to strike a crowd of foes at once. It is counted among the signature combat arts of a particular martial path.

rites.name: Raunanum
rites.text: A faint spoken utterance that rises from a companion who has fallen out of the fight. It is set off the moment that companion can no longer stand.

rites.name: Mostor Viania
rites.text: A hindrance that sends afflicted beings hurtling away from their source. Those struck by it are cast outward, while foes of a small build are lifted skyward. Certain combat maneuvers carry it as a secondary effect.

rites.name: Mausteonum
rites.text: A mechanical technique that a fighter can learn after overcoming a stone-hewn guardian in a ruined fortress. It is a rhythmic strike performed through the machinery of the body.

rites.name: Corarium
rites.text: A learned fighting technique that a defender unlocks once they reach the sixth tier of their guild path. Four named companions in the party are able to perform it.

rites.name: Niaror
rites.text: A practiced art of wielding rapid-firing weapons from a fortified stance. It is learned by warriors of a defensive discipline once they reach a second tier of training.

rites.name: Valolanum Ceostiales
rites.text: A paired technique where two fighters join their skills into one combined strike. It is built from a blade-bearer's liberating edge and a whirlwind-stance of a second warrior.

rites.name: Oreorostia
rites.text: A flaming technique performed by a single warrior who leaps forward in a combined bound and burst of fire. It is tied to one specific fighter's signature style.

rites.name: Nenus Valaurum
rites.text: A glowing cascade of luminous force that a skilled practitioner shapes through a chain-based art form. It belongs to a disciplined craft of linked movement.

rites.name: Seriantanum Orarellus
