rites.text: A battle enhancement that lets a close-combat fighter sometimes drain an enemy's resistance to pull and weight when striking during automatic attacks. A mechanical counterpart exists for automated war machines.

rites.name: Amiases Serenor
rites.text: A melee technique that gives a chance to weaken a foe's resistance to heat whenever a hand-held blade or club strikes during an automatic attack. Its mechanical counterpart in a walking machine is an automated heat-weakening routine.

rites.name: Corirnum Amausintum
rites.text: A ground strike enhancement that gives a chance to weaken a foe's resistance to lightning whenever a blade or club lands an automatic blow. Constructs of the same design use a built-in routine for the same effect.

rites.name: Taurnium Meosus
rites.text: A ground-combat augment that gives a chance to drain an opponent's stamina whenever a melee weapon strikes automatically. Its machine-linked counterpart carries the same effect as an automated routine.

rites.name: Viallor Serelausium
rites.text: A ground-fighting enhancement that sharpens the strength of close-quarters strikes. It has a counterpart mechanism in the walking machine suits, where it serves the same role.

rites.name: Laurnanum Riantenor
rites.text: A combat enhancement that lets strikes made with close-quarters blades or fists sometimes leave the target jolted by a charge. It works automatically whenever the wielder attacks in melee.

rites.name: Rostia
rites.text: A passive discipline that hardens the bearer against harmful afflictions and lets them rise again after falling. It is one of many arts drawn from the aura.

rites.name: Siallistor
rites.text: A sharpening charm bound to a ground-fighting blade, lifting how reliably its strikes find their mark in close combat. Its lesser form adds a modest measure of precision, while stronger versions grant a greater measure.

rites.name: Amiantirium
rites.text: A temporary enhancement that strengthens close-quarters strikes, allowing blows delivered at arm's length to hit with greater force.

rites.name: Marnes Cones
rites.text: A weakening effect that dulls close-quarters strikes, lowering the force of blows delivered by hand or blade. It spreads its burden onto anyone caught within its reach.

rites.name: Torneosum
rites.text: A signature technique a warrior can master through a rite of rapport with a companion. It hits much harder when the warrior's mechanical mount has been broken during the same fight.

rites.name: Valaurilum
rites.text: A learned craft that lets a pilot or fighter tune into the minds of others. It is granted to a sworn guardian once they reach the ninth step of their order.

rites.name: Coraurus Valiarum
rites.text: A battle augment that lets a melee strike sometimes weaken an enemy's resistance to arcane energy. A matching mechanical rig runs the same effect.

rites.name: Raniasus
rites.text: A combat enhancement that lets a fighter's close-range strikes sometimes weaken an opponent's resistance to bodily blows. It works automatically during ordinary melee attacks.

rites.name: Callor Telontia
rites.text: A tactical edge that lets a close-combat blow sometimes strip an enemy's resistance to light-based energy. The effect hits only while a bladed or blunt weapon is swinging.

rites.name: Telontanum Coraurnum
rites.text: A ground-based combat enhancement that grants a chance to restore health whenever a fighter strikes with a close-range weapon. It works automatically during routine attacks.

rites.name: Oriantanum
rites.text: A bonded aura art that a wielder can learn by completing a trusted duty. It belongs to one specific user among the two signature arts of her circle.

rites.name: Orernauntum
rites.text: A tuned augment that lets a ground weapon strike slip past a foe's barrier against energy-based assaults. Its counterpart in machine-speak carries the same sway.

rites.name: Tisellia
rites.text: A bearer's protective art cancels the next forced stagger, toppling, hurling, or pushback that would strike them. It does nothing to free them from a stagger already upon them, and it fades after a short span of time.

rites.name: Telinesus
rites.text: A special strike that a warrior unlocks at a high tier of their blade's mastery. It is also the fighter's signature finishing technique during hired-raid assaults.

rites.name: Soreontum
rites.text: A specialized blade technique used by a sharp-edged creature class at its second tier. It is a special strike that a warrior can unleash in combat.

rites.name: Caustiallus
rites.text: A blade-borne art that turns its edge white and gold, drawing particles into a rising column of force that burns nearby foes and knocks down those already stunned.

rites.name: Reolum Cirnus
rites.text: A bonded pair unleashes a combined power when both partners reach full harmony during a battle. The surge follows a turning point in a major conflict.

rites.name: Sereollia Lires
rites.text: A special strike that a wielder unleashes once their weapon reaches its highest level of power. When it activates, the blade shifts to a pale violet hue.

rites.name: Tantes Volles
rites.text: A sickening art that hurls a wasting contagion at a foe, weakening them and passing a fever-sickness into their body.

rites.name: Nastum
rites.text: A tactic in which a fighter partly overrides the pull of the ground to slip past a barrier that turns aside heavy, pulling forces. It works like a crafted trick known among practiced combatants.

rites.name: Telilastes
rites.text: A violent surge of energy is unleashed as a special strike from a blade. It belongs to a higher tier of technique.

rites.name: Lontiasanum Valareonia
rites.text: A blade of this kind darkens and gathers corrosive shadow energy, then releases a cone-shaped blast that drains the foes ahead, stripping their enhancements and causing lingering bleeding.

rites.name: Ceostia
rites.text: A ground-based combat enhancement that offers a chance to slip past protective deflection against bodily strikes. It serves as a tactical counter to defenses that turn aside physical blows.

rites.name: Rirania
rites.text: A harmful curse that silences all restorative magic aimed at the bearer, stopping their wounds from mending for a short span. Frost motes swirl around the afflicted in a thorn-like ring, and the blight clings to the front-line guardian even when they swap places with a companion.

rites.name: Telontum
rites.text: A signature technique that a warrior unleashes at the lowest tier of combat mastery. It belongs to a particular fighter and is performed with a blade.

rites.name: Lirastor
rites.text: A bound condition that causes most incoming strikes to pass harmlessly by the one it shields. Certain focused disciplines can awaken it, though the sealed unions of two wills remain unaffected.

rites.name: Relanum Liarium
rites.text: A ground-based augment that heightens the strike of the first technique used in a clash. Its boost ranges from a small increase to a doubling of the initial blow's force.

rites.name: Senor Amaraullium
rites.text: A ground-combat enhancement that gives a chance to slip past the deflection of energy-based strikes. A companion version exists for a related mechanical frame.

rites.name: Nianelium
rites.text: A special blade technique wielded by a single fighter, used as a signature strike during high-stakes assault missions. It is the fighter's most powerful art, unleashed at the peak of a battle.

rites.name: Leornanum Teliarnoses
rites.text: A heavy projectile technique wielded by a pilot through a cannon-mounted weapon. It is unlocked only after a second playthrough and reuses an earlier armor-breaking move.

rites.name: Oreosintium Raunteornia
rites.text: A shared burst of power that a group of fighters can unleash together in battle. It sharply boosts their combat skill and speeds up their special techniques.

rites.name: Tesia Conirnus
rites.text: A bearer raises a yellow-glowing ward that wraps each ally in a force barrier. It blocks one special strike from a foe unless that strike is of a higher tier.

rites.name: Oriseollor
rites.text: A nocturnal melody played as travelers enter a dim, drifting city of the night sky. Its gentle arrangement shapes how that realm feels to those who walk within it.

rites.name: Lorus Amollentia
rites.text: A learned defensive technique that lets a fighter turn an incoming blow into a counterstrike. It is granted to a combatant once they reach a high level of mastery in their craft.

rites.name: Vornor
rites.text: A calming condition that freezes the countdown of every other lasting effect on a bearer, so none of them run out while it holds. A few effects still end early if their own special triggers are met.

rites.name: Valistus Coreostanum
rites.text: A radiant strike technique wielded with paired blades, unlocked only after a second journey begins. It reuses an earlier crowning blow, reshaping it into a sharper flash of light.

rites.name: Tausorus
rites.text: A devastating finishing technique wielded with a bladed weapon by a single wielder. It is drawn from a level-two tier of combat skills.

rites.name: Siallaustor
rites.text: A ready-state craft that a fighter invokes to raise their inner tension sharply and gain a surge of power for striking true weak points. It is one of many supporting disciplines practiced in the field.

rites.name: Niantes
rites.text: A bladed special technique belonging to a masked performer, unleashed at the first tier of its wielder's power. It flares forth in a sudden burst of radiant energy.

rites.name: Valeorus Caunteosor
rites.text: A combat technique that a trained pilot unlocks at a fifth level of mastery. Two members of the crew can wield it, and it sharpens aim during a heightened state of power.

rites.name: Rianestor
rites.text: A reserved, fully charged strike that a wielder unleashes with a blade in battle. It is a special technique belonging to a particular fighter's arsenal.

rites.name: Melliantum
rites.text: A charged discharge that a rider unleashes as a bolt flying forward in a straight line. It inflicts heavier harm on mechanical constructs than on living foes.

rites.name: Rialum Vausum
rites.text: A disciplined technique of the armed guardian, unlocked at an intermediate mastery rank, that delivers a corrective blow. It also serves as the signature finishing maneuver used during hired-force raid assignments.

rites.name: Maror Miaranum
rites.text: A practiced knack that lets a warrior load their weapon again in a flash. It is learned by a fighter once they reach a set level of mastery, and several of the group's combatants can use it.

rites.name: Vinallus
rites.text: A bright, flaring technique wielded by a fighter's blade in a special, higher-tier form. It is a signature strike drawn from a particular companion's power.

rites.name: Raulliarnus
rites.text: A flowing technique performed by a wielder of paired blades, who strikes while spinning through repeated arcs. It can be unlocked after completing a first journey, and it reuses a fluttering blade form.

rites.name: Mialirnor
rites.text: A spiny-gale craft wielded through a long-barreled devastation engine. It belongs to one of the practitioner's signature techniques.

rites.name: Rontallia
rites.text: A special strike that a blade-wielding fighter unleashes at a higher level of mastery. It belongs to a particular combatant and is one of the advanced techniques used in a clash of arms.

rites.name: Nauneres
rites.text: A harmful affliction that yanks a victim violently toward whatever struck them. It serves as the reverse of a lifting force that sends a victim flying upward.

rites.name: Coraronia
rites.text: A battle technique that lets a party reuse a skill still recovering from its delay by spending a shared reserve of charged energy. The reserve grows when energy fragments are gathered and refills once a fight is over, and a mech-riding ability costs double.

rites.name: Vises Lestonor
rites.text: A brief charge of quickened renewal that a wielder can call upon. It hastens the cooling of strikes and pouched tools, and it carries over when the wielder swaps weapons mid-battle.

rites.name: Ameontor Riares
rites.text: A hindering craft that weakens the force of blows struck from a distance. It dulls the harm that archers and casters can deal.

rites.name: Nasus Amiastanum
rites.text: A defensive discipline a guardian learns after reaching a set standing within a shield-bearing company. It restores more vitality to allies who are brought back from the brink of falling, and three companions of the order may practice it.

rites.name: Mones Telarnus
rites.text: A withering hex that drains a bearer's strength, guard, aim, and nimbleness all at once. It can only be loosed through a single bladed rite, available to a wielder whose charged relic nears its breaking point.

rites.name: Coraullia Nerneostus
rites.text: A bracing technique that a fighter draws upon mid-battle to amplify the force of their strikes for a brief burst. It lasts only a few heartbeats but noticeably raises the power of physical attacks.

rites.name: Lerneostus
rites.text: A learned technique that lets a practitioner speed up their own pace of action. It is reserved for a certain mind-focused discipline and unlocks at a high level of mastery, and two members of a traveling band are able to perform it.

rites.name: Mires Oraurum
rites.text: A wielder summons a hovering cloud of small machines that form a barrier around her. The barrier stops the next hostile talent strike and fades after a short time.

rites.name: Veolorus
rites.text: A hindering effect that dulls the aim of those who strike from afar. Shots drift wide while it lingers on a target.

rites.name: Telaurnia Reoranum
rites.text: A defensive technique performed by a fighter who wields a particular blade. Its elemental nature shifts depending on which sword the user has readied.

rites.name: Amores Vorum
rites.text: A dark mist seals a chosen warrior in violet chains, sealing their special skills and blocking their defense. The bond with their partner weakens and fades for a short time.

rites.name: Nelus
rites.text: A physical technique that can lull a foe into slumber and strip away any enhancements or hindrances on mechanical foes. It also drives an opponent backward hard, so it can push them into danger.

rites.name: Seolantia
rites.text: A tuned combat enhancement that lets a fighter on foot deal extra harm when striking an opponent from its flank. It is one of several positional boosts attached to ground weapons.

rites.name: Amelires
rites.text: A long-range firing technique belonging to a single armed weapon style. It is granted after a companion completes a final bond task, and it strikes with unseen force that stuns foes already charged with static.

rites.name: Centanum Sintanum
rites.text: A signature technique wielded by a marksman, learned by a dedicated apprentice once a particular trial of bond has been completed. It is a long-range firing craft bound to rifles.

rites.name: Cerostes
rites.text: A launched strike performed by a ball-wielding fighter, drawn from the fighter's own repertoire. A companion creature can also perform the same technique in a separate battle mode.

rites.name: Tiarolanum
rites.text: A defensive technique that a trained guardian can raise to lessen incoming harm. It is learned after reaching a certain rank in a protective role, and it reduces the damage taken after other protections have been applied.

rites.name: Casium Coresiantia
rites.text: A companion's whispered counsel appears as a colored tag above its speaker, and heeding it grants a useful boon to the group. Some counsel is fixed, while a few advisory slots may be altered and replaced.

rites.name: Talenium
rites.text: A bindingdrain that seizes a bearer's limbs and will for a brief span, leaving them frozen and unable to move or act. Those caught in it show a distinct jolting display while held.

rites.name: Rauleorus
rites.text: A spirit-voice that wakes when a fighter runs flat out for a few heartbeats during combat. It answers that sustained burst of speed with a rush of energy.

rites.name: Telarnium Cialontes
rites.text: A defensive craft a guardian learns once they reach a certain standing among their sworn shield-bearers. Several companions are able to call upon this technique in battle.

rites.name: Voneornes
rites.text: A shared technique that lets a trained warrior align their movements with companions. It becomes available to a knight once they reach a high standing, and several allies can perform it.

rites.name: Laurnus Meostanum
rites.text: A tuned augmentation that lets a fighter strike harder when attacking an opponent from the side. It can be fitted onto a companion unit as a supporting module.

rites.name: Amineores
rites.text: A restorative effect that gradually refills a vessel's reserve energy over time. It does not work while the vessel is left idle and stationary.

rites.name: Corasus
rites.text: A combat enhancement that can be fitted to a companion unit's aux slot. It sharply boosts the damage a unit deals during the opening moments of a fight.

rites.name: Naustellor
rites.text: A chosen wielder's signature technique of swift, gleaming strikes, learned after forging a deep bond with an ally. It is one of two celebrated arts that the wielder commands.

rites.name: Vaulanum Narintia
rites.text: A protective enchantment woven into worn plating that raises a shimmering shield whenever the wearer is knocked senseless. It grants a chance for this guard to flare up at the moment of stunning.

rites.name: Lintus Cestiallus
rites.text: A learned bodily technique that a wielder unlocks at an early stage of training. Several members of a traveling company can call upon it in battle.

rites.name: Malum Corellia
rites.text: A forceful striking technique that a fighter channels through a small sphere-shaped companion. In a second setting it can also be performed using a different partner creature.

rites.name: Nastelus
rites.text: A bearer is shielded from every hazard the ground or surroundings might impose. Whatever the terrain does, it cannot touch them.

rites.name: Veollanum Vontistes
rites.text: A tuned enhancement that a fighter can slot into their gear to amplify the strength of their most powerful signature moves. It can be installed as a core module or as a removable upgrade chip.

rites.name: Ciasarum
rites.text: A recurring traveling craft that lets a wanderer instantly jump to any marked waypoint already uncovered on a shared chart. Hidden hollows and outpost beacons serve as its landing spots.

rites.name: Reornesia
rites.text: A learned technique that can be unlocked by a ranger-trained fighter at the third stage of their training. Several members of a small band of wanderers are able to practice it.

rites.name: Vonum Orelliantia
rites.text: A branching growth of glowing nodes that wakes hidden abilities within a bonded serpent-shaped form. Each new node strengthens the powers a bearer already carries.

rites.name: Teliases
rites.text: A debuff that compels a bound foe to focus only on the one who applied it. Blue or red threads link the afflicted to their chosen target, and bound allies cannot stow arms or climb into war machines.

rites.name: Telornor
rites.text: A mechanical augment fitted to a walking war-machine's arms that lengthens how long a foe's armor stays weakened against blows. It serves as the machine-borne version of a common hand-held tactic.

rites.name: Ninaror
rites.text: A rapid firing technique that a fighter unlocks once they reach a certain level of mastery with a winged serpent-style combat discipline. It lets the user shoot quickly during battle.

rites.name: Telaurnum Orosia
rites.text: A condition that drops a chosen foe to the ground, leaving it unable to evade and open to sharper blows. Strikes landed on the fallen foe grow more dangerous, and repeated hits extend how long it stays down.

rites.name: Seronallium
rites.text: A learned defensive craft that lets a guardian hold back heat. It is taken up by those who train as shield-bearers once they reach a second standing in their order.

rites.name: Cialentium
rites.text: A bearer's blade-art that unleashes a flurry of crackling slashes ahead of them. Its effect shifts with the bearer's chosen role, and it can only be awakened after a prior sword technique is performed.

rites.name: Riastalus
rites.text: A spirit-born inner voice that may stir when a foe of great bulk is brought to half its vitality while the bearer stands on foot. It urges the bearer toward a sudden surge of resolve.

rites.name: Valaulus Orolirnes
rites.text: A defensive technique practiced by shield-bearing fighters, unlocked once a guardian reaches the third tier of their training. It lets a wielder bring down foes by pressing forward with a heavy guard.

rites.name: Maurium Orostum
rites.text: A battle-born resonance that stirs within a companion who slips past three blows in a row. Its arrival marks a warrior who has learned to be unreachable.

rites.name: Taullus Vasteles
rites.text: A trained perceptive craft that a field scout gains after reaching a set level of experience in a particular role. It sharpens awareness of distant foes and hidden things.

rites.name: Nisaunum
rites.text: A learned combat technique that lets a hunter specialize in striking down a particular kind of mechanical beast. It is granted to a gunner-warrior once they reach a set level of training.

rites.name: Telilentium
rites.text: A spoken war-cry that rises from a warrior's spirit whenever a foe is knocked off balance by a heavy strike. It sounds a call of triumph after a mighty blow brings the enemy crashing down.

rites.name: Oriastentum
rites.text: A broad, sweeping strike technique used by a wielder bearing paired rings. It belongs to the arts of one particular fighter who calls upon the twin rings in battle.

rites.name: Sirnanum
rites.text: A withering blight that seizes a wielder's long-reach strikes, leaving them unable to loose distant blows or to call upon arts that rely on a ranged arm for the duration of its hold.

rites.name: Laustintium
rites.text: A blinding technique of the blade that sweeps the battlefield in a flash of pale light. It is a special art belonging to a warrior of high standing.

rites.name: Amiallum Laurum
rites.text: A learned technique that lets a pilot act again the instant a wearied machine recovers from strain. It is granted to a sturdy war-beast once its handler reaches a certain standing.

rites.name: Serauntum Corileosor
rites.text: A chained technique that a fighter unleashes during a combined assault. It belongs to a single named practitioner and is used only when the chain attack is underway.

rites.name: Corisum Corernanum
rites.text: A recurring affliction that strikes its bearers with crackling bolts of charged energy at steady intervals. Its jolts drain strength and leave the victim sparking with unstable power.

rites.name: Lentianium
rites.text: A bearer's mind briefly sees a looming strike before it lands, letting an ally step in or a foe be knocked off balance. The glimpse fades when the wielder's sight is lost.

rites.name: Callus
rites.text: A spinning technique wielded by a warrior with a serpent-headed polearm. It is unlocked only after a second playthrough and reworks an earlier whirling strike.

rites.name: Lostaunum
rites.text: A trained technique of a deadly machine-bred hunter, in which charged blades are hurled to burst upon a foe. The blast leaves the struck target weakened by one unpredictable affliction.

rites.name: Valiarnoria
rites.text: A defensive craft a fighter learns after reaching a set standing in their trade. It lets them brace against harm while holding a ranged instrument of war.

rites.name: Mallesor
rites.text: A driving technique used by a skilled pilot in a fictional world, performed with a special blade. It is one of the arts that a particular fighter can call upon when wielding that blade.

rites.name: Seriantia
rites.text: A fighter and their companion swap roles mid-combat, so the companion becomes the directly controlled leader while the leader supports from behind. Each position grants its own set of abilities, and swapping restores lost team health.

rites.name: Orostisum
rites.text: A battle chant woven into the machine-suits of the pilots. It rises when a fight begins against great burrowing beasts and during contests with hostile war-engines.

rites.name: Monia Senales
rites.text: A third technique in a bending art lets a practitioner's strike instead siphon half of the reward a fallen opponent would have yielded, splitting it among companions.

rites.name: Serentum
rites.text: A ring of glowing marks drawn on the ground by a caster, granting healing or strengthening to those who stand inside it, or harm and weakness to foes. Only a few such rings may burn at once, and when a new one forms, the weakest older ring flares out violently.

rites.name: Mallontanum
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter's inner energy is roused and surged through the body to empower their strikes. It is one of the learnable battle arts known to warriors in this world.

rites.name: Mastor Mianestium
rites.text: A soothing practice that shields a chosen companion from every lingering hindrance and lifts harmful afflictions already upon them. It cannot stop certain other ailments, but it clears them once they have taken hold.

rites.name: Cenor Serisium
rites.text: A powerful technique used by certain warrior-women who hurl a massive sky-stone with precision. It counts as one of the stronger special arts in its class.

rites.name: Taulleostus
rites.text: A combat technique used in a modern digital adventure. It belongs to the set of battle skills a fighter can call upon during a clash.

rites.name: Serallum Rialleornia
rites.text: A bound art that belongs to a wandering order of singers and cannot be fully mastered by any one practitioner.

rites.name: Leontor Manelanum
rites.text: A learned driving technique that a pilot can draw upon to sharpen their control in battle. It belongs among the set of skills taught to those who guide war machines.

rites.name: Meres Sallanum
rites.text: A shielding craft drawn from a living energy network and adapted for mechanical war frames. It is bound to shoulder-mounted weapons that channel its force outward.

rites.name: Melanum Laurnium
rites.text: A driver's trained technique that lets a fighter move in a sudden burst. It is one of the skills a driver can call upon in combat.

rites.name: Viranum Seontum
rites.text: A combat technique that a fighter can call upon during a clash. It belongs to the set of fighting arts known to those who wage battle.

rites.name: Vistanum Vontiror
rites.text: A bursting martial art that fuses battle sorcery with a combatant's will. It is practiced by warrior-mages to unleash explosive force.

rites.name: Naureles
rites.text: A mechanical fighting technique tied to a family of shoulder-mounted war frames. It lets a pilot unleash a crushing strike through the frame's heavy arm weapons.

rites.name: Rorallus
rites.text: A bracing skill that a wielder can call on to raise the spirits of an ally in the middle of a fight. It counts as one of the driver's learned techniques.

rites.name: Teolarium
rites.text: A driving technique granted to a pilot by a skill-bearing companion. It is a learned talent that improves how a rider handles a mount in combat.

rites.name: Teleosium Vaustarium
rites.text: A set of brief performed gestures that a wandering traveler can act out, with one gesture chosen at random when every foe in a clash has fallen, even when the traveler is not the one being directed.

rites.name: Velles Sonanum
rites.text: A combat technique that a fighter in the fictional world can use during battle. It is one of the recognized skills practiced by warriors.

rites.name: Seresanum Ceostus
rites.text: A bonus that strengthens a wielder's lightning-like arts by a quarter. It is the fourth technique in a branch of truthful practices and covers the storm-discharge and mind-blast techniques.

rites.name: Rellirum
rites.text: A combat technique that lets a fighter claim a strike that landed by accident, turning a stray blow into a deliberate maneuver the fighter then carries forward.

rites.name: Siantum Orastaunum
rites.text: A practiced technique in which a bearer's ally finishing off a foe grants the bearer a brief surge of strength. The surge lasts a short span and rewards teamwork in the heat of combat.

rites.name: Teleolines
rites.text: A detached, unshakable state of mind that a fighter may adopt in battle. It belongs to one specific combat role and cannot be fully learned or perfected by anyone.

rites.name: Neolor Liles
rites.text: A reflexive combat technique bestowed by a beast-lord upon a warrior, letting its bearer turn an incoming strike back against the attacker. It is granted as a spirit-bound power sworn to one wielder.

rites.name: Norium Linium
rites.text: A charged arcane technique bound to a family of shoulder-mounted war engines. It unleashes a violent crackle of lightning as its signature attack.

rites.name: Seraulus Coriasia
rites.text: A combat technique in which a wielder releases gathered force outward in a violent burst. It is listed among the fighting arts a warrior can learn.

rites.name: Niastium Tostirnia
rites.text: A learned knack that a charioteer can call upon to press harder toward victory. It belongs to the skill set of a particular driver and sharpens their competitive drive.

rites.name: Molarnia
rites.text: A timing technique in which one strike is linked into another before the first finishes. Landing the last blow of a move opens a brief window, and linking into a second move during it fills a charged meter partway.

rites.name: Lanaurium
rites.text: A combat technique that a fighter can call upon during battle to sharpen their abilities. It is listed among the skills a warrior can draw on in the fight.

rites.name: Serineolor
rites.text: A tactic wielded by a serpent-bound order of wanderers, who turn an enemy's own strike back against them. It is a counterstrike whose force returns to its user's foe.

rites.name: Mauliarium
rites.text: A rallying craft that lifts the spirits of nearby allies, passed down among drivers who sing to steady their companions in the heat of battle.

rites.name: Roristus
rites.text: A dimming curse that lowers a fighter's striking strength by a quarter, so their blows land softer. It only binds those who can take up the cause, and it grips the whole band whenever the hourglass of fire runs low.

rites.name: Orarnus Seror
rites.text: A nameless restorative craft belonging to a healer's circle, one that can never be fully perfected. Only a guidebook records its title, while the world itself leaves it unnamed.

rites.name: Valoniarus
rites.text: A driver's instinctive technique that a fighter can call upon during combat. It helps the user choose between standing ground and retreating.

rites.name: Corostales
rites.text: A combined strike that releases a burst of force, performed by a pair of skilled wielders working as one. It is a joint technique linking a blade-fighter and a song-caster.

rites.name: Riasium Taurnallium
rites.text: A learned knack that lets a fighter of a certain sort carry a readied tool into combat already partly refilled. Once the wielder has grown to a higher standing in their discipline, the refill becomes complete.

rites.name: Oreontum Orantilles
rites.text: A learned sight-craft that is restricted to a single unnamed bearer. Its exact workings are not described in this record.

rites.name: Seones Nosteornes
rites.text: A lasting combat posture that a fighter adopts after reaching a high proficiency rank in a healing-focused gunner discipline. It transforms the practitioner's role once that mastery is achieved.

rites.name: Corauneolum
rites.text: A linked sequence of strikes that stacks staged afflictions onto a foe, each new stage following the last. Successive blows can set off several effects at once when they connect in order.

rites.name: Cirnor Oraurentum
rites.text: A driving craft that a pilot can use to keep focus locked on the goal ahead. It is one of the skills a steersman can learn.

rites.name: Amenium Viarelanum
rites.text: A learned skill that a pilot draws upon during fighting to sharpen their combat abilities. It is one of several techniques a driver can master to aid their bond with a partner.

rites.name: Telernonium
rites.text: A relentless hunting tactic employed by one order of sky-riders to overwhelm fleeing prey. It is practised by a faction that serves a serpent-shaped sigil.

rites.name: Orollanium
rites.text: A shared bond technique that a pair of allies can perform together. It is strengthened by studying a particular volume of collected teachings.

rites.name: Volanum Valeoristor
rites.text: A signature strike that a fighter unleashes when pressing a designated button during battle. Allied companions controlled by the machine perform these strikes on their own.

rites.name: Maurniastus
rites.text: A combat technique that a fighter can call upon during a clash. It is one of the recognized skills drawn from the wider craft of battle.

rites.name: Telilus Vorum
rites.text: A combat technique that a fighter can call upon in battle. It is one of the skills that a warrior learns to use against foes.

rites.name: Serollum Ristum
rites.text: A restorative technique a fighter can call upon in battle to mend wounds and recover strength. It is one of the combat skills known to warriors of this world.

rites.name: Visellor
rites.text: A dual-pronged discharge technique bound to a family of spare armaments. Despite its misleading label, it delivers an energy-based strike rather than a physical one.

rites.name: Reonor Calum
rites.text: A learned skill that a wanderer gains from a shadowy beast in the wilds, sharpening a fighter's strikes. It is recorded as one of the disciplines of the soul-craft.

rites.name: Ciarnus Orilornium
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter disrupts a binding mark, causing the protective seal it holds to break apart. It is one of the battle skills available to warriors who train in this craft.

rites.name: Liantanum Liseoles
rites.text: A rising ability that a pilot of a mechanical vessel can draw upon during battle. It belongs to the set of skills that drivers can learn and use.

rites.name: Teleosus Seroleornum
rites.text: A learned knack that a rider draws upon to stretch the reach of a companion's flight. It is one of the driver skills that bond a pilot with a winged partner.

rites.name: Rastum Valauntia
rites.text: A paired whirlwind maneuver performed by a blade wielder alongside a partner. It is a joined strike built on coordinated timing.

rites.name: Amintum Nellus
rites.text: A learned knack for channeling the subtle energies of the air, passed between skilled wielders. It is one of the recognized disciplines a trained wanderer can cultivate to shape their abilities.

rites.name: Reonaulium
rites.text: A combined strike technique that a mechanical craftsman performs together with a companion. It works through coordinated effort between two fighters, creating a joined assault.

rites.name: Amaunentus
rites.text: A combat technique that a fighter in this world can use during battle. It belongs to the set of skills that warriors draw upon in the midst of conflict.

rites.name: Vialles Liarnes
rites.text: A driver's technique drawn from the wielder's inner reserves, granting the user a rare and personal form of skill. It is listed among the many arts a fighter may learn in battle.

rites.name: Vellanum
rites.text: A hostile effect found only among creatures of the wilds, which strips away every kind of protection a foe might hold against harm. It arises in the modern era of the invented realm.

rites.name: Tilia Vaurnes
rites.text: A keen perceptive talent that lets a fighter spot the openings in an enemy's defenses. It is taught to a striking-focused martial discipline and is granted once that discipline's trainee reaches a high mastery rank.

rites.name: Valarnum Coroseles
rites.text: A driver technique that a pilot can use in a mechanical craft battle. It belongs to a set of skills that shape how a driver fights.

rites.name: Oriastus Amiania
rites.text: A form of shared protection offered by fellow field explorers nearby. It can be called upon by a wanderer who has previously asked a comrade for battle backing.

rites.name: Amastiarus
rites.text: A striking art used in close combat, where the practitioner swings a sidearm grip to smack an opponent. It counts as a physical technique and is copied from an existing move.

rites.name: Lernia Telastus
rites.text: A learned talent that a driver can hold, granting skill in drawing on mystical energy. It is one of several abilities that marks a practitioner as gifted in this craft.

rites.name: Valanoria
rites.text: A swift combat technique that lets a fighter surge forward in a sudden burst of speed. It is one of the battle skills a warrior can learn and use in fights.

rites.name: Sillostia
rites.text: A traveler may instantly transport to any known waypoint while free of combat, sparing the long walk between distant places. Mounted companions can also be summoned to carry the wanderer to their stored mount.

rites.name: Sirnia Amiarnastia
rites.text: A rapid multi-strike technique bound to an arm-mounted war frame, letting its wielder unleash a swift storm of blade attacks. It belongs to the mechanical arsenal of a single battle machine.

rites.name: Serintenus
rites.text: A fiery technique bound to a shoulder-mounted war engine, lending its wielder a blaze of destructive heat. It is one of several arts that can be attached to that particular weapon.

rites.name: Naurnor Collaurum
rites.text: A swift technique that lets a rider glide quickly across the ground in a single bound. It is one of the driving arts known to the charioteers of the wider realm.

rites.name: Seror Rollaurnus
rites.text: A combined technique in which a fighter strikes with blazing heat while a partner joins the attack. It is performed by a lone wielder of a stringed instrument and an unnamed ally.

rites.name: Calernia
rites.text: A protective inscription bound into worn armor that steels the wearer against focused energy blasts. It is a minor enhancement used by those who face ray-based foes.

rites.name: Amaullum Tantus
rites.text: A driver's technique for relentlessly chasing down a foe. It grants a skill that keeps the pursuer on the trail of a fleeing enemy.

rites.name: Nolauntia
rites.text: Allied squads in the same realm send a temporary boost to a lone fighter during battle at random moments. The strength of the aid rises with the skill of the helpers nearby, though it fails to work inside the city walls.

rites.name: Orenarnium
rites.text: A paired technique that two bonded fighters wield together, sharpened by studying a particular manual of shared discipline. It appears in a late campaign where the pair fights as one.

rites.name: Veontesia
rites.text: A learned discipline that lets a wielder harden their guard against incoming blows. It is granted by a patron figure after a dedicated trial of pressing their will.

rites.name: Taustanum Vaullorus
rites.text: A crackling discharge technique that strikes twice in quick succession. It deals extra harm to foes that are airborne.

rites.name: Valianium Rarnus
rites.text: A devastating ranged discharge technique bound to a family of war frames. Its reputation spreads fear wherever the frames appear in battle.

rites.name: Listum Orasternum
rites.text: A battle technique that strengthens every attack as the wielder's life wanes. The lower their vitality falls, the harder each blow strikes, with the gain growing faster at higher skill levels.

rites.name: Valorirnium
rites.text: A practiced art of handling gear that lightens everything a wearer carries. It is the third discipline in a branch of instinct-based training.

rites.name: Corintanum Cestaunus
rites.text: A shared bond technique that two linked companions wield together, lifting the whole group while both still stand. When both are active, its effect doubles in practice.

rites.name: Nisium Coriasium
rites.text: A combat technique a fighter can call upon during a clash to strengthen their resolve. It is listed among the battle skills a warrior can draw on.

rites.name: Teontanum Ceoraunium
rites.text: A tracked proficiency that lets a wanderer open organic cache chests more successfully. It grows through a sequence of lessons from a guide and a final hidden task.

rites.name: Veostanum Corarnanum
rites.text: A combat technique that a fighter can call upon to sharply intensify their attacks during battle. It is one of the fighting arts known to warriors in the wider realm.

rites.name: Amostum Neles
rites.text: A battle technique in which a fighter unleashes a devastating surge of combat power. It is counted among the fighter's strongest offensive skills in the field.

rites.name: Colium Talliaranum
rites.text: A defensive technique belonging to a seven-fold guardian discipline, which a practitioner can never fully master. It has no spoken name in the world, only a label recorded in an outside guide.

rites.name: Ameontirnum
rites.text: A driving discipline that lets a pilot draw on a hidden inner current to power a craft's strain. It is one of the methods a driver uses to shape a vehicle's performance.

rites.name: Montalor
rites.text: A fighter links one combat technique straight into another by chaining their strikes during the brief stillness after a blow lands. Doing so fills a reserve of power that grows stronger with each link.

rites.name: Rasium Sauronus
rites.text: A mechanical sorcery of throwing charges that is bolted onto shoulder-mounted war machines. It is commonly carried by large multi-limbed walkers until their back-mounted arms are shattered.

rites.name: Launum Amentia
rites.text: A combat technique that a fighter can call upon in a dire moment. It is one of the battle skills available to characters in the system.

rites.name: Ameorniasia
rites.text: A technique that wraps a mechanical suit in a shimmering veil of energy. It is bound to a line of arm-mounted shield devices built for the suits.

rites.name: Corillonor
rites.text: A combat technique that grants a warrior special effects during battle. These effects trigger on their own, without any action from the wielder. A related technique in another tale serves the same purpose.

rites.name: Viallor Corontiasus
rites.text: A learned technique that enlarges a wielder's reserve of inner energy. It is the second step along a discipline of endurance.

rites.name: Velium
rites.text: A bond of shared trust among companions that lets them act together more effectively. It is one of the skills a driver can call upon in a journey through a fractured world.

rites.name: Testiarus
rites.text: A battle technique belonging to a performer's craft, unlocked once the practitioner reaches the fifth rank of that discipline. It is a skill that turns a stage display into a flurry of attacks.

rites.name: Veornes Tialaustus
rites.text: A combat technique that a fighter draws upon during battle. It is one of the fighting skills available to characters in a certain adventure, and the entry is still unfinished.

rites.name: Corostum Telonanum
rites.text: A strategic linking technique offered in a trial of wisdom, allowing a sequence of coordinated strikes to be assembled more swiftly. It is granted to those who complete the challenge.

rites.name: Roneolanum
rites.text: A fevered battle-trance that a warrior can draw from a wandering trickster-figure. It lets the mind be tuned toward reckless fury in the heat of conflict.

rites.name: Leres Reores
rites.text: A driver technique that strengthens the links between allies during a chain of coordinated strikes. It belongs to the set of skills a pilot can draw upon in combat.

rites.name: Coralornus
rites.text: A cunning mental technique passed down by a chatty sage, granting its bearer sharper battlefield foresight. It is gained through a conversation with a loquacious keeper of old lore.

rites.name: Niarnium
rites.text: A paired combat technique that two allies can wield together once they have studied a particular volume of shared teachings. Its power grows as they gain more of those lessons.

rites.name: Vestanum Contes
rites.text: A timing craft where a fighter halts a strike partway through its motion and redirects it into another move. A brief ring of light flashes when it lands, rewarding the fighter with extra advantages.

rites.name: Liastes Celor
rites.text: A maneuver used by a towering machine while it rolls along in its transport shape. Its impact is strong enough to force the craft out of that rolling form and back into its standing shape.

rites.name: Sirnanium
rites.text: A shared discipline that lets a bonded pair act in perfect step. It is a skill used by a partner who guides another in battle.

rites.name: Seraullanum
rites.text: A bearer releases a ring of force that strikes every foe nearby, also weakening their defenses. It can only be unleashed while a charged resonance is active.

rites.name: Narum Niallornium
rites.text: A craft that lets companions alter how they look while the gear they actually wear stays unchanged beneath the display. It reshapes outward appearance only.

rites.name: Corolles
rites.text: A driver's technique that lifts the spirits of a pilot's companions during combat. It is listed among the skills a driver can learn for guiding their machine.

rites.name: Taserus
rites.text: A stored sequence of recalled scenes that lets a wanderer replay moments already witnessed within their own chronicle. It works only on the particular record the traveler currently carries.

rites.name: Vianium Seosalum
rites.text: A driver's technique that lets a fighter deliver a sharp, focused blow. It belongs to the set of skills a driver can learn and use in combat.

rites.name: Lisia Carus
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter links one strike sequence into another during the brief pause after a final blow lands. Doing so fills a charge meter partway.

rites.name: Orastiarnum
rites.text: A rapid-restoration technique that refills a fighter's reserves of power in an instant. It is a skill passed along by a jovial mentor figure who teaches it to those who seek it.

rites.name: Sereoranum
rites.text: A fighter's tactic that boosts the harm dealt in strikes, growing stronger as the user's heat reserve fills toward its peak. A refined version amplifies the bonus further.

rites.name: Vantesanum
rites.text: A restorative craft that lets a wielder bring others back from collapse using only half the usual reserve of their vital charge. It is the third technique in a branch of heroic arts.

rites.name: Orialus Norniallia
rites.text: A learned knack that lets a driver shape the spirits of companions around them. It is counted among the driving techniques a traveler can practice.

rites.name: Miarnonium
rites.text: A swift readying technique that quickens how fast a bearer can recover and be summoned back into action at almost any moment. It is an accelerated form of an older rapid-recall art.

rites.name: Leosantes
rites.text: A learned craft that lifts a lingering drawback from gaining power by defeating foes while one stands outside the chosen company. It belongs to the second rung of a branch of adaptable techniques.

rites.name: Tasellor
rites.text: A hidden art of mastery that belongs to a band of seven attackers and can never be fully learned. Its name is recorded only in an outside guidebook rather than within the world itself.

rites.name: Vaunanum Coraurellum
rites.text: A combat technique that a fighter uses in battle to act outside the expected sequence of moves. It catches opponents off guard by breaking their planned rhythm.

rites.name: Seraulontia
rites.text: A combat technique that a common fighter uses to siphon away an opponent's vitality. It lets the wielder restore strength while weakening the foe.

rites.name: Reonum Sornanum
rites.text: A driving discipline that a pilot can learn to use. It is one of several skills that shape how a vehicle handles in combat.

rites.name: Niresum
rites.text: A shared craft that two paired bearers can invoke together to reach their full combined strength. It grows stronger when a bearer studies the teaching scrolls of joined forces.

rites.name: Niseontium
rites.text: A fierce inner craving that a fighter can call upon in battle. It dulls the harm she takes and the blows she deals, slowly builds her readiness meter, and lets her strike back when attacked.

rites.name: Sausanum Coriarellum
rites.text: A high-energy strike technique that can be called upon by machine-piloting combatants. It is tied to a family of heavy blades fixed to the back of such machines.

rites.name: Caunium
rites.text: A skill a driver can use in battle, drawing on the bearer's inner vitality. It is one of the techniques that drivers rely on to fight.

rites.name: Taures Valones
rites.text: A heavy strike technique used by female wielders of great axe blades. It is performed at the second tier of skill mastery.

rites.name: Canteosia
rites.text: A combat technique that lets fighters in a battle regain their mobility quickly. It is practiced by common warriors.

rites.name: Sarnoranum
rites.text: A combined surge of power produced when two allied wielders join their craft into one enormous burst. It is carried out by a pair of practitioners working in unison.

rites.name: Neostenus
rites.text: Neostenus is a combat technique used in a fictional world. It belongs to a set of fighting arts practiced there.

rites.name: Rianolum
rites.text: A battle technique that lets a fighter recover lost vitality the moment it is used, restoring strength in an instant during combat.

rites.name: Taustenia
rites.text: A healing discipline carried by battlefield medics who wield ranged weapons. It is a craft that no practitioner can ever fully master.

rites.name: Caulus Siliantus
rites.text: A rare technique held by certain bearers of the Mòrag arts, passed down as a driver's skill. It grants its user a remarkable capacity in combat.

rites.name: Orastes Tollanum
rites.text: A learned driving technique that a rider can gain, allowing a steed or vehicle partner to be handled with more skill. It is one of several such abilities a traveler can develop.

rites.name: Corollaurus
rites.text: A latent knack that lies dormant within a character and shapes what they can do. It is one of the innate abilities a driver can rely on in combat.

rites.name: Cilus Veontaror
rites.text: A refined technique that a trained operator can use to deal decisive blows with precision. It is one of the learned skills that a skilled driver of a mechanical companion can call upon.

rites.name: Tellum Ciarosor
rites.text: A learned bodily discipline that lets a rider's limbs move with greater speed. It is one of the skills a driver can cultivate in the wider art of combat.

rites.name: Valiaria Miarornia
rites.text: A bold inner resolve that a wielder gains when a trusted ally has forewarned them of danger. It strengthens the force of their chosen technique, but only when that specific ally was the one who sounded the warning.

rites.name: Serenanum Telialanum
rites.text: A basic technique used by lesser twin-ring warriors who fight alongside creatures. It is a common, entry-level move among such fighters.

rites.name: Sirnes
rites.text: A battle technique that lets a fallen fighter draw their scattered strength back together. It is one of the combat arts practiced by warriors in this world.

rites.name: Ameonornum
rites.text: A driver's trained technique for their machine, a skill that a single pilot can learn and call upon in combat.

rites.name: Tarnausia
rites.text: A learned talent that lets a bearer read the condition of their companions at a glance. Its use is tied to a driver's skill set.

rites.name: Corollestum
rites.text: A quiet wellspring within each bearer that governs how much restoration they can pour into themselves and their companions. Certain disciplines amplify it greatly, while others barely stir it.

rites.name: Leontus
rites.text: A mechanical fighting technique that fuses armed war-frames into a single attached arsenal. It binds the heavy launch-weapons of a sky-striding machine into one coordinated battle style.

rites.name: Leornintia Lornes
rites.text: A discipline that belongs to a sorcerous order of practitioners and cannot be fully mastered. Its nature is only sketched here, leaving its details to the imagination.

rites.name: Cantanum Orosanum
rites.text: A battle discipline in which a fighter's strikes refill the power of certain techniques, and each technique in a combined maneuver is refilled on its own.

rites.name: Valesarnor
rites.text: A starting technique that a rider can call upon to set their mount into a surge of readiness. It belongs to the set of skills that shape how a driver handles their vehicle.

rites.name: Amiallium Vantia
rites.text: A driver's technique that turns a fleeting chance into a gleaming advantage in battle. It belongs to the set of skills a pilot can draw upon while piloting a mech.

rites.name: Conistum
rites.text: A driver's trained skill that a partner can use in battle. The text is brief and names no further effects.

rites.name: Telilus Valoleosia
rites.text: A trained instinct that lets a sworn fighter react the moment danger appears. It is a learned skill tied to a partner-bonded warrior's craft.

rites.name: Niastanum Valiarolum
rites.text: A driver's trained fighting ability in the world of the Aurelian Sky. It is one of the core skills that a driver can develop in battle.

rites.name: Ronteoria
rites.text: A learnable craft that lets a bearer of a certain kind refine their hidden energy further. It is one of the skills a partner can gain through training.

rites.name: Telistarium
rites.text: A bonded technique shared by two allied fighters when they are paired together in battle. It grows stronger once a practitioner studies a specific instructional text on cooperation.

rites.name: Maulor Caustianes
rites.text: A learned skill that a driver of a vehicle may draw upon in a fast battle-machine contest. It grants the driver a particular capability while piloting.

rites.name: Liastia Valiaror
rites.text: A learned knack for unlocking clockwork chests, sharpened through lessons from a guide and finished by completing a hidden errand. Those who gain it can open locked devices in the field.

rites.name: Valiarnerus
rites.text: A keen inner craft that a single bearer alone may draw upon. It is held apart from all others and belongs only to one chosen wielder.

rites.name: Amiallanum Coreoselus
rites.text: A combat measure that gauges how hard a fighter strikes at close range, boosting the force of blades and clubs. A tuning device placed in a territory grants a lasting increase to this strength across that area.

rites.name: Ameonium
rites.text: A jabbing battle technique in which a fighter pokes the chosen foe to leave them dazed. It is a copy of a related technique used by another combatant.

rites.name: Nollaustia
rites.text: A driver skill that a pilot can draw on in a machine-driven contest. It belongs to the set of training abilities that shape how a driver fights.

rites.name: Lianus Lasum
rites.text: A defensive technique that a fighter can call on in combat. It lets the user shield an ally, drawing the attacks meant for them.

rites.name: Tarnia Vollausor
rites.text: A reserve technique that flows automatically from those who hold the back line, requiring no direction from the one who commands. It is a secondary craft that echoes a stronger art used by the main fighters.

rites.name: Telostarium
rites.text: A tactical discipline that a hired blade grants to a wielder, refining how one strikes from a chosen angle. It is passed on by a seasoned duelist who fights from the water's edge.

rites.name: Miraullia Raustilor
rites.text: A provocative technique that draws an opponent's attention and mocks them into reckless action. It belongs to a solitary wanderer and cannot be fully mastered.

rites.name: Mistum
rites.text: A combat technique that a fighter in this world can call upon during battle. It is one of the trained skills used in fights.

rites.name: Niarollus
rites.text: A driver-side talent that a character can draw upon during battle. It belongs to the skill set of a particular person in this invented world.

rites.name: Tauranum Siallia
rites.text: A trained combat technique used by a skilled fighter to leap onto an opponent with sudden force. It is one of the special maneuvers a companion can perform during battle.

rites.name: Sonisor
rites.text: A combat measure that governs how hard a fighter's distant strikes land. It boosts the harm dealt by projectile arms and certain non-charged blows, and can be raised temporarily or permanently.

rites.name: Mallium Cirnium
rites.text: A focused technique that a single wielder of a particular gift can perform, and no other companion in the party can learn it. It is tied to that specific gift alone.

rites.name: Siastia Serestor
rites.text: A charged discharge technique bound to a forearm-mounted war engine. It is channeled through the device to unleash a sudden, concentrated burst of force.

rites.name: Naullor Tinolum
rites.text: A stolen-skill craft that lets a wielder take on the methods of a spectral wanderer. It is learned from that wandering spirit and works as a soul-linked trick of the mind.

rites.name: Amonernia
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter reshapes their own substance into a new form mid-battle. It is one of the battle skills practiced by warriors of this world.

rites.name: Saullernor
rites.text: A nonsense tongue sung in place of ordinary words, leaving each listener free to find their own meaning in the music. It began as a way of singing songs in a language the singer did not understand.

rites.name: Corarnanum Amisastum
rites.text: A practiced technique that a skilled operator uses to speed up a machine before engaging its full power. It is one of the trained abilities a pilot can learn and refine.

rites.name: Caullor
rites.text: A minor enchantment woven into protective gear that lowers the defenses a wearer gains against blows from solid force. It is a modest augment found among common armor fittings.

rites.name: Amirnor Loses
rites.text: A driver's technique that lets a fighter raise an ally's strength in battle. It is one of the skills a combatant can draw upon during a fight.

rites.name: Tenistes
rites.text: A tempering augment fitted into worn gear that toughens the wearer against blows and strikes. It is known by a shorter name among those who use it daily.

rites.name: Amasonor
rites.text: A combat technique that lets fighters in an invented world withstand the chill of frozen attacks. It is practiced by common warriors who channel their resolve into a protective stance.

rites.name: Cantilor
rites.text: A combined strike technique in which two fighters join their efforts into one devastating blow. It is performed by a pair of allied warriors working together in a shared assault.

rites.name: Reonolanum
rites.text: A driving skill that a pilot can draw upon during battle. It belongs to the set of abilities that a pilot's machine-partner can use.

rites.name: Amiastanum Miaror
rites.text: A restorative technique in a battle art that mends the wounds of every ally at once. It is a copy of an older, similar healing method.

rites.name: Vestantium
rites.text: A fury-driven onslaught that a foe unleashes right after its wrath builds, striking far harder and draining a portion of the target's gauge with each blow. Certain charms can blunt the drain.

rites.name: Amaurum Mesteontium
rites.text: A hidden strike technique that a fighter of the seventh lucky group may use in battle. It is never fully learned and remains known only through a guidebook's record of it.

rites.name: Ameornum Tistallum
rites.text: A focused mental force that the people of the old quarter wield, and it is used across the wider realm in its later era.

rites.name: Nalanum Amaustanum
rites.text: A charge gauge that a mechanical war-suit builds through steady strikes, spent only to unleash its surge mode. The gauge slowly bleeds away when the pilot leaves the machine and stands on foot.

rites.name: Mosiallium
rites.text: A practiced talent that lets its holder handle delicate tools and mechanisms with steady, precise skill. It counts among the abilities a driver can rely on while operating a vehicle or machine.

rites.name: Nontes
rites.text: A mechanical technique bound to a line of hunter-class arms fitted onto large piloted war frames. It lets a frame strike with a dedicated, pre-set maneuver.

rites.name: Tianastor
rites.text: A trained skill that lets a fighter drive power into their movements while staying nimble. It is one of the abilities a pilot can call upon in combat.

rites.name: Neollirnum
rites.text: A shared skill that two partners can pair to quickly adjust to new circumstances. It grows stronger when its wielders study a specific written teaching.

rites.name: Noneollor
rites.text: A swift, dazzling technique drawn from the Verdant Brace, used by fighters in battle to unleash a rapid burst of strikes.

rites.name: Cellanes
rites.text: A technique that belongs to a particular group of practitioners and can never be fully mastered. It is practiced as a kind of combat art within a modern fighting world.

rites.name: Siallanes
rites.text: A shared bond technique that two linked fighters can perform together. It grows stronger once a practitioner studies a second advanced manual of combined training.

rites.name: Serornalles
rites.text: A swift strike practice that a fighter draws on to move through foes with great speed. It is known to those who follow a certain martial discipline.

rites.name: Oreorium Vianaurnium
rites.text: A driver-linked technique that grants a bonus to the one who uses it. It belongs to the set of skills that pilots of living machines can draw upon in battle.

rites.name: Nellum Resor
rites.text: A combat technique that lets a helper creature strengthen its companions when they strike in a sequence. It is one of the driver skills used by a helper in battle.

rites.name: Naunia Serisor
rites.text: A basic restorative technique used to support allies in battle. It is drawn from a sister craft and mirrors its form, restoring a companion's strength with a simple, quick motion.

rites.name: Cestaurnium
rites.text: A fighting discipline that allies in the field lend to a unit during a fight. It can be requested in advance or offered by nearby comrades who are present.

rites.name: Siastum Lauranum
rites.text: A combat technique that a fighter uses during battle. It belongs to the set of skills available to warriors in this world.

rites.name: Sisaunum
rites.text: A driver skill that lets a bonded partner draw on a particular strength. It belongs to the bonds shared between companions in this world.

rites.name: Villerum
rites.text: A borrowed mental discipline that a guardian of a seven-person band takes up to shield the others. It can be practiced but never fully perfected.

rites.name: Testium
rites.text: A powerful support technique that mends the wounds of allies. It is a sharper imitation of an older healing method used in battle.

rites.name: Raurnosum
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter lets out a soothing cry that steadies the fighter's allies. It is one of several skills a warrior can draw upon in battle.

rites.name: Lialium Coreosia
rites.text: A swift combat technique belonging to a fighting art of an invented world. It lets a warrior act with rapid speed in battle.

rites.name: Canus Vantialles
rites.text: A form of tactical backing that allied crews provide to a unit in the field. It can be called in when crews are nearby or when a request for combat help was made earlier.

rites.name: Vilus Cauria
rites.text: A bond-like assistance that a guardian leader can draw upon in the field. It cannot be fully learned or perfected by its wielder.

rites.name: Seriantor Amistelanum
rites.text: A bonding power is wielded by a figure who channels a shared force between allied beings. It is tied to a particular ring-like entity that binds companions together in battle.

rites.name: Castornor
rites.text: A mechanical technique that is bound to a family of shoulder-mounted rapid-fire weapons used by towering armored war machines.

rites.name: Rauniaranum Rineosia
rites.text: A starting technique that lets its wearer equip a special class of armored war-machine gear. It is the first ability unlocked on a character's path of bravery.

rites.name: Leliantus
rites.text: A third-tier driving technique that a pilot can learn to spark and sustain eagerness in their craft. It is listed among the driver abilities that a rider cultivates over time.

rites.name: Mistasia
rites.text: Foes can rally allies by pulling nearby fighters into the clash or conjuring fresh combatants. A dark finishing strike can silence this ability and stop the calls for aid.

rites.name: Valosialium
rites.text: A driver's trained talent that lets a warrior hasten their own recovery, turning the brief pause after a fall into a quicker return to the fight.

rites.name: Orineolanum
rites.text: A bound inner force that a wielder can draw upon but never fully command. It is tied to a particular mind-linked order of practitioners.

rites.name: Cianor
rites.text: Two linked skill-gestures are joined so that a pair of aligned techniques fire together in one motion. The combined strike spends both techniques at once and carries extra bonuses.

rites.name: Leonires
rites.text: A learned knack that lets a fighter's strikes sometimes call forth a glowing sphere of matching elemental power. It works the same as a sibling technique used by a certain trickster.

rites.name: Cauntanum Misianus
rites.text: A defensive technique that cancels incoming harm for a wielder. It works in the same way as several other shared combat maneuvers used across the field.

rites.name: Liastium Teres
rites.text: A bound technique of gravity-cutting that is carried by a family of armored war frames. It is woven into their blades so the frames can strike with pulls of weight.

rites.name: Orostintium
rites.text: A learned craft that lets a bearer foresee the coming moves of an opponent. It is used as a skill in combat, guiding the bearer to act before the threat arrives.

rites.name: Senus Telarus
rites.text: A tremendous jolt of stored energy that a bonded spirit can unleash in a single blow. It is gifted by a towering guardian who dwells far beyond the mountain pass.

rites.name: Reornium Naullirnus
rites.text: A fighter's technique that helps a combatant persist as the final one remaining on their side. It is a skill a warrior can draw upon in the midst of battle.

rites.name: Mintes
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter channels a sudden surge of raw energy to strengthen their next strike. It is one of the skills a warrior can call upon in battle.

rites.name: Telauror
rites.text: A learned craft of restoring wounded travelers that a driver can practice to heal allies in the field. It belongs among the trained abilities a steersman commands in the wider company.

rites.name: Tiastor Nesium
rites.text: A fighter's skill lets one striking technique be cut short and flowed into another during the brief pause after a final blow lands. Doing so fills a charging meter by half a stage.

rites.name: Mornia Valelium
rites.text: A learned skill that lets a pilot draw on the strengths of a bonded partner. It belongs to the set of abilities a driver can call upon in combat.

rites.name: Serentia Nastor
rites.text: A defender plants a blade upright into the earth and crouches behind it as a barrier against incoming strikes. The stance locks them in place until it ends, though pressing the same command again breaks it off early.

rites.name: Ceornasus
rites.text: A combat technique that a fighter can use during battle. It belongs to a set of skills known for their force on the battlefield.

rites.name: Rolleostus
rites.text: A bargain offered within a trial of the wise that lowers how much a fighter can carry while raising the points gathered during combat.

rites.name: Valastanum Teontasia
rites.text: A combat technique that draws on the flowing rhythm of a wide sea. It is one of the battle skills that fighters can call upon in the field.

rites.name: Seror Cintia
rites.text: A charged strike technique that a fighter learns within one discipline and that later evolves into a stronger form once the practitioner reaches the fifteenth tier of mastery.

rites.name: Cernarium
rites.text: A learned craft granted by a wandering traveler named after a roaming companion. It is a skill that a soul can be taught to use.

rites.name: Amiarus
rites.text: A driving technique that lets a pilot steady and restore control after a bad fall or loss of footing. It is one of the learned skills used by drivers in this invented world.

rites.name: Tinontum
rites.text: A bond-skill that a pilot-companion can call upon during battle. It belongs to the set of abilities a driver draws on in combat.

rites.name: Leontor Orestia
rites.text: A shared aid where fellow wardens lend their strength to a companion in the field. It is granted when allies are nearby or when someone has asked for help beforehand.

rites.name: Rosestanum
rites.text: A coordinated trio of ruinous strikes is unleashed together by allied forces. It is a shared assault in which three powers combine their fury into one devastating maneuver.

rites.name: Raunum Valaulor
rites.text: A spinning whirlwind technique bound to a set of back-mounted war engine armaments. It is unleashed by the pilot of a mechanical suit to strike foes with a swirling gale.

rites.name: Vaulostia
rites.text: A driver's technique that lets a fighter soak up incoming harm and keep pressing forward. It is one of the learned skills that a skilled combatant can draw upon in battle.

rites.name: Rornum Oriastanum
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter braces against incoming harm and steadies the mind. It is one of the set of battle skills a warrior can learn and use during a clash.

rites.name: Ameosium Orosor
rites.text: A bound technique that belongs to a particular kind of wielder and cannot be fully mastered by anyone. Its nature rests on its link to that wielder's inner force.

rites.name: Tirnanum Miallantum
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter channels crackling energy into a sudden, focused strike. It is one of several trained skills used in battle.

rites.name: Nialia Veontelia
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter links one strike into another during the brief pause right after a blow connects. Doing so fills a surge meter partway toward its next level.

rites.name: Caulanum Nosternes
rites.text: A bearer draws the attention of every foe and survives a deadly blow at one health, gaining brief invincibility. Incoming strikes return to their source while elemental weaknesses are struck automatically.

rites.name: Orones Saustium
rites.text: A lasting inner resolve that belongs to a certain circle of guiding sages, and it cannot be fully mastered by anyone who holds it.

rites.name: Ceosarnor
rites.text: A set of lingering hindrances laid upon a foe in a fixed sequence, slowing its movement and blocking its retaliation. Some hindrances only take hold when they follow one another in a particular order.

rites.name: Rornaullium
rites.text: A tossed-weapon strike that a hurler's partner unleashes on command. The thrown blade returns to its wielder once the forceful assault concludes.

rites.name: Mausiantes
rites.text: A learned knack that lets a fighter in a traveling crew soak up harm and endure hard blows. It is one of the trained skills a driver of the great mechanical beasts can call upon.

rites.name: Nintum Oriasia
rites.text: A combat technique that a fighter can call upon during a clash. Its exact workings are not described in this entry.

rites.name: Oreorum Corernum
rites.text: A faint inner perception that a person may sense beyond ordinary sight and hearing. It is a knack that resists mastery, and it is tied to a particular grouping of kindred practitioners.

rites.name: Lentostum
rites.text: A battle technique that a fighter can call upon during combat. It is listed among the skills available to warriors in a shared fighting tradition.

rites.name: Corostor Corastus
rites.text: A dueling technique practiced by common fighters who channel their blades into a devastating finishing sequence. It is a learned combat art rather than an innate gift.

rites.name: Nires Serintor
rites.text: A ranged burst technique that a mechanical war-suit wielder can channel through a back-mounted emitter. Creatures of a rival kind usually wield it, and it can be seized by striking away the limbs those creatures rely on.

rites.name: Venostia Oreornia
rites.text: A combat technique that lets a fighter move with heightened speed during battle. It is listed among the skills a warrior can draw upon in combat.

rites.name: Mornes Riarnum
rites.text: A restorative aura drawn by strong beings that mends the bearer a small share of its full vitality at regular intervals. It lasts without end, so foes wearing it are hard to finish until the aura is stripped away.

rites.name: Raullus Corollum
rites.text: A crackling burst of lightning-like energy that a fighter can unleash in combat. It is one of the fighting techniques known to warriors in the field.

rites.name: Niantes Tellum
rites.text: A fighting technique that lets common warriors of the wider realm strike with fluid, graceful motion during combat.

rites.name: Telalia Coraullirus
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter's body is briefly transferred into another form to unleash a stronger attack. It is one of the battle skills available to fighters in the wider conflict.

rites.name: Collor Telastanum
rites.text: A shared bond skill that two partners can join together, unlocked by studying a certain collected lesson volume. It grows stronger as the pair learns more.

rites.name: Oriantanum Corianerus
rites.text: A driver's skill in a sky-island realm that lets a bonded partner draw on the vitality of living creatures. It is used in combat and shaped by the driver's bond with the partner.

rites.name: Coriallanum Taraurnum
rites.text: A devastating technique that a combatant can unleash in a fight. It belongs to a class of powerful strikes that are known for their great force.

rites.name: Cianillus
rites.text: A spinning storm-art is channeled through a back-mounted weapon rig worn by mechanical suits. Its first users were hulking war-machines that wielded it as an arm-mounted blade, while people later adopted it for their own suits.

rites.name: Coralles Nelanum
rites.text: A mind-shaping technique that a wandering adept gains by drawing it from a hidden source of desire. It lets its user bend the wild impulses of others.

rites.name: Coriastinia
rites.text: A rare inner surge that a fighter may draw from strikes she lands. It grants a small chance each time she deals harm to refill her full reserve of combat talent.

rites.name: Cirosium
rites.text: These are combat techniques that a piloted mech draws from its equipped weapons. Each one is chosen by the weapon attached to a particular part of the machine, and many are offensive while others heal or strengthen the pilot.

rites.name: Taurnia Teleontes
rites.text: A driver's craft in which a gentle touch steadies a companion and eases their strain. It is one of the learned techniques that partners can draw upon in battle.

rites.name: Manialus
rites.text: A set of special techniques that a wielder can perform only after building up a store of charged inner force. Each technique draws on a full reserve before it can be unleashed.

rites.name: Saustallum
rites.text: A martial capacity held by a battle-hardened guardian leader that cannot be fully mastered. It shapes how the commander fights and what the warrior can grow into.

rites.name: Serirnontia
rites.text: A restorative power wielded by a bonded guardian creature. It is put to use by one of its keepers in a distant realm.

rites.name: Tostauranum
rites.text: A combat technique that a fighter performs in battle to unleash a special attack. It belongs to a set of skills used by warriors in the field.

rites.name: Niraullium
rites.text: A binding affliction that spreads across a group of linked souls, passed among them as a shared burden. It is wielded by a cyclical order of wanderers who draw strength from the bond.

rites.name: Seristenia
rites.text: A guarded bodily posture that a fighter adopts to lower their own strength and block any gain of it while the stance holds.

rites.name: Riasum Teolontus
rites.text: A steadfast inner discipline held by a guardian band of seven. It cannot be fully mastered, and its name is recorded only in an outside guide rather than spoken within the world itself.

rites.name: Vosanum Orostasia
rites.text: A fiery technique drawn from a back-mounted war engine that a pilot can only obtain through a demanding trial. It unleashes a searing burst of heat that scorches all who face it.

rites.name: Sollum Oroliasus
rites.text: A learned craft that lets a bearer pass charged force outward to nearby allies. It is taught as one of the practiced techniques of a guiding mind's trained disciples.

rites.name: Valonum Merosus
rites.text: A soul-hacking technique that a determined warrior grants to a companion. It enhances fighting strength when the wielder channels inner resolve.

rites.name: Veornes Maulus
rites.text: A sudden tactical maneuver used in combat by a warrior to catch enemies off guard. It belongs to the set of fighting techniques wielded by battling forces.

rites.name: Amaullum Teontinia
rites.text: A driver's trained combat technique in a fictional world that lets a partner fighter unleash a fierce feline-like assault. It belongs among the skills a driver can call upon in battle.

rites.name: Valeolium Serorialles
rites.text: A driving technique that lets a rider move with unmatched nimbleness. It is one of the skills a pilot can learn to refine how they handle their vehicle.

rites.name: Oreostum Velus
rites.text: A bond-style technique belonging to a lost vanguard of fighters, which can never be fully mastered. Practitioners find it a continuing challenge rather than a finished skill.

rites.name: Corilenor
rites.text: A calming technique used in battle that lulls a single foe into a deep rest. It copies an older sedating art and works on one target at a time.

rites.name: Taulum Ciarnostes
rites.text: A mass-hurling technique used by a wielder during a combined assault, it empowers every companion and refills the shared gauge so extra commands can follow. Its strength grows when the challenge is set to a gentler level.

rites.name: Veostolia
rites.text: A foresight-craft that lets a practitioner glimpse what is yet to come. It is an innate talent art tied to a single bearer.

rites.name: Valosastor
rites.text: A late-stage fighting discipline that can only be reached after advancing from a specific earlier path. It grants enhancements to both close-combat strikes and distant attacks.

rites.name: Oriarolum
