rites.text: A swift technique that a wielder can channel as part of a combined assault on an enemy. It belongs to one fighter's repertoire and is used during a linked attack sequence.

rites.name: Lintasium
rites.text: A driving art used by a wielder of a great blade, it reuses an earlier mighty strike. It belongs to the set of arts available to one particular bearer of that weapon.

rites.name: Telires Valaunialia
rites.text: A wielder charges a blade with drifting energy and releases a wave of it toward distant foes. The wave strips their protective glows and blocks their power surges for a time.

rites.name: Mania Valernes
rites.text: A high-tier blade-based special technique belonging to a far-future cosmic fighting system. It belongs to a distinct fourth rank of blade techniques.

rites.name: Telirnes Oralaunanum
rites.text: A learned maneuver by which a pilot in a deep-space guardian frame cuts through the atmosphere of a distant world. It is taught to knights who have reached the ninth tier of their order.

rites.name: Telaneolium
rites.text: A bearer lets their living armor shift into any mineral-bonded attunement that extends the ongoing chain of strikes, or any attunement at all when no chain has begun. Guided by a companion, the bearer can pick the next attunement freely, while an automated ally chooses one no one else has readied.

rites.name: Siantes Coresus
rites.text: A fused fencing technique that combines blade craft with an art of the future. It draws on a shared inner power used by warriors who wield a single weapon.

rites.name: Lostalia
rites.text: A fused battle-craft of the war-mages that combines two disciplines into a single art. It is practiced in the far-future conflicts of the age.

rites.name: Marium Seonia
rites.text: A tireless inner surge that a seasoned healer of the Veyra circle draws upon once they have mastered their craft. It is said to quicken the body's own restorative flow.

rites.name: Valirnia Nialeorium
rites.text: A fusion craft of war-sorcery that compels its practitioner toward destruction. It joins the arts of battle-magic and mage combat into a single surging force.

rites.name: Corostarium
rites.text: A combat technique in which a wielder folds the space around them to slip between points in the world. It is recorded among the battle skills of a particular fighting tradition.

rites.name: Tauntes
rites.text: A hovering, unmasterable technique tied to a hunter order of the skies. It cannot be fully learned by any practitioner.

rites.name: Tillentanum
rites.text: A fused arcane discipline in which a war-caster blends two charged currents into one blast. It is practiced by those trained for battle in a distant age.

rites.name: Tosteollor
rites.text: A combat technique in which the user bends space into a tear that strikes a foe from an unexpected angle. It is one of the fighting arts practiced by warriors in a distant cosmic conflict.

rites.name: Aminteones
rites.text: A combat discipline that fuses a warrior's arcane craft with volatile energy, letting the practitioner unleash a sudden explosive burst.

rites.name: Risor Norneres
rites.text: A layered offensive craft in which a single projectile is fused from several strands of battle sorcery. It is practiced by wartime spellcasters of a distant, technologically advanced era.

rites.name: Cilauntor
rites.text: A fused performance art that binds music and movement together. It is practiced as a craft within a far-future setting, drawing on the arts of its time.

rites.name: Siallor Laurnentum
rites.text: A dark cosmic power wielded by an order of ancient serpent-bound wardens. It channels the force of blotted-out light for their rites.

rites.name: Amauntanum Corantillum
rites.text: A combat technique the fighters of this world can invoke during battle. It belongs to the set of skills they draw on when waging war.

rites.name: Miasia Leoles
rites.text: A far-future fighting art that fuses fencing discipline with a focused energy technique. Practitioners wield a shimmering blade to blur their strikes and confuse foes.

rites.name: Cenes
rites.text: A combined strike technique that a skilled blade-wielding fighter performs alongside a partner. It is a coordinated attack from two allies working together.

rites.name: Seriasellum
rites.text: A battle technique that lets a fighter briefly sharpen their strikes and movement during combat. It is counted among the fighting skills a warrior can draw upon in battle.

rites.name: Sostium Lantes
rites.text: A shielding craft that projects a field which strips away the protection of mind-born beings, leaving them open to harm. It works by weaving a counter-pattern into the air around the target.

rites.name: Niastor Ceosor
rites.text: A coined stellar-craft technique that rides on the Kestrun barrage cloaks, which are armored shells used as heavy weapons. It pairs with that family of devastating arms.

rites.name: Liarinus Costasia
rites.text: A starfire technique bound to a line of armored war machines, unleashed through their integrated arms. It draws on the power of the weapons fitted to the machines' frames.

rites.name: Reostaria
rites.text: A singular rite of power that only one vast engine-entity can awaken. Its unleashing is reserved solely for that single machine's control.
